chapters.title: Chapter 601 People Thoughts
paragraphs: "What do you think happened to them? How did they turn into demons? Is it possible that demons have infiltrated this kingdom?" Lian Jinshu asked his brother-in-law.

"I can't answer that." Yong Zhengjun replied with a heavy sigh. "However, this kingdom is under the supervision of Huangfu Shou's subordinates, and he has ordered them to kill any demons who dare to infiltrate here, so I'm sure no demons can get past them. Perhaps someone has harmed them, but I am unsure of the perpetrator's identity. Your wife is my sister; I asked Cheng Feng to reach out to our organization's headquarters for help. We are currently awaiting their response, but I'm uncertain if they have a solution to help them recover."
"I see." Lian Jinshu nodded in understanding. "In that case, I will wait to hear from you about their answer, and I hope they have a solution for my family."

After Yong Zhengjun left, Lian Jinshu immediately approached his family and forced them to swallow a pill. "This pingan pill will make you guys sleep for a long time so that you won't be stressed about your situation, and I will try to find other ways to restore your condition."
Lian Jinshu then went to another room, took out his alchemy furnace, and tried to concoct something for his family.
In a sect, two women sit side by side uneasily, confusing their sect sisters.
"What happened to you two, Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying?" A female disciple asked the two women.
Another female disciple also asked them. "Do you two miss Prince Lian? As I recall, he went to the Star Tower ten days ago, right?"
"Yeah, you're right, Ting Ting." Gu Hanshuang then answered the first woman's question. "As Ting'er said just now, Qingying and I do miss Prince Lian, Ning Wu."

Dan Qingying naturally knew that Gu Hanshuang was lying, but she chose to follow her. "A month before Prince Lian left for the Star Tower, he was always by our side, and we had grown accustomed to his presence."
"Are you two really happy to be with him?" Ning Wu curiously asked.

Ting Ting also asked. "As far as I know, he has several other women by his side, right? Examples are Xuan Cunhua from the Black Fang Sect and Ming Yunjie from the Venomous Serpent Sect, both of which are located in the Huang Kingdom."

"Humph!" Dan Qingying snorted as she showed her the sea dragon bracelet. "Xuan Cunhua and Ming Yunjie do live close to Prince Lian in the Huangfu Kingdom, but he cares more about us than them, so we don't worry about them. Among his women, Ling Long from the Huangfu Imperial Sect is the one who worries us the most, especially since she lives with him in the Huangfu Kingdom."

Ting Ting and Ning Wu agreed with that. "Ling Long is not beautiful, but she has a devilish figure and high cultivation. She is even stronger than Prince Lian, so I'm not surprised if he prioritizes her."
Gu Hanshuang abruptly rose from his seat and helped Dan Qingying stand up. "Do you two want to join us? We are heading to the capital to search for resources for our cultivation."
"Yes!" Ting Ting and Ning Wu immediately followed them. "We've heard about the Sky Jade Restaurant, but we've never tried their dishes, so we want to go there now."
"Are you sure that brat kidnapped Meiling?" Zhou Xiaochuan asked as he stared at his first son, Zhou Tong.

"Honestly, I don't have any evidence of that, Father." Zhou Tong was silent for a moment. "However, that kid's ability and strength are simply absurd, and his appearance is too mysterious. That's why I'm sure that he kidnapped Meiling, and he probably hid her somewhere that no one else could find. Moreover, he also has a close relationship with that mysterious woman called Feng Yao, and she came to our realm specifically for him."
"Meiling disappeared before Feng Yao arrived, right?"
"Yes, Father."
Zhou Xiaochuan nodded slightly. "In that case, she has nothing to do with your sister's disappearance, but I agree with you that Zhang Fei is most likely the kidnapper."
"What should we do now, Father? We have to save Meiling as quickly as possible, or they will use her against us."

"I want you to stay in our kingdom and enter seclusion, and you must break through to the Divine Expansion Realm soon." Zhou Xiaochuan's answer caused Zhou Tong to raise his eyebrows. "Xian Changyue already knows that you are targeting Zhang Fei, and she will report this matter to Xian Feng, so you don't need to interfere in this matter. I have ordered Shenxin to take care of that brat, and her mastery of the Soul Whisper Art is much better than yours, so I'm confident that she can take care of him."

Zhou Xiaochuan's decision to send Zhou Shenxin to deal with Zhang Fei surprised Zhou Tong for a moment. "All right, I won't interfere in this matter for the time being, but I will look for that brat after my cultivation breaks through to the next stage."
After Zhou Tong left, an old man appeared behind Zhou Xiaochuan. "Are you sure that Feng Yao comes from the upper realms?"

"Emperor, I have personally listened to her conversation with the four people from the beast and natural race's kingdom. Although she didn't say it explicitly, I'm sure the place she was referring to was one of the planets in the upper realms."
Zhou Xiaochuan propped his head with his hands and thought deeply about Feng Yao's reasons for coming to the Nine Stars Realm. "Which kingdoms are aware of her presence in our realm?"

"All of them." Zhou Xiaochuan raised his eyebrows slightly. "The people from the Huangfu Kingdom had already left when that woman arrived, but the people from the Bai Kingdom are under Huangfu Shou's control, so I'm sure he will also know about her soon after they return."
Zhou Xiaochuan then gave the old man an order. "I want you to follow Shenxin when she looks for Zhang Fei later, and if she fails to capture him, you can help her."
"Yes."
In the Ximen Demon Kingdom.
Nu Huangjin was sitting in front of her two children, listening to them recount all the events in the Star Tower, particularly the survival challenge that forced Ximen Yueliang to give up.

Nu Huangjin then checked her daughter's body, but she could not find anything strange in it. Unfortunately, she lacked the ability to check her soul, so she was unable to locate Zhang Fei's soul mark. "Even though the two of you failed to continue the challenge in the Star Tower, you both at least managed to return home safely, and you can try to go there again in the future."
"Yes, Mother." Xian Hongwu then stood up. "I will go see my father now."

Ximen Yueliang really wanted to tell Nu Huangjin about Zhang Fei's actions against her and Ximen Yan, but her words trailed off every time, leaving her helpless. "Mother, I want you to help me capture Zhang Fei and turn him into a puppet, and I will use him as my servant for the rest of his life."

"All right, I will help you get him." Nu Huangjin herself had always doted on her daughter, and she did not hesitate to fulfill all her requests. "However, Zhang Fei has a good relationship with that mysterious woman, so I cannot act rashly, and I will act immediately when the opportunity arises."

Ximen Yueliang herself had realized that Feng Yao was very strong, and she was much stronger than her parents. "Yeah, I know. The activities in the tower exhausted me physically and mentally, so I want to rest now."

After Nu Huangjin left, Ximen Yueliang immediately took off her clothes and walked to the mirror. Her expression turned gloomy as she rubbed her chest, recalling Zhang Fei's soul mark and words. "Tch! That bastard! I can't do anything to him, but my mother can definitely capture him, and I will make his life miserable if he falls into my hands!"

Meanwhile, Ximen Hongwu was already standing in front of Ximen Changtian and telling him about Zhang Fei. "Are you going to take action against him, Father? Despite his youth and weakness, his talents are undeniable, and I must acknowledge his superiority over me."

"I've sent someone to the Xian Kingdom." Ximen Hongwu was surprised by Ximen Changtian's quick action. "I've heard from your mother about that mysterious woman, and I'm sure that her sudden arrival in our realm has something to do with Zhang Fei, so we can't act carelessly if they really have a good relationship. She's much stronger than us, so I ordered him to look at the situation first before I made a decision regarding that kid."

Ximen Hongwu nodded in understanding as he realized Feng Yao's strength. "What about Ximen Yan, Father? Yueliang doesn't seem to have changed anything, but I saw for myself that he stabbed something at her neck, so I thought he had used something against her."

"Sigh." Ximen Changtian let out a soft sigh after Ximen Hongwu mentioned his nephew, especially since Ximen Yan had long wanted to get his daughter, and he did so on the orders of his blood brother, Ximen Hongfu. "Your mother couldn't find any abnormalities in Yueliang's body, so she probably used that just to paralyze him. Even so, I won't ignore other possibilities, and I will monitor your sister myself so I can immediately take action if she shows any abnormalities that will threaten us."

Ximen Hongwu nodded in understanding. "All right, I'll leave Yueliang's matter to you, Father. I'll go into seclusion now, especially since I'm still too weak, and I won't be able to inherit the kingdom if I continue to be weak like this."
Ximen Changtian nodded with satisfaction at his son's words, and he also went to see his wife as soon as his son disappeared.
Meanwhile, Ximen Yan stood before two people who were intently examining his body. They were the Emperor and the Empress of the Dark Demon Kingdom, Ximen Gongfu and Zheng Moyue.

Ximen Gongfu was disappointed as his son did not progress to the next challenge in the Star Tower, nor did he complete his task of capturing Ximen Yueliang. Moreover, Ximen Yan also lost his puppet, Qian Ying.

Unlike her husband, Zheng Moyue did not blame her son, as she did not expect that there would be a powerful soul residing in the Star Tower. All the cultivators in her generation had never realized it, even though they had challenged it several times. Moreover, Ximen Yan's cultivation was still too weak to face such a powerful soul, so he felt it was natural for him to fall under its influence.

Based on Zhang Fei's orders, Ximen Yan revealed all this to his parents. He was certain that the two demon emperors would devise a plan to capture him once they received the report from their subordinates, so he instructed the Ximen Prince to convey this information.
"Go into seclusion now."
"Yes, Father."
After their son's departure, Ximen Gongfu directly questioned his wife. "Do you believe his story about that powerful soul?"

"The Star Tower appeared in our realm out of nowhere, and we could never find its origin. The tower doesn't look too big, but it's like another world, and there are so many strange places we haven't explored in it. Moreover, there are so many difficult tests with good rewards in there, so I believe that our son is not lying to us." Zheng Moyue pondered for a while before continuing. "As for the mysterious woman, I don't think she intends to do anything in this realm other than challenge the tower, so I don't think we need to worry about her as long as we don't come into contact with her."

"You're right. We should avoid that woman, or we'll be the ones in misery if we find trouble with her." Ximen Gongfu then asked again. "Do you want to challenge the tower again? Our son may not be lying to us, but I want to prove for myself that there is a powerful soul inside the tower, and the only way to do that is to go inside again."

Zheng Moyue found the situation intriguing as well. "We can't possibly challenge the tower with just the two of us, and we have to bring some powerful demons from our kingdom to help us. If necessary, you can meet your big brother and invite him to join us, so our chances of going further up will be greater."
Ximen Gongfu frowned for a long time before nodding to him. "All right, I will meet my brother now, but I'm not sure he'll be willing to join us."
"At least you can try it first." After Ximen Gongfu left, Zheng Moyue also went to another area, where a middle-aged man was contemplating alone. "What are you thinking, Xian Hong?"

Xian Hong immediately looked up at Zheng Moyue, who was already standing in front of him. "I got information from my two sons about a brat named Zhang Fei, and I heard from them that he has a close relationship with Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, so I asked my wife to investigate him."

"I've heard from our people about that kid, and his talent seems to be far above our children, especially since he can light ten crystals with his cultivation still at the Earth Realm." Zheng Moyue then sat on the table in front of Xian Hong while crossing her legs over each other, revealing her smooth, long legs. "Has your wife found any information about him?"

Xian Hong swallowed his saliva before sharing with Zheng Moyue some details about Zhang Fei, particularly his restaurant in the Xian Kingdom. "My wife won't be able to do anything about that kid due to his relationship with Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang, so please send someone to help her."

Zheng Moyue immediately contacted someone and ordered him to go to the Xian Kingdom. "Do you want to join us? My husband and I plan to go to the tower and challenge it soon, especially since we want to check something there."

"Oh? What made you guys suddenly think of challenging the tower?" Zheng Moyue promptly shared her son's story with Xian Hong. "The presence of the powerful soul is indeed a mystery, and there are still many other mysteries there. That's why I will join you guys, and I hope we can reach a higher floor than last time."

Zheng Moyue abruptly got off the table, took a seat on Xian Hong's lap, and wrapped his arms around his neck. "My husband has gone to see his big brother to discuss the matter, and he probably won't be back for a few days. This way, we can have fun with the two of us for the time being, and he can join us after he comes back."

'I've been with them for a long time, but I still can't understand this woman's madness, and Ximen Gongfu doesn't even mind her sexual fetishes.' Xuan Hong immediately picked up Zheng Moyue and laid her on the bed, where they began their sexual activity.
When the fourth test of the survival challenge finally appeared two hours later, a group from the Bai Kingdom, led by Bai Chongxi, suddenly approached Zhang Fei's group.

Zhang Fei deliberately told them their location and asked them to come to him, especially since the people from the Zhou, Huangfu, Ximen, and Dark Demon Kingdoms had been eliminated. "Do you three still want to continue the challenge? If you guys want to stop, I can send you all to my private place now, but all of you must wait for us to complete our challenge before I send you three to another place."
"I'm still curious about the other challenges, and I want to know my limits so we will continue our challenges." Bai Renfu and Bai Shouyi nodded in agreement with their big brother.
"All right." Zhang Fei then led his group to search for items in accordance with the new test's request.
Bai Chongxi also led his two siblings to another area, but Bai Shouyi repeatedly glanced at Zhang Fei, and his closeness to Xian Xianqin somewhat annoyed her.

chapters.title: Chapter 602 Natural Challenge
paragraphs: After spending several hours in the survival challenge, all groups completed all the tests. The elimination of the groups from the Zhou, Ximen, and Dark Demon Kingdoms surprised most of them. Even so, they didn't show the slightest happiness, especially since the remaining three challenges were only individual.
They didn't have time to rest because another portal descended from above and sucked them in, sending them to the location of the next challenge.

Despite the intense heat in his location, which caused him to sweat profusely, Zhang Fei felt fortunate as the entire area was engulfed in flames and lava, particularly since he was only confronting the fire element in this natural challenge. Moreover, he has mastered the initial stage of the fire element law since four and a half months ago, but he still has difficulty breaking through to the intermediate stage.

"I think that old man deliberately arranged this for me, so I won't waste the opportunity he gave me." Zhang Fei then floated to the center of the location, sat there cross-legged, and closed his eyes. "The fire element in this place is incredibly powerful, so I will utilize it to understand and master the intermediate stage of the fire law."
Unlike when he studied the fire law for the first time, Zhang Fei did not seal his senses because of his familiarity with the fire element, and he released it as he merged himself with nature.

Countless threads of fire elements quickly emerged from the flames and lava in that location, and they moved toward Zhang Fei. Some of them flowed directly into his body, and some others enveloped him like a fire sphere.

When Zhang Fei sensed this, a faint smile appeared on his face. He absorbed them without hesitation, particularly after Mei informed him that they could help his fire element reach its peak stage, thereby boosting its power.

Unlike Zhang Fei, the majority of other participants, including his group members, encountered difficulties in overcoming their natural challenges. Some of them met elements like theirs, but others met different elements, forcing them to give up because they couldn't understand their laws.
Four women were already at the Sky Jade Restaurant, and they seemed to be enjoying the dishes on their table. However, two of them kept glancing up at the second floor, confusing their two friends.

Zhu Yan, who was cooking in the kitchen, was not surprised by the arrival of Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying. However, she refrained from asking for their purpose because of the presence of their two friends, especially since Zhang Fei had already told her that they were Huangfu Lian's women.
"What are you two looking for? Why do you guys keep glancing up at the top floor?" Ting Ting asked both women.
Gu Hanshuang shook her head slightly before explaining. "Ten days ago, we met an old friend here, and she came down from the second floor, so we thought she might be here."
"Unfortunately, she doesn't seem to be here right now, so we'll see her another time." Dan Qingying added to her friend's words.

Both women deliberately mentioned Zhang Fei as a woman, especially since Ting Ting and Ning Wu couldn't keep a secret, and they would definitely tell Huangfu Lian if they knew about him, which would bring them great trouble.
"Oh." Ting Ting responded flatly and continued to enjoy the dishes.
Although Ning Wu did not ask Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying anything, suspicion flashed across her eyes as she glanced at them.

'They are both obviously lying to us, and I am sure that the person they are referring to is a man. But who is that man? Why are they looking for him? Is his status better than Prince Lian's? If I report this matter to him, he will reward me handsomely, and he might even consider taking me as his woman to replace them.' Ning Wu secretly sent a voice transmission to Huangfu Lian to inform him of the matter. 'What happened? Why can't I contact him? As far as I remember, there were no communication restrictions in the Star Tower in the past, yet I couldn't contact him.'
Unfortunately, Ning Wu still didn't know that Huangfu Lian had returned to her kingdom, and the Huangfu Kingdom was sealed off from outsiders, so she was unable to contact the Huangfu Prince.

Liu Hua, who was in a meeting with the Wen Twins and the five members of the demon fox group on the second floor, naturally noticed their presence in their restaurant. She then contacted Zhang Fei [1], who was arranging goods in their new shop, and asked him whether he would immediately take action against Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying.

Zhang Fei [1] immediately informed Liu Hua that he would meet the two women after he finished arranging their shop, especially since Huangfu Lian had returned to his kingdom, and he might meet them soon, so he had to act quickly.
"Big Sis, are we going to open other restaurants in the other kingdoms?" Wen Yuan asked Liu Hua.

Wen Xuan also spoke to her. "The area of each kingdom is very large, and this Xian Kingdom is even much wider than the western region in our realm. If we live here, it will be difficult for us to find information about the other kingdoms, so I thought that opening a branch in each kingdom would be our best option, allowing us to monitor their movements closely."

Liu Hua nodded in agreement with them. "Fei'er has already thought about it, and he is thinking of opening another restaurant in the Yun Kingdom first, especially since Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua have openly expressed their intention to establish a good relationship with him. Unfortunately, the rest of our members aren't ready for missions in this realm, and we don't have a suitable chef yet, so we must find one."

The Wen twins nodded in understanding, especially since their restaurant sold dishes from the Earth. The best chefs on Zhang Fei's side to cook for them were Zhang Chen and Qing Yi, but he would never let his grandmother and mother go to the Yun Kingdom and live there. Moreover, their restaurant in the Xian Kingdom had not been open for long, so he couldn't possibly move Zhu Yan to that kingdom.

"Let's talk about this matter later, and we just have to wait for Fei'er's decision." Liu Hua then shared another piece of information with them. "By the way, he has asked Huan Ya to come here, and she will join our group. Besides her, Situ Yi is his slave, so he is also part of our group, but he asked him to stay in the Yun Kingdom and monitor the people from the alchemy union in the capital city of the kingdom."
"Is it really okay for that woman to join us, Big Sis?" Wen Xuan asked.
Wen Yuan then added. "After all, he did not enslave that woman, so she still has her consciousness and will, and she is also still part of the alchemy union."

"Haha." Liu Hua laughed softly in response. "Yuan'er, you've been living with Fei'er for a long time. Do you still not understand his character? He did not enslave Huan Ya, but she was his former enemy, so he must have done something to her. That's why you don't need to worry about her, especially since she won't be able to say anything about us, and her life is already in his hands. She'll probably be here soon, so I'll leave her to you two. Anyway, you guys should come back to our residence once he's done with the tower, and we'll go back into seclusion."
"Yes, Big Sis." Both women answered with a nod.

In the Wasteland Realm, Shang Xiaoyin was angry as soon as she and the two women arrived at their residence, especially after she found Shang Xinyu cultivating in her room. She had waited for several days near the western island, but she had never seen her or the others leave the island, yet she had returned to their residence earlier than them.
'What are your plans now, Xiaoyin?' Shang Jiali asked.

Shang Xiaoyin frowned as she thought. 'I want you two to watch over Xinyu for the time being, and I will return to our realm to see my mother. I actually didn't want to involve her, but that kid seems to have many special abilities, so I have no choice but to ask for her help.'
'Are you going to ask Aunt Ziyuan to suppress Xinyu's family?' Shang Yifen asked worriedly.

'Why not?' Shang Xiaoyin asked back with a faint smile. 'Xinyu has become too close to that kid and Yaolin, so I no longer consider her part of us, and I will ask my mother to suppress her family. Moreover, Wuzi is eager to marry her, so I will ask my mother to force her parents to marry them. This way, she will no longer be able to stay in this realm, and she will not be able to gather with the two of them anymore.'

After she said that, Shang Xiaoyin rushed off to the fortress, leaving Shang Jiali and Shang Yife feeling helpless. Once she arrived there, she immediately returned to her realm through the portal that connected the two realms.

Shang Jiali immediately returned to her private place, especially since she didn't care much about Shang Xinyu's fate. However, Shang Yifen was different from her, and she cared a lot about her friend's fate because their situations were similar to each other, so she went straight into her room.
Shang Xinyu immediately opened her eyes. "What happened? Why is your expression like that?"

"Xinyu, you are in big trouble." Shang Yifen hurriedly told him about Shang Xiaoyin's plans for him and his family, causing Shang Xinyu to panic. "Xiaoyin is not messing around with her plans, and she is returning to our realm to see her mother. I can only help you to this extent, so you must think of something to deal with this matter yourself."
"Thank you, Yifen." After Shang Yifen left, Shang Xinyu rushed to look for Zhang Xiaolong [3] in Shang Yaolin's room.
When she arrived there, Shang Xinyu found Zhang Xiaolong[3] just returning from the mountaintop, and she immediately explained her situation to him and Shang Yaolin, causing their faces to darken.
"Can you do anything to help her, Big Sis Yaolin?"

Shang Yaolin shook her head at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Shang Ziyuan is the little sister of our patriarch, and her influence in our clan is second only to his. My father is only a member of our branch clan, and my mother's Murong clan is not as strong as our Shang clan, so I can't do anything for Xinyu."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding before showing two of his six tails, surprising both women. "I just evolved a few days ago when we were still in the western region, but I purposely kept it a secret because many people were watching me. However, I had no other choice now, so I deliberately showed it to you two, or you will be confused about my new ability." (A/N: He disguised himself as a ten-year-old fox with one tail from the start. Chapter 407: A Black Key.)
"What is your second ability, Long'er?" Both women curiously asked.

"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled and asked Mei to open a gate, shocking the two women. "I got this ability from my father's bloodline, and this gate will take us to our hiding realm before my father sends me to the Netherworld Realm. This way, I can hide Big Sis Xinyu from them, and the situation in that realm is much calmer, so she will be safe there. Regarding her parents, I believe you should ask Aunt Qianying or Aunt Xinxin to hide them elsewhere, as I believe Shang Ziyuan would not dare to go against both clans at the same time."

"You're right." Shang Yaolin replied with a nod. "Even though my mother's Murong Clan is not as strong as our Shang Clan, Aunt Xinxin's Hong Clan is very strong. Even our patriarch would not dare to find trouble with them directly, let alone Shang Ziyuan, so they would be safe hiding there."

"In that case, you can contact Aunt Qianying or Aunt Xinxin now so they can act as soon as possible." Shang Yaolin nodded and contacted the two women directly. Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned to Shang Xinyu. "Is it okay if you hide in that realm for a while, Big Sis Xinyu? As long as they can't find you, then they won't be able to force you to marry Shang Wuzi. You might be lonely there, but I promise to visit you often, and I will bring Big Sis Yaolin with me."
"I will pack my things now, and I will hide in that realm." Shang Xinyu then asked Shang Yaolin, who had finished contacting the two women. "What about them? Are they willing to protect my family?"
Shang Yaolin told her directly. "Aunt Xinxin agreed, and she went straight to your family's house to pick them up, so you don't have to worry about them."

"Thank you." Shang Xinyu then hurried back to her room and packed up her things, and she went straight back to Shang Yaolin's room afterward. Zhang Xiaolong [3] took the two women to the Azure Sky Realm, specifically to Azaroth's former hut.

However, they did not spend much time there before Zhang Xiaolong [3] took Shang Yaolin back to the Wasteland Realm to continue her work. She informed him that Murong Qianying would be arriving tomorrow night, which excited him.
Even so, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still thinking about Shang Xiaoyin and Shang Ziyuan's plans for him, but he wasn't too worried about them either, and he immediately cultivated in the room.

During the natural challenge, the red aura surrounding Zhang Fei's body intensified, and his body persistently absorbed the fire elements that were constantly moving toward him. Mei suddenly informed him that his fire element would soon advance to the peak stage, so he immediately accelerated his absorption rate.
A creature with a small fire-formed body and a salamander-like appearance continued to observe Zhang Fei from a distance, undetected by Mei or the system, as his actions piqued its interest.

The fire salamander suddenly came out of hiding and moved quickly toward Zhang Fei's location, which caused its presence to be detected by Mei and the system immediately. The female AI immediately informed her master about it, but he chose to ignore it.
Sometime later, Zhang Fei's fire element suddenly flared up, becoming much redder than before, and the heat emanating from it was even hotter than before.
[Congratulations! The host fire element has been upgraded to the peak stage.]

Zhang Fei was pleased with that, but he did not immediately open his eyes and continue to absorb the fire element in that place, especially since his understanding of the fire law had not yet reached the intermediate stage. Moreover, he didn't have much time in the challenge, so he didn't want to waste time and wanted to master it before the available time ran out.
Below Zhang Fei, the fire salamander kept looking up at him, and it patiently waited for him to open his eyes.
About two hours later, another notification appeared in Zhang Fei's mind, relieving him.
[Congratulations! The host fire law has been upgraded to the intermediate stage.]

"Phew." Zhang Fei let out a sigh of relief and opened his eyes before landing in front of the fire salamander, but it immediately retreated when he wanted to touch it. "Weren't you waiting for me? I won't hurt you, so you don't have to be afraid of me."

chapters.title: Chapter 603 Fire Elemental Spirit
paragraphs: [Master, this salamander is an elemental spirit born from the fire here; it approached you because it was attracted to your fire, so you can try to tantalize it.]
Zhang Fei crouched in front of the fire salamander, opened his right palm toward it, and used his fire element. "Here, you can taste my fire."

The fire salamander carefully crawled toward him, but it paused in front of him before licking his fire. Zhang Fei felt strange and amused as he watched the fire salamander lick his fire, but he could see that it was thoroughly enjoying itself, so he poured more fire qi into it, causing it to intensify.

The fire salamander licked Zhang Fei's fire faster, but it never decreased because he didn't stop using his fire qi. He then rubbed its head and asked. "Are you alone in this place? Do you want to come with me to leave this place?"
The fire salamander stopped licking and looked at Zhang Fei, but since it couldn't speak, it answered him by jumping into his flames and disappearing.
[Ding]
[The host obtained approval from a fire elemental spirit.]

'You're truly lucky, kid.' Ma Kuangyu suddenly spoke into Zhang Fei's mind. 'Elemental creatures are usually very difficult to tame, and only a few people can tame them. However, the fire elemental creatures are willing to follow you. Since it chose you as its master, it will become your newest power, boost your fire strength, and help you fight. Once your understanding of the fire law reaches the perfection stage, it will become extremely powerful, making it difficult for cultivators with opposing elements to fight against the two of you.'
'Are there many elemental creatures in this universe?' Zhang Fei posed this question as he stood up.

Ma Kuanqgyu told Zhang Fei directly. 'Each element can give birth to many elemental creatures, and their forms are different. I've met a few of them in the past, but the strongest one I've ever met was a thunder roc. It can move as fast as thunder, and it can also produce truly wide-area attacks. Given that you now possess four elements and have already acquired an elemental creature for your fire element, you should consider seeking additional creatures for your remaining three elements, particularly your wind element. Not all elemental creatures will follow you like the fire salamander, and not all will be suitable for you, so you must find the best one.'

'I see.' Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. 'If I'm not mistaken, there is a lightning elemental creature in my current realm, but I don't have the lightning element yet, so there's no way I can look for it. If my guess is correct, it should live in the Cyanwood Mountaintop, and it guards the low-rank lightning elemental seed.'
'So your purpose in coming to this realm is to obtain the low-rank lightning elemental seed, huh?'
'Yeah.' Zhang Fei did not hide it from Ma Kuangyu. 'The lightning element is one of the strongest and can be used for area attacks, so I want to get it, even though the chance is very small.'

Ma Kuangyu then spoke again. 'I don't know the situation on the mountain yet, but you shouldn't have much trouble getting through the lightning protecting the seed, especially since you've already gone through several lightning tribulations. However, you should still be careful when looking for it, especially since the lightning can be stronger than your tribulation, and it could probably kill you on the spot.'
'That's true.' Zhang Fei suddenly felt a change in that place, and he disappeared from there quickly, especially since his natural challenge was over.
"Fei!" Xian Xianqin immediately shouted and jumped to hug Zhang Fei, making him smile in amusement at her childish behavior. "Are you having trouble facing your challenges?"

"Not at all." Zhang Fei replied by shaking his head. "My challenge was too easy because I met the fire element, and it actually helped my fire element rise to the peak stage; even my understanding of fire law has reached the intermediate stage."
"Have you really reached the intermediate stage of the fire element law?" Feng Yao asked in surprise.

Zhang Fei immediately stretched his hand forward and activated his fire qi, causing Feng Yao to fall into a daze. After all, she was the one who taught him the fire element law, and he had only mastered the initial stage about four and a half months ago, yet he had already mastered the intermediate stage.

Zhang Fei immediately withdrew his fire qi, touched Feng Yao's forehead, and shared his understanding of the intermediate stage of the fire law with her. "My shop will open tomorrow, so I have to accompany Lingxue to the opening, and she will perform a live alchemy show to attract customers." Xian Xianqin turned her head in surprise. Zhang Fei suddenly planted a gentle kiss on her lips before continuing. Your parents, Senior Changyue, and those powerful cultivators cannot touch you, so you can easily escape danger."

Xian Xianqin smiled sweetly in response to Zhang Fei's words, but she still felt strange about herself. After all, she had only met him about a month ago, and she had never liked another man after Yun Aoxian rejected her in the past. However, she fell in love with him in a short time, and they even kissed several times. "Did you secretly use your charm ability on me, Fei?"
"No." Zhang Fei answered with a slight shake of his head. "I never used it on you, but my natural charm became quite high after I evolved, and you were unknowingly affected by it."

"You're probably right about that." Xian Xianqin looked up at the night sky again. "I started to feel this way for you after I saw you evolve; your teasing and praise may have also influenced me. No man had ever dared to tease me before, and they had always praised me because of my status as a princess. However, you are different from them because you never gave a damn about my status, and I can be myself whenever I'm with you."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled at that. "In my eyes, your status as a princess is just a mere one, and you are no different from all my wives."

Xian Xianqin nodded slightly. "Does this mean you've accepted your feelings for me now?"

Even so, I haven't thought about becoming your wife, and I want to build a deeper relationship with you first. Moreover, I want to focus on my cultivation and training first, so I don't want to be distracted by other things. Otherwise, it will be difficult for me to develop myself, and I won't be able to stand on an equal footing with you."

"It's okay; I'm in no rush to take you as my wife, so you can do whatever you want according to your heart." Zhang Fei then took out several bottles and gave them to Xian Xianqin. "These bottles contain my Yang Qi, and you can use them if you want. My Yang Qi is different because I am a mythical beast, and it can strengthen your body. As for your cultivation, I don't know if it will be beneficial for improving it, especially since my cultivation is still several major stages below yours."

Red hues instantly appeared on Xian Xianqin's cheeks as she imagined herself swallowing Zhang Fei's Yang Qi. Although she didn't swallow it directly from the source, the thought of swallowing Zhang Fei's Yang Qi made her believe it would be no different than accepting him as her man.

"I knew that my yang qi would arouse you, so I did this." Zhang Fei then cleaned her mouth and gave her a gentle kiss. "You should swallow the rest when you are alone, and you can use your qi to suppress the effects."

"Yeah." Xian Xianqin then kept the rest of the bottle, leaned against Zhang Fei's chest, and held both his hands. "My cultivation has stagnated in the quasi-divine realm for a long time, and I fervently hope to ascend to the seven divine realms soon."

"It's okay; you don't have to be too hard on yourself, especially since cultivation is never easy." Xian Xianqin nodded slightly in response to Zhang Fei. "I'll give you some pills when we enter seclusion, and they will help you to break through to that stage."

'Yeah.' Zhang Fei admitted it openly. 'I have already regarded Qin'er as my woman, and my Yang Qi is very useful to her, so I gave it to her. After we return, I will take her into seclusion, and you guys will be surprised by her improvement after we come out.'

'I can't say for sure how long we'll be in seclusion.' Zhang Fei then paused for a few moments. 'Perhaps we'll stay inside until I reach the 10-Star Earth Realm or the 1-Star Heaven Realm, so it might be a while before we come out.'

Xian Changyue raised an eyebrow after hearing that, especially since Zhang Fei's cultivation had just broken through to the 2-Star Earth Realm, so it would take him a long time to break through to that stage. 'Why are you eager to reach the Heaven Realm?'

'One of my women is still in the Sky Jade Realm, and she is in the hands of a powerful cultivator. 'I know your thoughts, but I don't want to depend on them. If I can't free Hu Yue with my own abilities, I will never be able to protect them from the powerful cultivators who might target them in the future. paragraphs: On the flying artifact, the nameless one and the white beast listened to Feng Tian's story with serious expressions, especially about the news about the Star Tower that he got from Feng Yao. However, he refrained from mentioning Zhang Fei in front of them, likely due to his familiarity with their characters and the likelihood that they would rush to the Nine Stars Realm if they heard about him.
Gong Ren also shared his experience at the Sun Tower in the Blossom Heaven Realm with the nameless one and the white beast, convincing them that the two towers indeed have the same origin.
"Old phoenix! Where did Little Yao get all that information? How can she be certain that the Star Tower holds the key to access those realms?" The white beast, Xue Bao, asked Feng Tian.

Feng Tian turned to him directly. "When Yao'er arrived at the Star Tower, the challenges there were in progress. Usually, the tower would not admit another participant midway, but it allowed her to enter and take on those challenges. As she underwent some of these challenges, she met several people who were related to the tower. At first, she only guessed that the tower came from those realms, and her guess was proven correct after the old man who controlled it met her."

The nameless one then spoke to them. "Since Yao'er has already met the person who controls the Star Tower, I believe the two towers are the key for us to open the way to those realms. To prove the truth, we have no choice but to go through all those challenges and reach the tenth floor of the Sun Tower, and I'm sure that we will meet the person who controls it there. However, I'm not sure that our numbers will be enough to reach that floor, so I think we should contact the others and ask them to set off for the Blossom Heaven Realm right away."
"I agree with you." Feng Tian said, then asked the nameless one. "Which of them should we invite to the Sun Tower?"

For some time, the nameless one thought of several names. "You can contact the leaders of the other mythical beast races, except for Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing. Those demons are still trying to invade their realm, and the Heavenly Moon Real will undoubtedly fall into the hands of the demons if the two of them leave now, which will add to our problems."
"I will contact Long Qiang, Dai Hubai, and Wang Wugui." Feng Tian immediately turned to his wife. "Wife, you can contact Zhu Hong now."
"What about Huli Xianniang, Nu Shen, and Fu Xin? Should I contact them, too?" Feng Jiu asked.
Feng Tian first turned to the nameless one, who smiled bitterly after hearing the last three names. "You can contact the three of them too, Jiu."

'Haha! This guy is always afraid of meeting the three of them, especially Huli Xianniang.' Feng Jiu inwardly laughed because of the nameless one's expression. "All right, I will contact them all now."
Xue Bao suddenly spoke to his master. "Master, that vixen Huli Xianniang will be overjoyed to meet you, and I am sure that she will not stop seducing you."
The nameless one only released a heavy sigh in response to Xue Bao's words. "How long will it take us to arrive at the Blossom Heaven Realm?"

"With the speed of my flying artifact, we can arrive at that realm in three days. However, we have to wait for the others to arrive first before we challenge the Sun Tower." After the nameless one nodded, Feng Tian immediately contacted the three people he mentioned before.
Once they received the message from Feng Tian and Feng Jiu, the six people immediately agreed and proceeded toward the Blossom Heaven Realm.

'I don't care if Shang Ziyuan is furious with them, but I think it will benefit me, especially since Shang Xiaoyin won't bother me anymore.' After that, Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin went to carry out their duties.

Meanwhile, Shang Yifen and Shang Jiali were still standing in front of the bedroom door, watching Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin kissing hotly. On the first floor, they could find the Earth Grade techniques, and they had to go up to the second floor to look for the Heaven Grade techniques. Meanwhile, the Celestial and Divine Grade Techniques were only available on the third and fourth floors.

chapters.title: Chapter 608 Hidden Floor
paragraphs: While Zhang Fei and Feng Yao were looking for a way to the hidden floor, some of the participants had already chosen a technique that suited them on the fourth floor, and they rushed to learn their chosen technique.
Xian Xianqin was eager to get a divine grade technique, but she had tried it in the past and failed to learn it, so she decided to go down to the third floor and choose a celestial grade technique.

Yun Xinyue made the same decision as Xian Xianqin, and she had already begun studying a celestial-grade technique on the third floor. Yuan Luo, Ye Zhiqiu, and Bai Shouyi also chose celestial-grade techniques. Some members of the other groups, lacking the confidence to learn the divine grade techniques, also descended to the third floor.

Meanwhile, Ximen Chuixue, Xian Xianwu, and Bai Tian'er remained on the fourth floor. They had not managed to find a technique that suited them, so they continued to search among the thousands of techniques on that floor.
After she searched for some time, Xian Changyue found a divine-grade technique for her, so she immediately took it and read it seriously before starting to learn it.

[Master, look over the upper wall north of you.] Zhang Fei immediately turned in the direction Mei was pointing, and he discovered an unusual painting. [I've checked everything in this place, but there's nothing unusual about them. However, the system can't detect the painting, so I think it's related to the hidden floor.]

Before he approached the painting, Zhang Fei saw a thin light emitting from it, convincing him that Mei was right. He directly told Feng Yao before approaching it together, and they were immediately sucked into it after they touched it.

Since most of them were already occupied with studying the divine grade techniques of their choice, almost no one noticed their disappearance, including Ximen Chuixue and Xian Xianwu, who were still busy selecting techniques.
Bai Tian'er, upon noticing the disappearance of Zhang Fei and Feng Yao, hurriedly flew in front of the painting. As soon as she touched it, the painting immediately sucked her in.
Zhang Fei and Feng Yao arrived in a room filled with extremely heavy pressure, nearly causing them to collapse to their knees.
Feng Yao immediately mobilized her cultivation to fight back the pressure, but it was still quite troublesome for her, even though it had reached the divine manifestation realm.

Zhang Fei could also feel the pressure bearing down on him, but it was not too difficult for him to overcome it. After all, he had long since adapted to sixteen times heavier gravity, and the pressure was slightly lower than that.
"How can you withstand this heavy pressure so easily?" Feng Yao asked with a surprised expression.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled in response. "You will find out about it when you join our seclusion."

Bai Tian'er suddenly appeared in front of them, but she instantly fell to the floor without being able to move or speak. 'Ugh! Why is the pressure this heavy? It's several times stronger than on the previous floor.'

"Why did you follow us here, Senior Sister?" Bai Tian'er glanced at Zhang Fei with a look of help. "I can withstand this pressure because of my body's strength, so I can't help you withstand this pressure with your fragile body, but I can send you back to the previous place."

Bai Tian'er then glanced at Feng Yao, but the phoenix princess, still struggling with the pressure, rejected her with a shake of her head. Even if she protected her with her aura, the Bai Princess still wouldn't be able to concentrate on learning the technique.

Bai Tian'er was disappointed with their answer, but she knew that she would be a burden to them if she forced herself. After she sent a voice transmission to him, Zhang Fei immediately sent her out of the place through the previous path.
In the end, Bai Tian'er had to be satisfied with choosing one of the divine grade techniques, and she immediately started learning it once she chose one.
"Zhang Fei! Please get that technique for me." Feng Yao said as she pointed towards a technique scroll, which was covered in blazing fire.
Zhang Fei looked at the technique and sucked it into his hand straight away. "Oh? Immortal grade: Phoenix Soul Ascension Art? This technique is very suitable for you as a pure phoenix."
"Yeah." Feng Yao immediately received the technique from Zhang Fei's hand and sat cross-legged to read it. "You must find the technique you need as soon as possible, or you will run out of time."

Zhang Fei utilized his senses to identify all the techniques present in the room. 'Hmm? The Immortal Jade Body Art seems interesting, but I don't know if it is better than my heavenly body tempering technique. The Soul Binding Reality Art is definitely a soul technique, but it's not much different from my dream imprisonment ability. The Immortal Breathing Method seems useful since it can speed up my Qi absorption rate, but I'm a dual cultivator, so I don't really need it. Those movement techniques are also good, but my nine cloud steps are enough for now, and I still have my teleportation ability."

For some time, Zhang Fei read and thought about the most suitable technique for him, especially since all the techniques there were extraordinary, making it confusing for him to choose one. His gaze suddenly fell on a technique that was floating quite far behind the others, and he immediately sucked it into his hand. 'What do you think of this Immortal Yin-Yang Fire Art, Mei? Should I choose this technique?'

[Actually, there are numerous techniques suitable for you, but I believe this Immortal Grade Yin-Yang Fire Art is the most appropriate. You can use this technique for both offense and defense, as well as for alchemy and blacksmithing, so I believe you should choose it over the others, Master.
[Ding]
[You obtained the Immortal Yin-Yang Fire Art.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement, opened the technique, and read the details.

[Yin-Yang Fire Art: This technique is still incomplete, and the user must absorb ten kinds of heavenly flames to perfect it. Although it is not yet perfect, the user's fire strength will increase by one hundred percent after mastering it, and it will increase by one hundred percent for each flame the user absorbs.]

'Huh?' Zhang Fei was shocked by the details of the technique. 'One hundred percent for each fire? If I were to absorb all the flames, wouldn't that equate to a total of one thousand percent? Do you have any information about the ten heavenly flames, Mei?'
[I'll show you their data, Master. Anyway, one of them is near you, so you can get it faster.]
[Ten Heavenly Flames]
1. Dragon Flame
2. Phoenix Fire
3. Soul Fire
4. Blood Fire
5. Earth Flame
6. Sky Flame
7. Sun Flame
8. Moon Fire
9. Chaotic Flame
10. Eternal Flame

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned after reading the list. 'Long Huang and his family are pure dragons, but I'm not sure that their flame would be useful, especially since they weren't flame dragons. As for the Phoenix Fire, Feng Yao was a pure fire phoenix, so she could help me with that. Do you have any information about the location of the other heavenly flames?'
[Unfortunately, the system has no information about their location, Master. Perhaps Feng Yao knows some of them, so you can ask her after you guys go back.]

'Yeah, you're right.' Since the technique was no ordinary technique, and it was of an immortal grade, Zhang Fei decided to send his five clones into the training space. This way, he could learn it more easily if his five clones also learned it at the same time, especially by using the comprehension feature.
Above the tower, the old man and his disciples continued to pay attention to Zhang Fei, wondering whether he would succeed in learning the Immortal Yin-Yang Fire Art.

Sima Yun suddenly said to Helian Xun'er. "Hey, Xun'er! I've placed a bet on my golden phoenix fern, but you haven't placed any yet. It would be wise for you to do so now, as I'm certain to win our wager."

"Haha." Hua Mei'er laughed before saying. "Old brat, Sister Xun'er has a jug of hundred-thousand-year-old frost spirit wine, and it is no less than your phoenix fern, so I believe you will really enjoy drinking it."

Sima Yun immediately turned to Helian Xun'er with sparkling eyes, causing her to sigh helplessly. She immediately took out a jug of frost spirit wine and opened the lid for a mere second, but it was enough to entice Sima Yun and their master.

Sima Yun started to drool after he smelled the aroma of the wine, and his eyes kept staring at the wine jug, but Helian Xun'er did not give it to him right away. "You can have it if that kid manages to learn the technique, but I don't believe that he can learn it in just a day, so you better be prepared to lose your golden phoenix fern."
"Heh!" Sima Yu snorted in response. "You should be prepared to lose your wine, and I will drink it together with our master."
The old man shook his head before asking Helian Xun'er. "Did you get the ingredients from the Spirit Temple? Did you use sneaky methods on Jing Shendian?"

"Yes, Master." Helian Xun'er then told them how she got the wine ingredients, making them laugh. "Jing Shendian was too stupid, so I managed to trick him into getting the golden spirit dew and the soul lotus seed. After that, I brought the two ingredients and other materials to Senior Sister Yue Bingxuan's place, and he helped me make the wine. Unfortunately, the lengthy process of making the wine, which took a hundred years, and the limited availability of ingredients resulted in only a few jars being produced."

"Haha." The old man laughed as he rubbed his beard. "Jing Shendian has always been like that, and he still hasn't changed, even though so many people have taken advantage of his innocence and naivety too many times."

"Master, look at that kid!" Hua Mei'er suddenly shouted as she pointed at the screen in front of them, and her eyes opened quite wide as she saw Zhang Fei's body being enveloped by thin black and white flames, indicating that he had begun to comprehend the Immortal Yin-Yang Fire Arts.

After being momentarily stunned, Sima Yun immediately turned to Helian Xun'er, who looked shocked. "See? I told you that we can't underestimate this kid, but you don't believe me. He's only been studying the technique for a few minutes, but he's already grasped the essence, so he'll definitely succeed in learning it."

Helian Xun'er was at a loss for words to respond to Sima Yun, as she had consistently underestimated Zhang Fei from the start, particularly due to her lack of attention toward him since he began the challenges. Furthermore, she and the others were unaware of the numerous cheats Zhang Fei possessed, which significantly aided him in overcoming all challenges.
"Yun'er is right, and this kid will definitely succeed in learning that technique." The old man uttered this as he nodded in satisfaction. "This way, your defeat is obvious, Xun'er."
"No!" Helian Xun'er still denied it. "He has indeed managed to grasp the essence of that technique, but he has not truly mastered it, so I will not admit defeat before he truly succeeds."
"Stubborn!" Sima Yu cursed silently to himself as he glanced at the jug of wine. 'Heh! I'll drink the wine in front of her later, and she will regret having looked down on that kid.'
Hua Mei'er giggled at the two of them, but then she looked at Feg Yao. "Master, the female phoenix seems like she will also succeed in learning her chosen technique."

"Yes." The old man nodded in agreement. "She is a pure fire phoenix, and she came from the upper realms, so it's not strange that she can learn the technique more easily. As for that kid, not only does he have amazing talent, but he also has extraordinary comprehension. Learning the Yin-Yang Fire Art is a challenging task, particularly for those who lack a profound understanding of the Yin and Yang.
"Are you planning to tell that guy about that kid, Master?" Hua Mei'er inquired.
Sima Yu just remembered about that. "That person is the creator of the Yin-Yang Fire Art, so I think he needs to know about this kid, Master."
The old man nodded to them. "I do have to inform that guy about him, but I won't tell him now, and I will tell him after this kid's cultivation reaches the seven divine realms."
"Why is that, Master?" Helian Xun'er asked in confusion.

The old man immediately explained. "This kid came from the lower realms, and the situation there is completely different from our realms. His talent is extraordinary indeed, but his mindset has not been fully formed, and he still needs a few years to mature in cultivation. If that guy brings him there too early, I'm afraid he won't be able to handle the pressure, and his talent will be wasted if his mindset breaks. Moreover, his talent will make many people jealous, and they will immediately kill him as soon as they hear about him. That guy is strong, but he won't be able to protect him, so it's better if he stays in his current realm until he's truly ready."
"I see."
Ten hours passed quickly; the black and white flames covering Zhang Fei's body were already extremely bright, and the two formed a Yin Yang symbol around him.

chapters.title: Chapter 609 The Sky Jade Shop
paragraphs: In order to speed up the alchemy process, Chu Ying and Chu Qing sat on either side of Zhang Lingxue, and the two of them helped her prepare the ingredients she needed to concoct pills.

Although Zhang Lingxue had not yet started her alchemy, the actions of the three of them had already attracted the attention of the residents of the capital. After all, alchemists needed a quiet atmosphere when they concocted pills, so they usually did it in a special place. Even when alchemists performed alchemy in public, it was usually during competitions or special occasions, not in front of shops or on the side of the road like her.

They were also curious about the identities of the three women, especially since they were still too young and their cultivation was still in the ten mortal realms. Moreover, the shop was once owned by the Alchemy Union, but they abruptly decided to leave their kingdom. Now, the three women have taken over the shop, which has raised numerous questions in their minds.
They wanted to take a closer look at the three women, but the imperial guards stopped them. Yang Caojing also warned them not to cause a disturbance, or Xian Feng would punish them.

Present among them were Gu Hanshuang, Dan Qingying, Ning Mu, and Ting Ting. At first, they were still enjoying their time in the capital, but they saw people gathered there, so they decided to check it out.
A while later, Zhang Lingxue had already started her alchemy, and she leisurely processed the herbs that the Chu sisters had prepared one by one.

Although not all of them understood alchemy, the audience seemed amazed by Zhang Lingxue's every move, especially her ability to control her flame despite her low cultivation. However, they doubt that Zhang Lingxue will succeed in concocting high-grade pills with her current cultivation; they are unaware that alchemy does not necessarily depend on one cultivation, and she is a king-rank alchemist.

When everything was ready, Zhang Lingxue immediately mixed all the ingredients in the furnace and began concocting the pill. A faint scent of various types of herbs began to spread in the air, attracting the attention of more and more people. In a short time, the shopfront area became overcrowded with people, causing Yang Caojing to summon additional guards to maintain security.

Meanwhile, a middle-aged woman with long brown hair and two long bangs hanging down to her chest was watching Zhang Lingxue from a building not far from the shop. Her face wasn't that pretty, but she looked mature and had her own charm. Her figure lacks height and voluptuousness, yet her purple dress accentuates her ravishing body, particularly her slightly exposed chest. 'So they are Zhang Fei's women, right?'
Zhang Fei [1], who was waiting inside the shop, naturally noticed the woman's presence, especially since he had been looking for her for some time after Xian Xianqin told him about her.
[Master, Xian Changyue's guess about Li Yiping's relationship with Ximen Gongfu is correct. I detected Yang Qi from several men inside her body, and two of them belonged to her two sons.]

'Oh?' Zhang Fei [1] was a little surprised to hear that. 'Even though her husband had lost his status as a member of the Xian royal family after he decided to defect to the demons, she was still a woman from a respectable family, but she was no different from a whore.'

[Li Yiping's cultivation is only one level below Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang; she has already reached the 4-Moon Divine Expansion Realm. If you capture her and lock her in the Yin-Yang Space, you can get a lot of Yin Qi from her.]

'Yeah.' Zhang Fei [1] suddenly narrowed his eyes as he saw a black shadow appear behind Li Yiping then transform into a middle-aged man. The system scan revealed that the man was a demon, confirming that he was Zheng Moyue's subordinate. 'Let's see what you two will do.'

Two hours quickly passed, and the audience could smell the pill's aroma getting stronger, leading those who had previously doubted Zhang Lingxue's alchemy skills to believe that she would succeed in concocting the pill. However, they were still waiting to see whether she would succeed in concocting the low, middle, or high-grade pill.

After another hour, Zhang Lingxue withdrew her fire qi directly because her pill had been perfectly formed, and the audience's eyes were glued to her alchemy furnace, waiting for the results. Before she opened the lid of her furnace, she looked at the people in front of her with a faint smile on her face.
The audience immediately gasped in shock after Zhang Lingxue opened the lid of her furnace, especially since there were five pills inside, and all of them were superior-grade.
Yang Caojing was also surprised to see the results of Zhang Lingxue's alchemy, but he then nodded in satisfaction.

'Fortunately, Fei'er gave me the Divine Alchemy Method, and I have been studying how to make this pill in the training space for quite some time, or else I would not have been able to concoct a superior grade.' Zhang Lingxue then took the pills and showed them to the audience. "I know that all of you initially doubted my alchemy abilities due to my young age and low cultivation, but I have proven my abilities before your eyes, so you shouldn't doubt me anymore, right?"
Zhang Lingxue's words made most of the audience feel embarrassed, but they no longer doubted her alchemy skills, even though they had only witnessed her performance once.

"Welcome to our Sky Jade Shop! Today is the opening day of our shop, and I purposely did alchemy here to attract your attention." Zhang Lingxue immediately tidied up her furnace and the remaining herbs before standing up, and the Chu Sisters followed her. "From the name of our shop, all of you should already know that the Sky Jade Restaurant is ours, and many of you have often enjoyed the dishes at our restaurant. Our shop not only sells pills and other alchemy necessities, but we also sell various types of items that you have never seen before, and we are sure that you will be interested in them."

The audience was surprised to hear that the Sky Jade Restaurant was theirs, but they should have guessed from the beginning, especially since the names of the two were similar. Moreover, many of them enjoyed the dishes at their restaurant very much, and some of them even visited it every day, which made them eager to see the items in their shop.

"Since our shop is not very big, I hope that all of you can enter in turns so that you can move freely to choose the items that interest you." After she said that, Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters hurriedly entered their shop.

Yang Caojing ordered the guards to arrange for the people to enter the shop in an orderly manner, but he raised his eyebrows when he saw Li Yiping walking towards them, and the people immediately made way for her. Zhang Fei [1] told the minister not to stop her, especially since he was sure that she would not dare to act openly, and he also needed her. 'What is that kid planning to do to her?'

Li Yiping simply smiled at Yang Caojing before entering the shop, with several customers neatly following behind her. When they arrived inside, they were shocked by the presence of mattresses, winter coats, and various items from Earth.

Li Yiping approached the pile of mattresses first, and she was immediately attracted after she tried to feel their flexibility and softness. Not only her but the customers were also attracted by the mattresses, especially since they were too soft compared to their beds, which were made of wood and stone.

That was why Zhang Fei [1] had deliberately asked Huang Rong to prepare them in large quantities, especially since they were the main attraction for his two shops in the Sky Jade Realm, and he was sure that the people in the Nine Stars Realm were not much different from those in that realm.

Zhang Lingxue and the others promptly provided the customers with information about the mattresses and other items. Without thinking twice, they decided to buy the mattresses, even though the price per piece was very expensive, up to several hundred gold coins. They also bought other items they had never seen before, such as winter coats, perfume, and several others.

Once she had selected her items from the earth, Li Yiping immediately moved to one side of the shop. However, her expression changed when she noticed the various sex tools on display, including dildos, BDSM tools, full-body silicone, and other items. What caught her attention most was the double-headed vibrator, especially since its size was much larger than the average male dicks, so she immediately took it to feel its flexibility. 'Where did they get all these items? Did they buy them from other realms?'
"Do you like this vibrator, my lady?" Li Yiping immediately turned to Zhang Fei [1] before nodding to him. "Do you want me to explain how to use it?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] immediately explained to Li Yiping in detail, and he also explained the function of every other item, causing her expression to turn slightly embarrassed. "In that case, I will purchase one of each item, as well as some other items."

"Sure." Zhang Fei [1] immediately called one of his female subordinates to take care of everything, and he asked Li Yiping to follow her. 'This woman is quite interesting, but I'm not interested in a whore like her.'

Li Yiping repeatedly glanced at Zhang Fei [1], but she frowned as he ignored her and approached other buyers instead. 'Tch! Am I not attractive to him? If I succeed in seducing him, I can use him to carry out a secret mission against Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang.'
After paying for all the previous items, Li Yiping went to the alchemy section and purchased some available pills, particularly the basic ones and those to enhance his cultivation.
The other buyers were not much different from Li Yiping; many of them were interested in those sex tools and pills, and they bought quite a lot of items from the shop.

After they all left, the customers who were still queuing outside began to take turns entering the shop, making the shop's sales higher than Zhang Fei's [1] original estimates. Fortunately, he had prepared a large stock, and Zhang Lingxue had concocted quite a few pills in the past few weeks, so they had no trouble meeting the buyers' demands.
Since the situation in his shop was conducive, Zhang Fei [1] immediately left his shop and hurriedly followed Li Yiping.
"Why are you smiling to yourself?" Feng Yao accessed Zhang Fei.

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly in response. "The opening of my shop went smoothly, especially after Lingxue performed the live alchemy show. The number of customers was much greater than in my two shops in the Sky Jade Realm, so I was able to earn a lot of money from them. By the way, do you know about the ten heavenly flames?"

"Oh?" Zhang Fei's question momentarily took Feng Yao aback. "How do you know about them? In fact, my phoenix fire is one of the ten heavenly flames, especially since my fire has a special attribute that can purify many things."

"I know that your phoenix fire is one of them." Zhang Fei then told Feng Yao about the Immortal Yin-Yang Fire, and he told her that he needed the ten heavenly flames to perfect the technique. "Can you give me your fire?"

Feng Yao nodded to Zhang Fei, opened her palm, and a ball of phoenix fire appeared above her palm. "This fire contains a little of my phoenix essence, so you can absorb it, and it might work for you."
Zhang Fei used the technique first, surprising Feng Yao as black and white flames appeared on both sides of his body. "Yin Yang Fire, huh? I didn't expect you to obtain such an amazing technique."
"Actually, there are many good techniques in there, but I think this technique suits me the most." Zhang Fei immediately extended his palm forward, directly absorbing Feng Yao's phoenix fire.
[Ding]
[The host obtained the phoenix fire. Fire count: 1]
[The host fire strength has increased by 100%.]
"Phew." Zhang Fei let out a sigh of relief after the notification appeared, and he immediately canceled his technique. "Do you know the location of the other nine heavenly flames?"

"You can ask Long Tian or Long Chen about the dragon flame." After giving it some thought, Feng Yao decided to share the information with Zhang Fei. "If my memory serves me correctly, you can find the Soul Fire in the Nine Hells Darkland Realm. However, the area of fire is surrounded by numerous bloodthirsty and vengeful souls of living beings. Therefore, you must exercise extreme caution when entering the area, as they have the potential to possess and control you."

"The Nine Hells Darkland Realm, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered under his breath. "Morgana told me about the realm four months ago, especially the fiendish pond. In that case, I will go to that realm to see both of them, but I won't be going there anytime soon, and I will probably go there after my cultivation reaches the Quasi-Divine Realm."

"I think that's the best choice for you." Feng Yao then told Zhang Fei about some other fires. "I don't know the location of the blood fire, but you can find the Earth and Sky Flames in the upper realms. I've also read about the Sun Flame, the Moon Fire, the Chaotic Flame, and the Eternal Flame. Unfortunately, they don't exist in the upper realms, and they might be in the realms beyond."

"Those places, huh?" Zhang Fei mumbled and nodded in understanding. "In that case, I won't think about them for now, and my next target is the Soul Fire.
