Zhang Fei ignored the notification and looked at the man inside his science capsule. "How was the result of the examination, Mei?"

[Master, you should wake Gu Jinglin up immediately, especially considering that this man is being controlled by a Gu Insect. According to the system, it is a Soul Marionette Gu, and I cannot separate it from his body.]

"Gu insect, huh?" Zhang Fei himself had long wanted to learn the Gu Creation Technique that he had obtained from Gu Jinglin, but he could not learn it without the Gu Heart. Moreover, the process of creating the Gu Heart required significant sacrifice and took several years, leading him to postpone it.

Zhang Fei then went to Gu Jinglin's room and removed the effects of the dream imprisonment from her before waking her up. Soon, the old woman opened her eyes and let out a soft sigh, especially since her mind was always a mess whenever she locked up her subconscious for too long.

"Follow me." Gu Jinglin immediately followed Zhang Fei, but she looked confused when she saw the man inside the capsule. "There is a Gu inside this man's body, which is the Soul Marionette Gu. That's why I woke you up."

Gu Jinglin nodded to Zhang Fei. "The Soul Marionette Gu is indeed stronger than my Heart-Controlling Gu, and its level is several levels higher. It resides in the soul of the person it possesses, and it controls the person from the soul directly."
"Can you get that out of his soul?" asked Zhang Fei.

"Master, I am only a low-level soul cultivator, and this Gu is not under my control, so I cannot remove it directly." Zhang Fei frowned at that, but Gu Jinglin hurriedly continued. "I can lure the Gu Insect to leave this man's soul using my immortal Gu, but you must first pull his soul out of his body."

After Zhang Fei opened the capsule cover, he immediately touched the man's chest and used his soul manipulation ability to pull his soul out. They could see a black Gu insect nestling inside the man's soul, which was quite large compared to other Gu insects, almost the size of a baby's fist.
Zhang Fei looked at Gu Jinglin, who immediately summoned the immortal Gu from within her body before ordering it to enter the man's soul.
In that instant, the Soul Marionette Gu tried to devour it to show its superiority, but Gu Jinglin quickly pulled her immortal Gu back, and it immediately followed her Gu, leaving the man's soul.

Zhang Fei took immediate action by suppressing the Soul Marionette Gu with his heavenly fox aura, causing it to fall to the floor. However, he did not kill it and locked it in a glass bottle, but it tried to break it while making strange sounds inside. "Can you control this Gu?"

"No." Gu Jinglin responded with a shake of her head. "I'm not sure who the user is, but I believe that person is a member of the Gu Masters, who visited my ancestor in the past. That person's Gu ability is higher than mine, and this Gu is beyond my ability, so I can't control it."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and immediately returned the man's soul to his body. However, he did not wake him up immediately as they were still in his Yin-Yang Space, and he did not want strangers to know about it.
"Are you planning to lock my subconscious again, Master?" Gu Jinglin inquired.

"I can suppress this Soul Marionette Gu with my beast aura, but I still can't control it. Since the only way to control a Gu is by becoming a Gu Master, I want to become one, so I want you to create a Gu heart." Zhang Fei then gave some pills and his Yang Qi to Gu Jinglin. "Your current strength won't allow you to survive in my realm, so improve yourself, and I'll take you there when you're ready."
"Yes, Master." Gu Jinglin went straight back to his room to use the items.
After Zhang Fei put the science capsule into the system inventory, he immediately brought the man out of his Yin-Yang Space, intending to take him somewhere else before waking him up.
When he arrived, Zhang Fei found that all the seniors had already woken up, such as Zhang Chen, Zhang Hanzhi, Ming Han, Qing Tan, Wang Zetian, and Dou Luotian.
People from the Ye, Liu, Zhang, and Chang Clans also prepared for their activities. However, they did not stay at the residence, and they went to train in the forest not far away.

Chang Wenjie, Lian Xiang, Zhu Hongtao, Qin Zheng, Zhu Qianzhi, Hai Dongyin, and Hai Dongxin continue to concentrate on their training in Zhang Fei's training space, particularly because they have yet to adjust to the level 1 gravity feature.

Even though he brought Chang Wuhen and Chang Wentian to the Nine Stars Realm, Zhang Fei still had no intention of bringing them to train in his training space. As for Cheng Wenjie, he did allow her to train there, but he forbade her from telling her family about it, which she had agreed to.

Not long after they left, the disciples of the Yin-Yang Pavilion and the Heavenly Sword Sect also woke up from their sleep. They hurriedly went to a different forest with the seniors, including Mu Lingshu, Lin Dong'er, and Yue Qingya, especially since their cultivation was still far below theirs.
"Fei!" Zhang Fei immediately turned to Xian Xianqin, who was walking towards him with Zhou Meiling following behind her. "Are we going into seclusion starting today?"

"Not yet." Zhang Fei then pulled Xian Xianqin into his embrace and kissed her for a few minutes, causing Zhou Meiling to frown. "Our new shop has only been open for a day, so Lingxue, Ying'er, and Qing'er have to manage it for the time being. Hua'er and the Wen Twins are also still taking care of the people from my demon fox group, so we will enter seclusion in a few days. Anyway, I want to go to the Sky Jade Realm, especially since I haven't visited Hu Yue for two weeks, and I'll take you there to have a look."

Although she had been to several other realms with her parents, Xian Xianqin had never been to the lower realms, and she was also curious about Zhang Fei's origin realm, so she immediately agreed to it. "Before we go to the Sky Jade Realm, I want to return to the capital first, and I will inform my parents about our seclusion plan. Moreover, I haven't seen Yao Yin for a long time, so I want to meet him before we enter seclusion."

"I also have some business in the capital, so I will take you there after Lingxue and the others wake up." After that, Zhang Fei brought the man from the Bai Kingdom back to the Star Tower, but he immediately returned to his residence after waking him up, and he accompanied Xian Xianqin while waiting for the others to wake up.
Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying lay exhausted on either side of Zhang Fei [1], but they were completely satisfied after dual cultivating with him for several hours in turns.
"What exactly is your purpose in approaching us?" Gu Hanshuang asked him.
Dan Qingying also asked. "What exactly did Prince Lian snatch from you?"

Zhang Fei [1] raised Dan Qingying's right hand. "My wife wanted this azure dragon bracelet, but Huangfu Lian snatched it from me when I wanted to buy it. Since you guys are his women, I immediately planned to snatch you two from him."
Zhang Fei [1]'s answer stunned Dan Qingying. "Do you want to take this bracelet from me? Prince Lian will be angry if I don't wear it, and he will do something bad to me."

"If I wanted to take it from you, I could have done it since we first dual cultivated, remember?" Dan Qingying nodded to Zhang Fei [1]. "Although I don't know Huangfu Lian personally, I have met him and his three siblings at the Star Tower, so I know more or less their characters. Moreover, he is targeting me, and I am sure that he will come after me soon, so I immediately went to see you two before he came here."
"Does that mean you just want to use us to do something to Prince Lian?" Gu Hanshuang inquired in a disappointed tone.

Zhang Fei [1] denied it with a shake of his head. "If I wanted to use you two, I wouldn't have told you guys about this matter, right? Furthermore, neither of you are capable of defeating Huangfu Lian, and using you to battle him will only result in your futile deaths."

Both women were relieved upon hearing that, but Gu Hanshuang questioned him once more. "Did you really challenge the Star Tower before? How far did you make it through the challenges on the first floor? How did Prince Lian and his three siblings fare?"
"Huangfu Lian and the others were eliminated from the Maze Challenge, so they should have returned a week ago, but I don't understand why he hasn't come to you two yet."

Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying exchanged confused glances because they were sure that Huangfu Lian would immediately look for them as soon as he returned to his kingdom, but then they remembered his other women, annoying them.

"I managed to pass the first floor with the help of the disciples of the Xian Imperial Sect, but I can't go to the second floor yet." Both women were surprised to hear that Zhang Fei [1] had successfully passed the challenges with his cultivation still in the Earth Realm. "I have important matters to attend to, so I'll leave you two alone now, and I'll see you later."
Before he left, Zhang Fei [1] immediately cleaned the traces of his yang qi from the two women's bodies, and he left them directly after he got dressed.

'Anyway, you two are my partners now, so I don't want you to do it with Huangfu Lian anymore.' Zhang Fei [1]'s voice in their minds left both women feeling confused about their situation. "What should we do now, Hanshuang? Are we really going to avoid Prince Lian from now on? If we do that, he will definitely kill us."

"Even if he didn't ask us that, I no longer feel comfortable having a relationship with Prince Lian, especially after we have dual-cultivated with him twice." Dan Qingying agreed with Gu Hanshuang. "We can't get away from Prince Lian, but we can do something to stop him from touching us, and I'm sure he won't notice our actions."
"Oh! That's right! We can use that!" Dan Qingying said with a slight scream. "Sigh! It's early morning, but I still feel tired."
"Let's go." Gu Hanshuang got out of bed. "Ning Wu will be suspicious if we're still sleeping, so we should get ready before joining her and Ting Ting."
After all his women woke up and got ready, Zhang Fei first sent Zhou Meiling into his Yin-Yang Space. He then took Liu Hua, Zhang Lingxue, the Chu Sisters, and Xian Xianqin to the Xian Capital.
Upon arrival, Liu Hua rushed to meet the Wen Twins at the Sky Jade Restaurant. On the other hand, Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters went to the Sky Jade Shop to prepare to open their shop.

Zhang Fei then took the Xian princess to the Xian royal palace, but Yang Caojing informed the princess that her parents were receiving important guests. Xian Xianqin then led him to a garden in another area, where Xian Xianwu was chatting with Yao Yin alone.
Yao Yin looked surprised when she saw them, especially since Xian Xianqin hugged Zhang Fei's arm intimately, and she also looked more cheerful than usual.

"Congratulations on your breakthrough, Yao Yin." Xian Xianqin immediately said as soon as they arrived in front of them. "My brother told me that you two were getting married in two weeks, and I'm relieved that you finally decided to be his wife, or else he would have waited for you until he was old."
"Hehe." Yao Yin chuckled at that. "What about you? When will you marry him?"

Yao Yin's question made Xian Xianqin blush. "Unlike you and my brother, Zhang Fei and I have only known each other for a month, so I haven't thought about marrying him. Even so, I admit that I have already fallen in love with him, and I will marry him once our relationship is truly deep."
'This girl! She never wanted to openly admit her feelings to me, but she dared to confess them to her future sister-in-law.' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered.

"I didn't expect you to fall in love with him in a month, but I'm glad that you've finally moved on from your feelings for Big Brother Aoxian." They then sat in front of each other, and Xian Xianqin told Yao Yin about her process of falling in love with Zhang Fei, particularly the incident in the basement bedroom. "Even though your relationship is still in its early stages, I want to congratulate you both, and I hope you guys will truly get married in the future."

"That's for sure." Zhang Fei answered Yao Yin as he held Xian Xianqin's hand. "Even though Qin'er is not yet willing to be my wife, I already regard her as one, and I will marry her once she is fully ready."

The blush on Xian Xianqin's cheeks grew brighter, causing Yao Yin to smile in amusement. "Zhang Fei, Xianqin and I have known each other since we were little, and she is a good woman, so I hope you will always treat her well."
"I will definitely treat Qin'er well." Zhang Fei replied with a nod.

Xian Xianqin then told them something else. "Brother! Yao Yin! Zhang Fei and I will enter seclusion soon, but we will definitely attend your wedding. Since our parents are still receiving guests, you two can inform them of this matter, and I will also leave a voice message for them."
"All right, I will tell our parents later."
After they talked about some other things, Zhang Fei immediately took Xian Xianqin to Gang Zhishou's shop, but they couldn't find her there because she had gone to another city.
A while later, they arrived at Sky Jade Realm, but Zhang Fei first took Xian Xianqin to the fallen moon cave to check on Zhang Yue's situation.
However, the cave was sealed by thick ice, and Feng Jinqiu, who noticed their presence, immediately told Zhang Fei that Zhang Yue was still concentrating on her training and could not be disturbed.
Zhang Fei then took Xian Xianqin away to the portal to the moon fox's sub-realm, and he contacted Hu Yue through the harem link, asking her to send Hu Qiaomu to meet them.
"Is the entrance to their sub-realm located at this location?"
Zhang Fei nodded before telling her. "Actually, I have the key to enter it myself, but Hu Gao would notice my arrival if I did that, so I asked Yue'er to send someone to pick us up."

"I see." Xian Xianqian then looked around them and tried to feel the Qi in that realm. "The quality and quantity of Qi in this realm is not even a quarter of the Qi in the Nine Stars Realm, so I am not surprised if the highest cultivation here is only at the Sovereign Realm."

"You're right." Zhang Fei answered with a soft sigh. "That's why I rushed to bring them to our realm, even though they weren't fully prepared to face the situation there. If we continued to stay here, it would definitely take me several years to reach the heaven realm, and Yue 'er will have to wait longer for me to be able to save her."
Xian Xian immediately asked him. "Do you need my help? Since Hu Gao's cultivation is only at the Sovereign Realm, it's too easy for me to defeat him, and you can take Hu Yue with us afterward."

"Master, I am only a low-level soul cultivator, and this Gu is not under my control, so I cannot remove it directly." Zhang Fei frowned at that, but Gu Jinglin hurriedly continued.
"I can lure the Gu Insect to leave this man's soul using my immortal Gu, but you must first pull his soul out of his body."
After Zhang Fei opened the capsule cover, he immediately touched the man's chest and used his soul manipulation ability to pull his soul out.
They could see a black Gu insect nestling inside the man's soul, which was quite large compared to other Gu insects, almost the size of a baby's fist.
Zhang Fei looked at Gu Jinglin, who immediately summoned the immortal Gu from within her body before ordering it to enter the man's soul.
In that instant, the Soul Marionette Gu tried to devour it to show its superiority, but Gu Jinglin quickly pulled her immortal Gu back, and it immediately followed her Gu, leaving the man's soul.
Zhang Fei took immediate action by suppressing the Soul Marionette Gu with his heavenly fox aura, causing it to fall to the floor.
However, he did not kill it and locked it in a glass bottle, but it tried to break it while making strange sounds inside.
"Can you control this Gu?"
"No." Gu Jinglin responded with a shake of her head.
"I'm not sure who the user is, but I believe that person is a member of the Gu Masters, who visited my ancestor in the past.
That person's Gu ability is higher than mine, and this Gu is beyond my ability, so I can't control it."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and immediately returned the man's soul to his body.
However, he did not wake him up immediately as they were still in his Yin-Yang Space, and he did not want strangers to know about it.
"Are you planning to lock my subconscious again, Master?" Gu Jinglin inquired.
"I can suppress this Soul Marionette Gu with my beast aura, but I still can't control it.
Since the only way to control a Gu is by becoming a Gu Master, I want to become one, so I want you to create a Gu heart." Zhang Fei then gave some pills and his Yang Qi to Gu Jinglin.
"Your current strength won't allow you to survive in my realm, so improve yourself, and I'll take you there when you're ready."
"Yes, Master." Gu Jinglin went straight back to his room to use the items.
After Zhang Fei put the science capsule into the system inventory, he immediately brought the man out of his Yin-Yang Space, intending to take him somewhere else before waking him up.
When he arrived, Zhang Fei found that all the seniors had already woken up, such as Zhang Chen, Zhang Hanzhi, Ming Han, Qing Tan, Wang Zetian, and Dou Luotian.
People from the Ye, Liu, Zhang, and Chang Clans also prepared for their activities.
However, they did not stay at the residence, and they went to train in the forest not far away.

Chang Wenjie, Lian Xiang, Zhu Hongtao, Qin Zheng, Zhu Qianzhi, Hai Dongyin, and Hai Dongxin continue to concentrate on their training in Zhang Fei's training space, particularly because they have yet to adjust to the level 1 gravity feature.
Even though he brought Chang Wuhen and Chang Wentian to the Nine Stars Realm, Zhang Fei still had no intention of bringing them to train in his training space.
As for Cheng Wenjie, he did allow her to train there, but he forbade her from telling her family about it, which she had agreed to.
Not long after they left, the disciples of the Yin-Yang Pavilion and the Heavenly Sword Sect also woke up from their sleep.
They hurriedly went to a different forest with the seniors, including Mu Lingshu, Lin Dong'er, and Yue Qingya, especially since their cultivation was still far below theirs.
"Fei!" Zhang Fei immediately turned to Xian Xianqin, who was walking towards him with Zhou Meiling following behind her.
"Are we going into seclusion starting today?"
"Not yet." Zhang Fei then pulled Xian Xianqin into his embrace and kissed her for a few minutes, causing Zhou Meiling to frown.
"Our new shop has only been open for a day, so Lingxue, Ying'er, and Qing'er have to manage it for the time being.
Hua'er and the Wen Twins are also still taking care of the people from my demon fox group, so we will enter seclusion in a few days.
Anyway, I want to go to the Sky Jade Realm, especially since I haven't visited Hu Yue for two weeks, and I'll take you there to have a look."

Although she had been to several other realms with her parents, Xian Xianqin had never been to the lower realms, and she was also curious about Zhang Fei's origin realm, so she immediately agreed to it.
"Before we go to the Sky Jade Realm, I want to return to the capital first, and I will inform my parents about our seclusion plan.
Moreover, I haven't seen Yao Yin for a long time, so I want to meet him before we enter seclusion."

"I also have some business in the capital, so I will take you there after Lingxue and the others wake up." After that, Zhang Fei brought the man from the Bai Kingdom back to the Star Tower, but he immediately returned to his residence after waking him up, and he accompanied Xian Xianqin while waiting for the others to wake up.
Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying lay exhausted on either side of Zhang Fei [1], but they were completely satisfied after dual cultivating with him for several hours in turns.
"What exactly is your purpose in approaching us?" Gu Hanshuang asked him.
Dan Qingying also asked.
"What exactly did Prince Lian snatch from you?"
Zhang Fei [1] raised Dan Qingying's right hand.
"My wife wanted this azure dragon bracelet, but Huangfu Lian snatched it from me when I wanted to buy it.
Since you guys are his women, I immediately planned to snatch you two from him."
Zhang Fei [1]'s answer stunned Dan Qingying.
"Do you want to take this bracelet from me?
Prince Lian will be angry if I don't wear it, and he will do something bad to me."
"If I wanted to take it from you, I could have done it since we first dual cultivated, remember?" Dan Qingying nodded to Zhang Fei [1].
"Although I don't know Huangfu Lian personally, I have met him and his three siblings at the Star Tower, so I know more or less their characters.
Moreover, he is targeting me, and I am sure that he will come after me soon, so I immediately went to see you two before he came here."
"Does that mean you just want to use us to do something to Prince Lian?" Gu Hanshuang inquired in a disappointed tone.
Zhang Fei [1] denied it with a shake of his head.
"If I wanted to use you two, I wouldn't have told you guys about this matter, right?
Furthermore, neither of you are capable of defeating Huangfu Lian, and using you to battle him will only result in your futile deaths."
Both women were relieved upon hearing that, but Gu Hanshuang questioned him once more.
"Did you really challenge the Star Tower before?
How far did you make it through the challenges on the first floor?
How did Prince Lian and his three siblings fare?"
"Huangfu Lian and the others were eliminated from the Maze Challenge, so they should have returned a week ago, but I don't understand why he hasn't come to you two yet."

Gu Hanshuang and Dan Qingying exchanged confused glances because they were sure that Huangfu Lian would immediately look for them as soon as he returned to his kingdom, but then they remembered his other women, annoying them.

"I managed to pass the first floor with the help of the disciples of the Xian Imperial Sect, but I can't go to the second floor yet." Both women were surprised to hear that Zhang Fei [1] had successfully passed the challenges with his cultivation still in the Earth Realm.
"I have important matters to attend to, so I'll leave you two alone now, and I'll see you later."
Before he left, Zhang Fei [1] immediately cleaned the traces of his yang qi from the two women's bodies, and he left them directly after he got dressed.
'Anyway, you two are my partners now, so I don't want you to do it with Huangfu Lian anymore.' Zhang Fei [1]'s voice in their minds left both women feeling confused about their situation.
"What should we do now, Hanshuang?
Are we really going to avoid Prince Lian from now on?
If we do that, he will definitely kill us."
"Even if he didn't ask us that, I no longer feel comfortable having a relationship with Prince Lian, especially after we have dual-cultivated with him twice." Dan Qingying agreed with Gu Hanshuang.
"We can't get away from Prince Lian, but we can do something to stop him from touching us, and I'm sure he won't notice our actions."
"Oh!
That's right!
We can use that!" Dan Qingying said with a slight scream.
"Sigh!
It's early morning, but I still feel tired."
"Let's go." Gu Hanshuang got out of bed.
"Ning Wu will be suspicious if we're still sleeping, so we should get ready before joining her and Ting Ting."
After all his women woke up and got ready, Zhang Fei first sent Zhou Meiling into his Yin-Yang Space.
He then took Liu Hua, Zhang Lingxue, the Chu Sisters, and Xian Xianqin to the Xian Capital.
Upon arrival, Liu Hua rushed to meet the Wen Twins at the Sky Jade Restaurant.
On the other hand, Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters went to the Sky Jade Shop to prepare to open their shop.
Zhang Fei then took the Xian princess to the Xian royal palace, but Yang Caojing informed the princess that her parents were receiving important guests.
Xian Xianqin then led him to a garden in another area, where Xian Xianwu was chatting with Yao Yin alone.
Yao Yin looked surprised when she saw them, especially since Xian Xianqin hugged Zhang Fei's arm intimately, and she also looked more cheerful than usual.
"Congratulations on your breakthrough, Yao Yin." Xian Xianqin immediately said as soon as they arrived in front of them.
"My brother told me that you two were getting married in two weeks, and I'm relieved that you finally decided to be his wife, or else he would have waited for you until he was old."
"Hehe." Yao Yin chuckled at that.
"What about you?
When will you marry him?"
Yao Yin's question made Xian Xianqin blush.
"Unlike you and my brother, Zhang Fei and I have only known each other for a month, so I haven't thought about marrying him.
Even so, I admit that I have already fallen in love with him, and I will marry him once our relationship is truly deep."
'This girl!
She never wanted to openly admit her feelings to me, but she dared to confess them to her future sister-in-law.' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered.

"I didn't expect you to fall in love with him in a month, but I'm glad that you've finally moved on from your feelings for Big Brother Aoxian." They then sat in front of each other, and Xian Xianqin told Yao Yin about her process of falling in love with Zhang Fei, particularly the incident in the basement bedroom.
"Even though your relationship is still in its early stages, I want to congratulate you both, and I hope you guys will truly get married in the future."
"That's for sure." Zhang Fei answered Yao Yin as he held Xian Xianqin's hand.
"Even though Qin'er is not yet willing to be my wife, I already regard her as one, and I will marry her once she is fully ready."
The blush on Xian Xianqin's cheeks grew brighter, causing Yao Yin to smile in amusement.
"Zhang Fei, Xianqin and I have known each other since we were little, and she is a good woman, so I hope you will always treat her well."
"I will definitely treat Qin'er well." Zhang Fei replied with a nod.
Xian Xianqin then told them something else.
"Brother!
Yao Yin!
Zhang Fei and I will enter seclusion soon, but we will definitely attend your wedding.
Since our parents are still receiving guests, you two can inform them of this matter, and I will also leave a voice message for them."
"All right, I will tell our parents later."
After they talked about some other things, Zhang Fei immediately took Xian Xianqin to Gang Zhishou's shop, but they couldn't find her there because she had gone to another city.
A while later, they arrived at Sky Jade Realm, but Zhang Fei first took Xian Xianqin to the fallen moon cave to check on Zhang Yue's situation.
However, the cave was sealed by thick ice, and Feng Jinqiu, who noticed their presence, immediately told Zhang Fei that Zhang Yue was still concentrating on her training and could not be disturbed.
Zhang Fei then took Xian Xianqin away to the portal to the moon fox's sub-realm, and he contacted Hu Yue through the harem link, asking her to send Hu Qiaomu to meet them.
"Is the entrance to their sub-realm located at this location?"
Zhang Fei nodded before telling her.
"Actually, I have the key to enter it myself, but Hu Gao would notice my arrival if I did that, so I asked Yue'er to send someone to pick us up."
"I see." Xian Xianqian then looked around them and tried to feel the Qi in that realm.
"The quality and quantity of Qi in this realm is not even a quarter of the Qi in the Nine Stars Realm, so I am not surprised if the highest cultivation here is only at the Sovereign Realm."
"You're right." Zhang Fei answered with a soft sigh.
"That's why I rushed to bring them to our realm, even though they weren't fully prepared to face the situation there.
If we continued to stay here, it would definitely take me several years to reach the heaven realm, and Yue 'er will have to wait longer for me to be able to save her."
Xian Xian immediately asked him.
"Do you need my help?
Since Hu Gao's cultivation is only at the Sovereign Realm, it's too easy for me to defeat him, and you can take Hu Yue with us afterward."

chapters.title: Chapter 614 Meet The Moon Foxes
paragraphs: Before he answered Xian Xianqin, the portal to the moon fox's sub-realm had already opened. The cultivation of the Xian Princess immediately shocked Hu Qiaomu, who had just walked out from inside. She turned to Zhang Fei and thought that he would attack her race today, which worried her.
"Let's go in; we'll talk in Yue'er's cave."

A while later, they were already inside Hua Yue's cultivation cave, and Zhang Fei immediately pulled the female fox into his embrace, giving her a deep, passionate kiss without caring about the presence of the other three women.

Hu Yue herself had missed Zhang Fei for so long, so she didn't think about the presence of the three women and returned his kiss directly. She even took the initiative to remove his upper clothes, leaving the three women speechless.

Unhesitatingly, Zhang Fei pushed the female fox backward until she was leaning against the wall. He then held her hands above her head using one hand, and his other hand moved quickly to pull off the pink cloth around her waist before dropping her dress to the ground, leaving Hu Yue completely naked.

'Is she a sultry female fox? Why doesn't she feel the least bit embarrassed by our presence?' Xian Xianqin, already seated on the stone chair, pondered inwardly. However, her eyes showed admiration for the beauty of the female fox, giving her the feeling that she was the best woman among all Zhang Fei's women.

Hu Qiaomu also thought that Zhang Fei was too crazy to do intimate things in front of them, but she was curious about his prowess in sex, especially since he had numerous women by his side. Moreover, she couldn't leave Hu Yue's cave without his order, so she sat leisurely by the side while watching them.

Hu Lili was not surprised by her daughter's behavior, especially since Hu Yue missed Zhang Fei too much, and she had been holding herself back for too long. Furthermore, every few months, members of their race experience extreme arousal, and her daughter's turn has come.

Hu Lili then turned to Xian Xianqin with raised eyebrows because she could not detect her cultivation, convincing her that the Xian Princess was far stronger than her and all the members of her race. 'Miss, can you tell me your cultivation level?'

'My cultivation is at the quasi-divine realm.' Xian Xianqin answered as she turned to Hu Lili, who was shocked by her answer. 'Actually, I've already reached the final barrier, but I still need a little push to break through it, and my cultivation will reach the seven divine realms after that.'
Hu Lili took a deep breath to get rid of her shock. 'Did Zhang Fei bring you here on purpose to help him save my daughter?'

'I don't know yet.' Xian Xianqin immediately returned her gaze to the couple. 'I don't know much about his fox race, but his fox bloodline seems to shape his arrogant nature, and he still seems to insist on saving your daughter with his own strength.'

Unlike Xian Xianqin, Hu Lili had a lot of knowledge about the ten-tailed fox, and Zefyr added to her knowledge by telling her about the fox based on stories circulating in the natural races. 'The heavenly fox race is the strongest and stands above all fox races, but he is different from the other heavenly foxes, and he will be able to reach a higher level after he evolves to the ten tails.'

'Isn't the fox race only capable of reaching the nine tails?' Xian Xianqin asked in confusion. 'In my realm, there are some stories about the nine-tailed fox, but I have never heard of the ten-tailed fox.'

'You are wrong about that.' Hu Lili responded, glancing at Zhang Fei, who was still kissing her daughter. 'Since you are a human, I understand your lack of knowledge about the ten-tailed fox, but I'm sure that the beasts or natural races in your realm are familiar with him. Only one ten-tailed fox was ever born in this universe, and the heavenly foxes were his descendants after he split into their current two ancestors. As for this kid, he is indeed a heavenly fox now, but he has inherited a small remnant soul from the ten-tailed fox, and it is written that he will become the next ten-tailed fox.'

'A writing?' Hu Lili promptly informed Xian Xianqin about the ten-tailed fox's writing, particularly its reference to Zhang Fei's three identities as a human, a beast, and a demon. The Xian Princess was completely shocked after hearing all that, and she began to understand the origin of his strength. 'No wonder he is so extraordinary, even though he is still young, and he could even defeat a cultivator with cultivation at 1-Moon Divine Transcend before. If it weren't for him, I would have failed the previous challenges, and our team wouldn't have made it through them.'

'This kid's progress has gone that far, huh?' Hu Lili mumbled to herself as she looked admiringly at Zhang Fei. 'Since he could defeat such a strong cultivator with his current strength, I think he should be able to defeat Hu Gao by now. He's probably already thinking about taking my daughter away today, but we have to wait for him to finish with her first.'
'Yeah.' Xian Xianqin gave Hu Lili a nod of approval.

The couple had stopped kissing, but Hu Yue immediately knelt on the floor as she lowered Zhang Fei's trousers, causing the other three women's faces to turn red as his erect dick was exposed before their eyes.
Unlike Hu Qiaomu, who swallowed her saliva at the sight of Zhang Fei's dick, Hu Lili and Xian Xianqin immediately closed their eyes.

Zhang Fei did not stop Hu Yue as he missed her so much, and he wanted to repeat their intimate relationship, which they had first had more than seven months ago. Moreover, he already considered Xian Xianqin and Hu Lili as his women, and Hu Qiaomu could be considered his servant, so he didn't care if she watched them.

"Ugh." Hu Yue's soft and warm tongue began to lick Zhang Fei's dick, and her soft fingers began to tickle his testicles, causing him to moan. He gently stroked her head and spoke to her. "Yu'er, I missed you so much these days. I can't wait to take you away with me, and we won't be separated anymore."

Hu Yue immediately stopped her actions and looked up at Zhang Fei with a look full of hope. "Are you going to take me away today? I have always missed you since our separation that day, and I want to stay by your side as soon as possible. Even though you came to see me three times after that, it didn't ease my longing for you, so I sincerely hope you will take me away today."
Zhang Fei did not directly answer Hu Yue's question, and he tenderly looked into her eyes, especially since he wanted to defeat Hu Gao by himself.

Zhang Fei was confident that he could defeat the moon fox leader if he used all his cheats, but his pride as a heavenly fox always prevented him from doing so, and he wanted to defeat Hu Gao without having to rely on his cheats.

"Is your pride more important than my daughter's feelings?" Zhang Fei immediately turned to Hu Lili. "This young miss has already told me that you managed to defeat a cultivator with cultivation at 1-Moon Divine Transcend before, so Hu Gao should no longer be your opponent, right?"

"You have me too, Fei." Xian Xianqin chimed in. "You are the man I chose to be my husband, and Hu Yue will be my sister if I become your wife, so I don't mind helping you take her away from this place."

Hu Qiaomu actually didn't want to interfere with Zhang Fei's decision because she was not his woman, and her status was similar to his servant. "Master, I think you should take Hu Yue away today. Hu Gao hasn't taken any action against her because of Hu Dong's stagnant cultivation in the Heaven Realm, but his patience is running short. Sooner or later, he will force her to wed his son, so you must take her away."

"Yeah, you guys are right." Zhang Fei replied with a heavy sigh before lifting Hu Yue to her feet. "Please forgive me, Yue'er. I was too stupid and selfish to prioritize my pride over your feelings, but I won't delay any longer, and I will take you away from here today. If Hu Gao and the other moon foxes want to stop me, I will soak this land with their blood."
Instantly, tears of joy flowed from Hu Yue's eyes, and she hugged Zhang Fei as she began to sob. "I've waited for this day for so long, and your decision really makes me happy."
Hu Lili breathed a sigh of relief after Zhang Fei said that, and she immediately stood up from her seat. "Shall we fight them now?"
Hu Yue immediately released her hug from Zhang Fei, and the two quickly got dressed, preparing to face Hu Gao and the others.

Given the sheer number of moon foxes, Zhang Fei immediately summoned Boitata from the beast space. Additionally, he brought his clones there, with the exception of Zhang Xiaolong [3], who stayed with Murong Qianying to avoid raising suspicions. At first, he wanted to bring Shen Xueyi because she had already broken through to the sovereign realm some time ago, but he canceled his intention because of her inferior bloodline to the moon fox.
"Haha." Boitata laughed as she hugged Zhang Fei's arm. "Can I eat those foxes, husband? They are divine beasts, and many of them have high cultivation, so I can use them to improve myself."

"You can eat those who get in my way, and you don't need to bother those who have no intention of fighting me." Zhang Fei's answer not only overjoyed Boitata but also brought relief to Hu Lili and Hu Qiaomu, especially since they didn't want him to massacre the members of their race. "Let's go now! Qin'er, suppress your cultivation first, or Hu Gao won't dare to meet us."

As soon as they got out of the cave, Zhang Fei immediately took Hu Yue flying with him, and he released his heavenly fox aura. Boitata, Hu Lili, Hu Qiaomu, and Xian Xianqin flew behind them. His four clones, using the invisibility ability, spread out and flew slightly away from them.
Hu Gao, who was cultivating in his cave, immediately opened his eyes as soon as he felt Zhang Fei's presence. "Hmm? How did that bastard enter this sub-realm? Who helped him do it?"

Hu Gao immediately spread his senses toward Zhang Fei's location, but his expression turned furious when he found him hugging Hu Yue. Hu Lili and Hu Qiaomu's presence intensified his fury until Xian Xianqin abruptly repelled his senses. "Who the fuck is that woman? How did she repel my senses?"

Without wasting any time, Hu Gao left his cave, activated the alarm in the sub-realm, and ordered his followers to follow him. "Tch! I don't care what happens! I will kill that bastard today, even if it means sacrificing many of them."

A while later, the two groups were already facing each other in the air, and Hu Gao was fiercely glaring at Zhang Fei. The other moon foxes did not immediately move and waited for the orders of their leader, who was observing Boitata and Xian Xianqin.

Initially, they were perplexed as to why Hu Gao had activated the alarm, and he had not provided an explanation for why he had summoned all of them. However, the presences of Zhang Fei, Xian Xianqin, and Boitata quickly dispelled their confusion.
However, they were shocked because Hu Lili and Hu Qiaomu sided with the humans, and Zhang Fei hugged Hu Yue so tightly, making them realize that their arrival was for her sake.

Unlike many of them, Hu Peiwu and Hu Dahai had long known of Hu Gao's plan to kill Zhang Fei. He even took them to the western region a few months ago, but Feng Yao stopped them and forced them to retreat that time. 'Is this guy crazy? Why did he come here with his current strength? Did he intend to commit suicide? I am not surprised that Hu Lili sided with him because she is Hu Yue's mother, but I am surprised by Hu Qiaomu's reason for siding with him.'
"Hey, brat! Let go of my daughter-in-law and surrender yourself to me!" Hu Gao suddenly shouted as he released his aura to suppress Zhang Fei and the others.
Xian Xianqin wanted to act, but Zhang Fei immediately stopped her. He then transformed into his half-fox form, and his six tails shocked the moon foxes, including Hu Yue, Hu Lili, and Hu Qiaomu.
"Heh! A mere moon fox like you dares to be arrogant in front of a heavenly fox like me, huh?" Zhang Fei uttered these words with a cold snort, releasing his heavenly fox aura to suppress them.

'A heavenly fox!' Many of them screamed in shock in their hearts as their bloodlines trembled under the pressure of Zhang Fei's aura. Naturally, they know that a heavenly fox is a mythical beast, and they are just divine beasts.

'Damn it!' Hu Gao, Hu Peiwu, and Hu Dahai cursed in their hearts. They immediately released their cultivation at the 3-Star and 2-Star Sovereign Realm to fight back against Zhang Fei's pressure. "Bastard! I will kill you."

However, Zhang Fei's four clones, hiding in an invisible state, immediately released their beast aura. Their actions intensified the pressure on Hu Gao and his subordinates, causing some of them to fall from the sky due to the combined pressure.
'This bastard! How can he suppress us this much?' Hu Gao and his subordinates pondered as they struggled to resist their pressure.

Zhang Fei then kissed Hu Yue in front of their eyes, and the female fox did not hesitate to return his kiss. Even so, they only kissed for a few moments, and he spoke to Hu Gao directly. "Do you think your son is worthy to marry my Yue'er? You forced her to be engaged to your son by planting your mark into her soul, yet she has always been my woman. That's why I came here today to free her from your clutches, and I'll take her away with me."
*Boom*

Hu Gao's aura exploded and strengthened several times, and his subordinates immediately followed suit, using their secret techniques to increase their strength and break free from the pressure of Zhang Fei and his four clones.

"Your bloodline is indeed strong, but we are much stronger than you. Since you came here to commit suicide, you don't need to leave anymore, and our sub-realm will be your grave." Hu Gao immediately ordered his subordinates. "Kill all of them except Hu Yue and Hu Lili!"

Zhang Fei immediately handed Hu Yue over to her mother before teleporting in front of Hu Gao, shocking not only him but also his subordinates. Before the moon fox leader reacted, he had already grabbed his head and taken him away to another area using his nine cloud steps. "Boitata! Kill those who dare to oppose you!"

Boitata instantly transformed back into her dragon-serpent form, and all the fiery eyes spread across her entire body, causing Hu Gao's subordinates, with the exception of Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu, to tremble in fear.

Unfortunately, they underestimated Boitata too much, especially since she had perfectly adapted to the level four gravity feature, like Zhang Fei. In an instant, her tail swept towards them without them being able to avoid it, and all of them were blown far away, causing the moon foxes with cultivation below hers to spit out a mouthful of blood from their mouths.
Boitata did not pursue the other moon foxes, instead focusing on Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu, particularly since they both had the intention of assisting Hu Gao in killing Zhang Fei.
"Shit!" Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu cursed as they shielded themselves from Boitata's massive fireball, which slammed straight into their protection.
*Boom*
- To be continued -

'Isn't the fox race only capable of reaching the nine tails?' Xian Xianqin asked in confusion. 'In my realm, there are some stories about the nine-tailed fox, but I have never heard of the ten-tailed fox.'

'You are wrong about that.' Hu Lili responded, glancing at Zhang Fei, who was still kissing her daughter. 'Since you are a human, I understand your lack of knowledge about the ten-tailed fox, but I'm sure that the beasts or natural races in your realm are familiar with him.
Only one ten-tailed fox was ever born in this universe, and the heavenly foxes were his descendants after he split into their current two ancestors.
As for this kid, he is indeed a heavenly fox now, but he has inherited a small remnant soul from the ten-tailed fox, and it is written that he will become the next ten-tailed fox.'
'A writing?' Hu Lili promptly informed Xian Xianqin about the ten-tailed fox's writing, particularly its reference to Zhang Fei's three identities as a human, a beast, and a demon.

The Xian Princess was completely shocked after hearing all that, and she began to understand the origin of his strength. 'No wonder he is so extraordinary, even though he is still young, and he could even defeat a cultivator with cultivation at 1-Moon Divine Transcend before.
If it weren't for him, I would have failed the previous challenges, and our team wouldn't have made it through them.'

'This kid's progress has gone that far, huh?' Hu Lili mumbled to herself as she looked admiringly at Zhang Fei. 'Since he could defeat such a strong cultivator with his current strength, I think he should be able to defeat Hu Gao by now.
He's probably already thinking about taking my daughter away today, but we have to wait for him to finish with her first.'
'Yeah.' Xian Xianqin gave Hu Lili a nod of approval.

The couple had stopped kissing, but Hu Yue immediately knelt on the floor as she lowered Zhang Fei's trousers, causing the other three women's faces to turn red as his erect dick was exposed before their eyes.
Unlike Hu Qiaomu, who swallowed her saliva at the sight of Zhang Fei's dick, Hu Lili and Xian Xianqin immediately closed their eyes.
Zhang Fei did not stop Hu Yue as he missed her so much, and he wanted to repeat their intimate relationship, which they had first had more than seven months ago.
Moreover, he already considered Xian Xianqin and Hu Lili as his women, and Hu Qiaomu could be considered his servant, so he didn't care if she watched them.
"Ugh." Hu Yue's soft and warm tongue began to lick Zhang Fei's dick, and her soft fingers began to tickle his testicles, causing him to moan.
He gently stroked her head and spoke to her.
"Yu'er, I missed you so much these days.
I can't wait to take you away with me, and we won't be separated anymore."
Hu Yue immediately stopped her actions and looked up at Zhang Fei with a look full of hope.
"Are you going to take me away today?
I have always missed you since our separation that day, and I want to stay by your side as soon as possible.
Even though you came to see me three times after that, it didn't ease my longing for you, so I sincerely hope you will take me away today."
Zhang Fei did not directly answer Hu Yue's question, and he tenderly looked into her eyes, especially since he wanted to defeat Hu Gao by himself.

Zhang Fei was confident that he could defeat the moon fox leader if he used all his cheats, but his pride as a heavenly fox always prevented him from doing so, and he wanted to defeat Hu Gao without having to rely on his cheats.
"Is your pride more important than my daughter's feelings?" Zhang Fei immediately turned to Hu Lili.
"This young miss has already told me that you managed to defeat a cultivator with cultivation at 1-Moon Divine Transcend before, so Hu Gao should no longer be your opponent, right?"
"You have me too, Fei." Xian Xianqin chimed in.
"You are the man I chose to be my husband, and Hu Yue will be my sister if I become your wife, so I don't mind helping you take her away from this place."
Hu Qiaomu actually didn't want to interfere with Zhang Fei's decision because she was not his woman, and her status was similar to his servant.
"Master, I think you should take Hu Yue away today.
Hu Gao hasn't taken any action against her because of Hu Dong's stagnant cultivation in the Heaven Realm, but his patience is running short.
Sooner or later, he will force her to wed his son, so you must take her away."
"Yeah, you guys are right." Zhang Fei replied with a heavy sigh before lifting Hu Yue to her feet.
"Please forgive me, Yue'er.
I was too stupid and selfish to prioritize my pride over your feelings, but I won't delay any longer, and I will take you away from here today.
If Hu Gao and the other moon foxes want to stop me, I will soak this land with their blood."
Instantly, tears of joy flowed from Hu Yue's eyes, and she hugged Zhang Fei as she began to sob.
"I've waited for this day for so long, and your decision really makes me happy."
Hu Lili breathed a sigh of relief after Zhang Fei said that, and she immediately stood up from her seat.
"Shall we fight them now?"
Hu Yue immediately released her hug from Zhang Fei, and the two quickly got dressed, preparing to face Hu Gao and the others.
Given the sheer number of moon foxes, Zhang Fei immediately summoned Boitata from the beast space.
Additionally, he brought his clones there, with the exception of Zhang Xiaolong [3], who stayed with Murong Qianying to avoid raising suspicions.
At first, he wanted to bring Shen Xueyi because she had already broken through to the sovereign realm some time ago, but he canceled his intention because of her inferior bloodline to the moon fox.
"Haha." Boitata laughed as she hugged Zhang Fei's arm.
"Can I eat those foxes, husband?
They are divine beasts, and many of them have high cultivation, so I can use them to improve myself."

"You can eat those who get in my way, and you don't need to bother those who have no intention of fighting me." Zhang Fei's answer not only overjoyed Boitata but also brought relief to Hu Lili and Hu Qiaomu, especially since they didn't want him to massacre the members of their race.
"Let's go now!
Qin'er, suppress your cultivation first, or Hu Gao won't dare to meet us."
As soon as they got out of the cave, Zhang Fei immediately took Hu Yue flying with him, and he released his heavenly fox aura.
Boitata, Hu Lili, Hu Qiaomu, and Xian Xianqin flew behind them.
His four clones, using the invisibility ability, spread out and flew slightly away from them.
Hu Gao, who was cultivating in his cave, immediately opened his eyes as soon as he felt Zhang Fei's presence.
"Hmm?
How did that bastard enter this sub-realm?
Who helped him do it?"
Hu Gao immediately spread his senses toward Zhang Fei's location, but his expression turned furious when he found him hugging Hu Yue.
Hu Lili and Hu Qiaomu's presence intensified his fury until Xian Xianqin abruptly repelled his senses.
"Who the fuck is that woman?
How did she repel my senses?"
Without wasting any time, Hu Gao left his cave, activated the alarm in the sub-realm, and ordered his followers to follow him.
"Tch!
I don't care what happens!
I will kill that bastard today, even if it means sacrificing many of them."
A while later, the two groups were already facing each other in the air, and Hu Gao was fiercely glaring at Zhang Fei.
The other moon foxes did not immediately move and waited for the orders of their leader, who was observing Boitata and Xian Xianqin.
Initially, they were perplexed as to why Hu Gao had activated the alarm, and he had not provided an explanation for why he had summoned all of them.
However, the presences of Zhang Fei, Xian Xianqin, and Boitata quickly dispelled their confusion.
However, they were shocked because Hu Lili and Hu Qiaomu sided with the humans, and Zhang Fei hugged Hu Yue so tightly, making them realize that their arrival was for her sake.
Unlike many of them, Hu Peiwu and Hu Dahai had long known of Hu Gao's plan to kill Zhang Fei.
He even took them to the western region a few months ago, but Feng Yao stopped them and forced them to retreat that time. 'Is this guy crazy?
Why did he come here with his current strength?
Did he intend to commit suicide?
I am not surprised that Hu Lili sided with him because she is Hu Yue's mother, but I am surprised by Hu Qiaomu's reason for siding with him.'
"Hey, brat!
Let go of my daughter-in-law and surrender yourself to me!" Hu Gao suddenly shouted as he released his aura to suppress Zhang Fei and the others.
Xian Xianqin wanted to act, but Zhang Fei immediately stopped her.
He then transformed into his half-fox form, and his six tails shocked the moon foxes, including Hu Yue, Hu Lili, and Hu Qiaomu.
"Heh!
A mere moon fox like you dares to be arrogant in front of a heavenly fox like me, huh?" Zhang Fei uttered these words with a cold snort, releasing his heavenly fox aura to suppress them.
'A heavenly fox!' Many of them screamed in shock in their hearts as their bloodlines trembled under the pressure of Zhang Fei's aura.
Naturally, they know that a heavenly fox is a mythical beast, and they are just divine beasts.
'Damn it!' Hu Gao, Hu Peiwu, and Hu Dahai cursed in their hearts.
They immediately released their cultivation at the 3-Star and 2-Star Sovereign Realm to fight back against Zhang Fei's pressure.
"Bastard!
I will kill you."
However, Zhang Fei's four clones, hiding in an invisible state, immediately released their beast aura.
Their actions intensified the pressure on Hu Gao and his subordinates, causing some of them to fall from the sky due to the combined pressure.
'This bastard!
How can he suppress us this much?' Hu Gao and his subordinates pondered as they struggled to resist their pressure.
Zhang Fei then kissed Hu Yue in front of their eyes, and the female fox did not hesitate to return his kiss.
Even so, they only kissed for a few moments, and he spoke to Hu Gao directly.
"Do you think your son is worthy to marry my Yue'er?
You forced her to be engaged to your son by planting your mark into her soul, yet she has always been my woman.
That's why I came here today to free her from your clutches, and I'll take her away with me."
*Boom*

Hu Gao's aura exploded and strengthened several times, and his subordinates immediately followed suit, using their secret techniques to increase their strength and break free from the pressure of Zhang Fei and his four clones.
"Your bloodline is indeed strong, but we are much stronger than you.
Since you came here to commit suicide, you don't need to leave anymore, and our sub-realm will be your grave." Hu Gao immediately ordered his subordinates.
"Kill all of them except Hu Yue and Hu Lili!"
Zhang Fei immediately handed Hu Yue over to her mother before teleporting in front of Hu Gao, shocking not only him but also his subordinates.
Before the moon fox leader reacted, he had already grabbed his head and taken him away to another area using his nine cloud steps.
"Boitata!
Kill those who dare to oppose you!"

Boitata instantly transformed back into her dragon-serpent form, and all the fiery eyes spread across her entire body, causing Hu Gao's subordinates, with the exception of Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu, to tremble in fear.
Unfortunately, they underestimated Boitata too much, especially since she had perfectly adapted to the level four gravity feature, like Zhang Fei.

In an instant, her tail swept towards them without them being able to avoid it, and all of them were blown far away, causing the moon foxes with cultivation below hers to spit out a mouthful of blood from their mouths.
Boitata did not pursue the other moon foxes, instead focusing on Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu, particularly since they both had the intention of assisting Hu Gao in killing Zhang Fei.
"Shit!" Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu cursed as they shielded themselves from Boitata's massive fireball, which slammed straight into their protection.
*Boom*
- To be continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 615 Killing Hu Gao - Hu Dong
paragraphs: Boitata's tail destroyed Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu's barrier, causing both of them to spurt blood from their mouths. The two of them rushed to escape as soon as the dragon serpent flew towards them with her mouth wide open.
Seeing that Boitata suppressed Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu, Hu Gao's other subordinates moved to save the two from her. However, two women immediately moved in front of them and stopped them.
Hu Lili then asked them. "Do you guys still not understand the situation? If you all move now, you will die by Boitata's hands."
"Even if Boitata doesn't kill you, my master will kill you in even more cruel ways." Hu Qiaomu added.

"Tch! You two are traitors! Hu Gao was our leader, but you betrayed him and sided with that bastard instead." One of Hu Gao's subordinates furiously shouted at the two women, and the others also started to mock them.

"Since they are stubborn, just let them do whatever they want, and they will pay the consequences themselves." Hu Gao's other subordinates looked at Xian Xianqin with a frown, but she immediately released a bit of her aura, causing all of them to feel a chill down their spine. "That's just a small warning from me, and you guys can move if you want to die. Not only will you die, but everyone related to you, including your wife and children, will also perish with you."

Hu Yue joined in speaking to them. "If your loyalty to Hu Gao is more important than your lives and your families, we won't stop you anymore. However, all of you should think things through carefully, or it will be too late for you to regret your decision."

Hu Gao's other subordinates took a breath and thought about their words seriously, especially since it was clear before their eyes that Xian Xianqin could kill them without her having to move from her spot. In the end, they decided to surrender because they didn't want to die, and they dispersed immediately.

Hu Qiaomu, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue were relieved by their decision. They then looked at Boitata, who was toying with Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu. It was clear she could have beaten them from the start, but she deliberately tortured them slowly.
"I'll go to Fei's place." Hu Yue hurried to follow Xian Xianqin as she was worried about Zhang Fei.
Hu Lili and Hu Qiaomu did not follow them, and they went to meet the other moon foxes who never sided with Hu Gao.

Zhang Fei casually stood in front of Hu Gao, who looked completely shocked. After all, the moon fox leader's cultivation was much higher than his, but he couldn't stop him from separating him from his subordinates, and he could feel that the strength of his grip was extremely strong.
'This bastard!' Hu Gao gritted his teeth, transformed into his half-fox form, and moved toward Zhang Fei. He swung his fox claws at him, but his attacks penetrated his illusion.
A black ball shot toward Hu Gao while he was in shock, but he quickly returned to his senses and dodged it straight away, causing it to hit the area behind him.

"You're too slow." Hu Gao was once again shocked after hearing the voice behind him, but Zhang Fei didn't give him a chance to react. He grabbed one of his tails and threw him downwards, causing the moon fox's leader to hurtle towards the ground at high speed.

Hu Gao was still an experienced cultivator, so he immediately stabilized himself and stomped his feet to stop himself just before his body hit the ground. Suddenly, a dark Qi-covered black halberd shot towards him, but he countered it with a ball of light Qi that emerged from his mouth, leading to a collision between the two.
*Boom*
Their impact threw the black halberd upwards, but Zhang Fei immediately grabbed it and dove towards Hu Gao, thrusting it towards the moon fox's leader.
Hu Gao immediately protected his body with his light qi before flying upwards. He then turned his five tails into swords and thrust them toward Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei simply smiled as he watched, but his black halberd vanished, replaced by the moonlit whisper sword, and he quickly parried Hu Gao's attacks before turning behind him.

"Hiss!" Hu Gao hissed in pain as Zhang Fei cut one of his tails, causing blood to flow out of the severed tail and forcing him to move away. He immediately used the light Qi to stop the bleeding, keeping his eyes fixed on the sword in his hand. 'Bastard! How could his sword possibly penetrate my qi protection?'

Hu Gao tensed up the moment Zhang Fei disappeared from his sight, and he increased the thickness of his protective qi after he realized that his sword was not an ordinary sword. Moreover, he could not see his movements or feel his presence, even though he was stronger than him.
Without the moon fox's leader realizing it, Zhang Fei was already behind him with a faint smile on his face. He immediately slashed his sword, cutting off Hu Gao's other four tails cleanly.
"Argh!" Hu Gao screamed in pain as he flew away, but Zhang Fei immediately moved before him with his right leg raised. "Shit!"

Hu Gao crossed his arms in front of him as soon as Zhang Fei swung his leg at him, but it was not enough to block the impact of his attack. Instantly, the moon fox's leader was sent hurtling downward before slamming heavily into the ground, causing him to vomit quite a bit of blood from his mouth, and his blood also flowed profusely from his tails.

"Cough... Cough..." As he coughed loudly, Hu Gao looked at Zhang Fei, who was standing in the sky with a mocking smile on his face. 'Impossible! How can his speed surpass mine with his low cultivation?'
While Hu Gao was thinking, Zhang Fei had already moved in front of him and kicked him hard in the face, causing him to roll on the ground for a considerable distance.
Zhang Fei immediately moved in front of Hu Gao again, grabbed his head, threw him into the sky, and then slashed the sword in his hand toward him.
In an instant, several dark sword Qi shot toward Hu Gao, and they easily penetrated his protective Qi, slashing his body repeatedly and causing his body to bleed. "Argh!"
Zhang Fei bullied Hu Gao for quite some time without intending to kill him, which resulted in the moon fox leader's appearance becoming increasingly messy and his entire body covered in blood.

Xian Xianqin, who was watching their fight from a distance, could only shake her head. She was sure that Zhang Fei could defeat Hu Gao easily, but he was deliberately wasting time just to toy with him. 'His pride as a heavenly fox is too high, and he is deliberately toying with this weak fox.'

Hu Yue had also arrived at the area, and she breathed a sigh of relief after she saw Zhang Fei had the upper hand on Hu Gao. However, she was also surprised by his developments, especially his speed, which overwhelmed her race's leader.

After all, Hu Yue had never lived by Zhang Fei's side and had only heard about his actions from her mother's stories. Moreover, he was still much weaker than her at the time of their first meeting, and only a little over seven months had passed since then, but he was already able to fight and toy with Hu Gao to that extent.

"How do you feel about his progress?" Xian Xianqin asked Hu Yue. "Fei has already told me about his first meeting with you, and his cultivation was still in the elementary realm at that time. Since then, he has been continuously improving himself to free you from this place, and he can now fight a cultivator in the sovereign realm without any difficulty."

Hu Yue couldn't say anything in reply to Xian Xianqin, but the look in her eyes clearly showed that she was grateful and proud of Zhang Fei's development. Her heart was filled with happiness because they could finally be together, and she didn't have to wait a few more years for that.
Xian Xianqin smiled as she glanced at Hu Yue. 'Even though their relationship is somewhat bland, she seems completely in love with him.'
*Boom*

Hu Gao was slammed heavily on the ground before spitting out a lot of it again. His face was completely pale, and wounds covered his body. The Qi and Beast essences in his body had become extremely thin because Zhang Fei had absorbed them using his Beast Essence Absorption technique, leaving him in his weakest state.

As soon as Zhang Fei [1] appeared by his side, Hu Gao's eyes widened in shock, especially since he was carrying Hu Dong with him. Moreover, his other three clones also appeared around them, shocking him further after he sensed that all of them were as real as his real body.

"Have you realized it?" Zhang Fei indifferently asked. "I could have killed you from the start, but I deliberately stalled time because my clones needed time to destroy your barrier in your son's cave, and he is in my hands now."

"Father! Save me." Hu Dong pleaded as his body trembled uncontrollably because Zhang Fei's clones had already sealed his cultivation, and he couldn't even fight them back before being captured by them. Unfortunately, Hu Gao was already too weak, and all the injuries on his body rendered him unable to do anything to help him.
Zhang Fei then brought Hu Dong down before his father, and he looked at Xian Xianqin, who immediately brought Hu Yue to their side. "What are you going to do to them, Fei?"

"Do you still have to ask that, Qin'er?" Zhang Fei then crouched down beside Hu Gao and touched his body. "Anyone who dares to threaten any of my women or those closest to me must die, but he must remove his mark from Yue'er's soul first before I kill him."
'Kid! Actually, you don't need to do anything else to this guy, and his mark will immediately disappear from everyone's souls once you kill him.' Ma Kuangyu suddenly spoke into Zhang Fei's mind.
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows slightly. 'Is that true, Old Ma?'
'Absolutely true.'

'I see.' Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "At first, I thought I had to control you to remove your mark from Yue'er's soul, but it turned out I was wrong. Because I don't need you anymore, you can die now."
After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately used his essence absorption technique to absorb Hu Gao's remaining beast essence, causing his body to dry up before his death.
[You gained 250,000 Beast Essence from a moon fox.]

Hu Dong, who was in Zhang Fei [1]'s hands, was shaking violently after witnessing his father's death. He even peed his pants as soon as Zhang Fei stood in front of him. "Please... spare me... I don't want to die..."

"Spare you?" Zhang Fei inquired as he touched Hu Dong's chest. "Will you two spare Yue'er if I lack the strength to save her? There is no such thing as mercy in my life, and I will kill anyone who becomes my enemy. Since your father is dead, you can follow him into the afterlife."
"Argh!" Hu Dong immediately screamed in pain as soon as Zhang Fei used his essence absorption technique to absorb his beast essence. "Argh! Please! Spare me! I don't want to die!"

Xian Xianqin and Hu Yue, who couldn't bear to see Zhang Fei's cruelty, immediately closed their eyes and ears. Their bodies trembled, knowing with certainty that Hu Dong would die from drying out, just like his father.
Before long, Hu Dong's body had completely dried up, and Zhang Fei immediately threw his corpse on top of his father's corpse.
[You gained 500,000 Beast Essence from a moon fox.]
"Phew." After the notification appeared, Zhang Fei let out a sigh of relief. He immediately approached the two women, hugged their waists, and brought them to Hu Lili's place.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei's four clones immediately went back to their respective places. Zhang Fei [1] returned to the capital of the Xian Kingdom to help Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters in their shop. Feltia [2] went to the Netherworld Realm to join her partner and subordinates. Zhang Fei [4] returned to the northern region of the Sky Jade Realm to train the four female demons again. Zhang Fei [5] returned to Zhang Chen's house on Earth, continuing his forging.
When they arrived at Hu Lili's place, all the higher-ups of the moon fox races had gathered there, including Hu Gao's followers.

Boitata was also there with a smile of joy on her face, especially after she had eaten Hu Peiwu and Hu Dahai alive. Her eyes kept glancing at the remains of Hu Gao's followers, and she was eager to eat them. Unfortunately, Zhang Fei had forbidden her from eating them if they didn't fight her, so she refrained from doing so.

Zhang Fei's gaze caused the remnants of Hu Gao's followers to tremble, as they genuinely feared that he might kill them. However, he ignored them and turned to Hu Yue. "Has his mark disappeared from your soul?"
"Yes." Hu Yue nodded to Zhang Fei. "I immediately checked my soul after you killed Hu Gao and Hu Dong, and his mark has disappeared, so I can go with you now."
Upon hearing that, the moon foxes immediately checked their souls, as Hu Gao had also implanted his mark in them. They all felt a sense of relief when they couldn't find his mark.

"That's good." Zhang Fei then said to the moon foxes. "From today on, all of you are free, and you can do whatever you like. However, I don't want you to cause trouble in the Sky Jade Realm, and I will kill all of you if you dare to do so."

The moon foxes took a deep breath as they nodded to Zhang Fei. Hu Gao, who was the strongest among them, was unable to fight Zhang Fei and had already met his demise at his hands, not to mention those who were clearly weaker.
"Zhang Fei, you can take Yue'er with you, and I will stay here to take care of my race." Hu Lili suddenly spoke.
"No." Zhang Fei immediately rejected Hu Lili, causing her to frown. "Even though you are still not willing to be my woman, I have already regarded you as one, so you must stay by my side."
'This guy is really selfish! I already said I don't want to be his woman, but he keeps forcing his will on me!' Hu Lili grumbled in her heart. "They—"

"I don't care about them, and they can take care of themselves." Zhang Fei immediately opened the portal to the training space, and he sent her along with the other three women into it. "You can choose your new leader, and I will not interfere in the affairs of your race. However, you guys must always remember my words just now, especially since I have been watching over this realm."

The moon foxes felt immense relief once Zhang Fei disappeared from their sight, but they still had a big problem because they no longer had a leader. Moreover, their two powerful elders had died at the hands of Boitata, and he took the other two away, so they had to choose a new leader to organize their race members quickly.

Zhang Fei had already entered the training space and was explaining the features to Hu Lili, Hu Yue, Hu Qiaomu, and Xian Xianqin. The four women were truly amazed by all the features, which made them realize the origin of his strength. The gravity feature shocked them greatly, especially since each level would increase by two times compared to the previous level.
"You guys can practice first, and Yue'er will join you later." Zhang Fei then took Hu Yue with him to the cloud mansion.

"You two don't need to mind them, and we should start practicing here to catch up with Fei." Xian Xianqin spoke as she guided Hu Lili and Hu Qiaomu to the center of the area, but the three of them instantly fell due to the strong gravity in the area.
