Although she was not a stupid woman, her understanding of cultivation techniques and similar concepts was not as high as that of Hu Yue or Zhang Lin, and her process of forming the black lotus bud was significantly longer.
While waiting for Zhang Fei and Ru Xue to finish, Chu Qing and the other young wives decided to chat with Hu Yue, especially since some of them had only seen her once.
However, they had never spoken to her before, and since she was now a part of their family, they wanted to get to know her better.
While Zhang Fei was occupied with all his wives, Xian Feng, Shi Qingzhuang, and Yang Caojing were already standing in front of the prison.
Their expressions were filled with disappointment as they observed the three people lying unconscious in the prison.
Yang Caojing had already shown them the crystal device and the video inside, which made Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang completely disappointed with their sister-in-law's madness.
Li Yiping was so wild when having sex with Zheng Mohei, and they could also feel the Yang Qi of her two sons inside her body, which meant she was doing it with them, too.
"I never thought that Yiping would be this crazy, Husband.
Not only did he cheat on your brother with Zhang Mohei, but he also cheated on him with their two sons." Shi Qingzhuang expressed her disappointment with a heavy sigh.
"What will you do to them?
Will you sentence them to death?"
"Even though they have tarnished my Xian family's name with their immoral behavior, they are still members of my family, especially Yu'er and Mu'er." Xian Feng then fell silent for a few moments.
"Even though I don't like Yiping, I can't sentence him to death because that would bring deeper trouble between me and my big brother.
Still, I won't spare the three of them, and they must take responsibility for their actions."
Xian Feng immediately entered the prison, approached Li Yiping, and touched her stomach.
"I'm sorry, sister-in-law.
My family name is much more important than you, and you have tarnished it, so I was forced to do this."
*Splurt*
Li Yiping, who was still unconscious, immediately spurted blood from her mouth.
Quickly, her cultivation disappeared, especially since Xian Feng decided to cripple her cultivation veins.
Xian Feng then moved to the side of his two nephews and touched their stomachs, but he seemed hesitant to do that to them.
After he thought about it, he finally decided to cripple their cultivation veins as well, and he directly took their storage ring.
Shi Qingzhuang let out a heavy sigh once again after she sensed that Li Yiping, Xian Yu, and Xian Mu's cultivation disappeared.
This way, they had returned to being ordinary people, and they would never be able to restart their path of cultivation.
Xian Feng immediately left the prison room with a heavy heart and led his wife away.
"Caojing, order some people to move them to the farthest village and order them to keep a close eye on them.
If they try to commit suicide, they must stop them immediately."
"Yes, Emperor." Yang Caojing immediately summoned several people and ordered them to carry out Xian Feng's orders.
As they walked away from the place, Shi Qingzhuang asked her husband.
"You've gotten rid of Xian Wu and Xian Yu, so what's your next plan for their followers in our sect?
Are you going to get rid of them too?"
"Yes." Xian Feng answered without hesitation.
"Back then, I never intended to do anything to them, but Li Yiping's disgusting actions forced me to change my mind.
Moreover, I've let them do as they please for too long, and my big brother has clearly betrayed us by joining Ximen Gongfu, so I think it's time for me to clean them up."
Shi Qingzhuang nodded slightly in response.
"In that case, let's go to our sect now, and we'll explain this matter to Xian Luo first, or he will think that you made a reckless decision."
"Yeah, you're right."
Following this, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang swiftly departed from their palace and headed toward the Xian Imperial Sect.
They also sent a message to Xian Changyue, informing her of their decision.
As soon as they arrived at the Xian Imperial Sect, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang immediately went to see Xian Luo.
They explained the details of the situation, but he seemed to find it hard to believe that Li Yiping would commit such an immoral act, especially considering that she did it with her two sons.
Xian Feng immediately showed the recording in the crystal device to Xian Luo.
"They were targeting Zhang Fei, but he had long known their plans, so he acted first against them.
Since they are members of our family, he did not do anything to them and handed them over to me, so I decided to do that to them."

chapters.title: Chapter 619 Bai Tian'er's Visit
paragraphs: "If-"
*Crack.*
Xian Feng and the others immediately turned to Xian Qifeng and Luo Qinglin, who had just arrived. "What about the second floor? Did you two manage to pass the first challenge?"

"Uncle Feng, the challenge on the second floor is too difficult, even though the main requirement is only the Heaven Realm." Xian Qifeng then led his wife to sit on an empty chair. "There's no way we can pass it with the few of us, and according to my calculations, we need at least twenty people to pass it. Moreover, their minimum cultivation must be in the quasi-divine realms, or they won't be able to survive if their cultivation is below that."
Luo Qinglin then joined in. "The only cultivator below the quasi-divine realm who was able to survive the challenge was Zhang Fei."
"What do you think about Zhang Fei?" Xiao Luo asked his son and daughter-in-law.
"Formidable!" Xian Luo was surprised by their answer.

Xian Qifeng immediately explained the various events in the challenges on the first floor, starting with Zhang Fei's strength challenge, the battle challenge, and the final boss in the maze challenge.

"Honestly, I feel embarrassed to tell you all this, Father." Xian Qifeng said it with a bitter smile. "My cultivation is at the 2-Moon Divine Transcend Realm, but I can't get close to the beast. Zhang Fei, with his cultivation at the Earth Realm, fought with the beast at close range. He directed us to attack it, and we wouldn't have made it through if it weren't for him. In the end, the beast died in his hands, and we got a wonderful reward from the challenge."
"The reward allowed my cultivation to touch the final barrier to the seven divine realms, and I will try to break through tonight, Father." Luo Qinglin informed Xian Luo.
Xian Luo nodded. "You guys can rest now, and you must be careful in your breakthrough, Qinglin."
"Yes, Father." After that, Xian Qifeng and Luo Qinglin said goodbye to Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang before leaving them.

Xian Luo then asked Xian Feng. "Why didn't you ever tell me about Zhang Fei's abilities, Second Brother? At first, I was confused by your reasons for sending him to our sect, and I was pessimistic about his chances of passing the strength challenge. It turns out that my guess was wrong, and he actually helped our children get through all the challenges on the first floor. Moreover, I noticed that he was very close to Xianqin, and they seemed to be interested in each other."

"Hahaha." Xian Feng laughed after listening to Xian Luo's words. "Zhang Fei asked me not to tell anyone about his abilities, and I promised him. Moreover, I was sure that Qifeng and Qinglin would tell you everything after they returned from the tower, so I didn't say anything."

"We sent our daughter to Zhang Fei to establish a good relationship with him, but she actually developed feelings for him." Xian Luo looked at Shi Qingzhuang with surprise because they had not been in contact for too long, and his niece had been avoiding men since Yun Aoxian rejected her. "Changyue was also with them, and she told me some things about what happened between them. They were trapped in a bedroom, and my daughter was exposed to an aphrodisiac, but he didn't do anything to her and knocked her out of the cold. If another man had been in his position, my daughter would have lost her virginity, and that incident deepened her attraction to him."

"Enough talking about them." Xian Feng then put on a serious expression. "As I told you before, I crippled Li Yiping and his two sons, and I sent them to the farthest village. Zhang Fei told me that our big brothers would go with Ximen Gongfu and Zheng Moyue to the Star Tower, and they would be gone for a long time. It is a good opportunity to get rid of his loyal followers, and our kingdom will no longer be divided into two factions like in the past few decades."
"When will we make our move, Second Brother?"

"Since you are the sect master of our sect, you can send the strongest people on their side elsewhere, and we will gradually cleanse this sect of their people." Xian Feng then thought for a while. "I don't know if any demons are hiding in this sect, but Zhang Fei should be able to detect them. I will ask him for help to reveal their identity, and I will deal with them straight away."

"I will arrange everything starting tomorrow, and you can send your aides to follow them. That way, they can immobilize those people outside this sect so as not to arouse suspicion from their friends." After Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang left, Xian Luo immediately leaned back in his chair and massaged his forehead. "Why are you so ambitious, Big Brother? None of this would have happened if you hadn't betrayed us! Moreover, you didn't know that our parents are still alive in the upper realms, and they would be furious if they found out you did that."

After that, Xian Luo contacted his trusted men and ordered them to prepare everything, which surprised them. Even so, they immediately followed his order because their sects and kingdoms had been divided for too long, and they hoped that the situation could return to normal, especially with the Zhou and Huangfu Kingdoms still ambitious to conquer their kingdoms.

When Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang returned to the palace, they found a guest chatting with Yang Caojing while waiting for them to return. They naturally recognized their guest's identity, especially since he was the man from the Bai Kingdom that Zhang Fei had left behind in the Star Tower.

The man's normal behavior puzzled Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang, especially considering their knowledge of Huangfu Shou's control over him. However, they immediately guessed that Zhang Fei had freed him from the evil emperor, which made them wonder how.

"Emperor Xian! Empress Shi." The man immediately stood up and greeted the two respectfully. "Please forgive me for my sudden arrival, but I have a serious matter to discuss with the two of you, which concerns my Emperor and Empress."

"Please sit down, Bai Hunyao." After Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang sat down, the man immediately took a seat and explained everything to them, particularly about Huangfu Shou's actions against his Bai Kingdom. He also told them about the disappearance of Bai Chongxi, Bai Renfu, and Bai Shouyi. The two of them were naturally not surprised about the three, especially since Xian Changyue had already told them that Zhang Fei had sent them to another realm. "We already know about the man behind that evil emperor, but we don't know his exact identity yet. However, we suspect that he came from the upper realms, so we cannot act rashly against them. As for the two princes and the princess, you don't need to worry about them, and they are in a safe place now."
"How can you be sure that they are safe, Emperor Xian? Where are they now? Do you know the identity of the mysterious woman? Did she hide them?" Bai Hunyao asked with a look of disbelief.

"If you don't believe me, you don't need to ask for my help, and you can take care of your kingdom's affairs by yourself." Bai Hunyao immediately apologized to Xian Feng. "I have met the mysterious woman, and her name is Feng Yao. She comes from the upper realm, and she is far stronger than all cultivators in this realm, including the Beast Emperor Long and the Elf Emperor Xian. Anyway, you're correct that she has hidden the three of them, but I'm unsure of their exact location. I dare to guarantee that they are completely safe, so you don't need to worry about them."
Bai Yunhao nodded to Xian Feng. "Since you trust that woman, I will also trust her regarding their safety, Emperor Xian."

"You don't need to return to Bai Kingdom, and you can stay in our kingdom for the time being." Shi Qingzhuang then turned to Yang Caojing. "Bring him to that place so that Huangfu Shou and Bai Yaowei's spies will not be able to find him, or his presence here will bring trouble to us."
"Yes, Empress." Yang Caojing immediately led Bai Yunhao away.
Shi Qingzhuang then asked her husband. "Do you have any plans regarding Bai Yaowei and the Bai Kingdom?"

"No." Xian Feng replied with a shake of his head. "Zhang Fei has taken the three of them away, so I will go see him tomorrow and inquire about both kingdoms. If he already has plans for them, I will devise another plan to support him."
Shi Qingzhuang agreed with that. "I will go with you to meet him, especially since I want to buy things from his shop."
Zhang Fei [1], who was preparing to close his shop, was surprised by the arrival of a woman. "When are you coming back from the tower, Senior Sister Tian'er?"

"A few hours ago, but I took a break because the first challenge on the second floor was really difficult, and we miserably failed because there were only a few of us." Bai Tian'er then told Zhang Fei [1] about the challenge. "Anyway, I want to buy some things, especially those mattresses."

"Let me show you all the items I sell in this shop." Zhang Fei [1] then guided Bai Tian'er through the shop, explaining the various items and their respective uses. However, Bai Tian'er's expression turned embarrassed as they passed the sex toys section. "Are you interested in buying them?"

Bai Tian'er immediately put on a sour face. "I'm still a virgin and don't have a lover, so I can't possibly buy those items, right? The story will be different if you are willing to accept me, and I won't mind if you use them with me."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] simply laughed and guided Bai Tian'er to look at the other items.

In the end, Bai Tian'er purchased a significant number of items, including mattresses, winter clothes, pills, and various other items. "Are you going to close your shop soon? It's almost midnight, and the streets are quiet. If you don't mind, I'd like to talk to you after this."

"I'm going to close this shop now, and I'll go see all my dual cultivation partners right after this." Bai Tian'er looked at Zhang Fei [1] in confusion as she never knew that he had dual cultivation partners before. "Apart from my 19 wives, I have 22 partners. As for you, even though your family was expelled from the Bai royal family, you are still a princess. That's why you should stop approaching me, especially since the number of my women will continue to increase in the future. You don't want to have a lustful husband like me, right?"

Bai Tian'er wanted to say something to Zhang Fei [1], but she remembered her master's previous words, so she swallowed her words back. "You're right. I don't like that kind of man, let alone choose that kind of man as my husband."
"In that case, you can forget about your desire to approach me, especially since I'm not the ideal type of man for you." Zhang Fei [1] casually said it.

Bai Tian'er didn't say anything in response, and she immediately turned to leave the shop. However, she was surprised by the woman who had just walked in, especially since she was quite familiar with her. 'Huan Ya? Does she have a special relationship with Zhang Fei?'
Huan Ya just nodded to Bai Tian'er and immediately went over to Zhang Fei [1], and she reported a few things to him. "What should I do next?"

"Nothing." Zhang Fei [1] then pulled Huan Ya into his arms and gave her a quick kiss, causing Bai Tian'er to frown in the distance. "I want you to accompany me tonight, and we will spend the night together."
'This guy! He deliberately used me to inflame Princess Bai!' Huan Ya inwardly grumbled as she glanced at Bai Tian'er.

Bai Tian'er could only sigh in her heart and leave the shop, but she still did not give up on her hopes of getting Zhang Fei [1]. After witnessing all his abilities in the Star Tower, she firmly believed that he was the only person who could help her and her family regain their rights.
Zhang Fei [1] then questioned Huan Ya. "Has your cultivation approached the final barrier?"

"Not yet." Huan Ya replied with a disappointed look. "Your pills and Yang Qi have brought many changes in me, but I feel that the final barrier is still far from my reach, so I don't know when I can break through to the seven divine realms."

"Wait for me; I'll close the shop first." Huan Ya was confused by that, but Zhang Fei [1] had already rushed to organize the messy things. Once he had tidied everything up, he took her away with him. "Did anyone from the alchemy union contact you?"

Huan Ya immediately told Zhang Fei [1] about the matter. "Cheng Feng reported the condition of Lian Jinshu's family to the higher-ups, and they decided to send someone over. Even though they stripped him of his status, he had done a lot for the organization, so they wanted to help him restore their condition."
"When will that person arrive in this realm?"

"I don't know when that person will leave the headquarters, so I don't know when he will arrive in this realm." Zhang Fei [1] frowned for a moment, but he quickly shrugged it off. "Where are we going?"
"Close your eyes first." Huan Ya followed Zhang Fei [1]'s orders without asking anything.
A few moments later, they were already inside the portable mansion, and the presence of 14 women inside surprised Huan Ya. 'Where is this place? Are these women his women?'
"Oh? Is she your new partner, Fei?" Du Yuan asked immediately.
"Do you need to ask that?" Ning Xiang asked her best friend while shaking her head. "Since Fei brought her here, she must be his new partner, and this place will be more lively."

Huan Ya raised her eyebrows after hearing that, but she was sure that Zhang Fei [1] would do something to her sooner or later, especially after he kissed her a few times and gave her his precious pills and Yang Qi.
Luo Yu then teased him. "You always manage to get new partners, Fei. Anyway, Qingya told us that she was ready to be your partner, especially after she watched our dual cultivation too many times."

Zhang Fei [1] looked at Yue Qingya, who turned her face away in embarrassment. However, he did not immediately take her away, instead asking Yan Luan'er a question. "Are you satisfied with torturing Thish?"
Yan Luan'er shrugged helplessly. "That female demon is already a living corpse now, so there's no point in me torturing her any further. If you want to kill her, you can kill her directly."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [1] then walked into Thish's room. "Anyway, one of you can explain to Huan Ya about soul cultivation, and I'll also teach you guys a new technique later."
When Zhang Fei [1] mentioned a new technique, it excited everyone, and Xi Zihua immediately explained soul cultivation to Huan Ya.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the Earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]
Both notifications appeared as Zhang Fei [1] entered Thish's room, and he approached the succubus duchess, who was hanging helplessly.
[Don't you want to use her to increase your demon rank, master?]

"No." Zhang Fei [1] immediately rejected that. "Thish's female essence should be as high as Orith and Ilsath, but I never intended to use her, and I had planned from the start to kill her after Yan Luan'er had had her fill of venting her anger on her."

chapters.title: Chapter 624 Huangfu Lian's Plans
paragraphs: After leaving his kingdom, Huangfu Lian did not immediately take Ling Long to the Xian Kingdom. Instead, he picked up his other two women, Xuan Cunhua and Ming Yunjie, primarily because their abilities would be useful to him.
Huangfu Lian then shared Zhang Fei's image with the three women, captivating Ling Long. 'He's really handsome, huh? No wonder Xian Xianqin is interested in him.'
Unlike Ling Long, the other women were unfazed by Zhang Fei's handsome face and sturdy body. Ming Yunjie then asked Huangfu Lian. "What should I do about that man, Prince Lian?"
"Did you bring the Crimson Fang Poison?" Huangfu Lian asked her back.

"Yes." Ming Yunjie then took out a small bottle and showed it to them. "A drop of this Crimson Fang Poison can paralyze all the nerves of a living creature, and they will become completely paralyzed if they do not get the antidote within a week; not even cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms would be able to resist its effects."

Huangfu Lian then took the bottle before speaking to Xuan Cunhua. "I want you to help Yunjie infiltrate the Xian palace with your concealment technique and use this poison on Xian Xianqin. After paralyzing her, you must immediately take her away from there."
Xuan Cunhua nodded to him. "Then what about Zhang Fei? Do we need to help you?"

"No need." Huangfu Lian then pulled Ling Long into his arms. "Zhang Fei is indeed not an ordinary cultivator, but he is still weaker than us. Moreover, Long'er's Heavenly Marionette Arts are very effective; even my father recognizes her techniques. That's why she will take care of him, and I will help her by using my special artifact."
Xuan Cunhua and Ming Yunjie nodded in agreement. "In that case, we will take care of Xian Xianqin, but we must descend far outside the Xian capital so that they won't detect our arrival."
"Big Sis Ma Mingxin! Emergency! A flying artifact has just entered our realm!" A young woman riding a winged horse screamed as she flew around above a house.

Ma Mingxin rushed out of her house and immediately looked at the red flying artifact with a phoenix statue in front of it. She then examined the flying artifact with her senses, but as soon as her senses repelled her, her expression turned to shock.

'Who are the people on the flying artifact? What is their purpose in coming to my realm? They are clearly stronger than me, so I have to be careful of them.' Ma Mingxin then gave the young woman an order. "Ma Xiaowei! Order the others not to approach the flying artifact! They are stronger than me, and I don't want them to be suspicious of the situation in our realm."
"Yes, Big Sis!" Ma Xiaowei immediately flew away again to carry out Ma Mingxin's order.
"What happened? Why do you look panicked?" A middle-aged woman asked as she walked out of the house. Her appearance was seductive, with only a brown cloth covering her two private areas.

Ma Mingxin turned around and pulled the woman into her embrace before placing a gentle kiss on her lips. "Uninvited guests have come to this realm, Meng Qi. I still don't know why they came here, but they are stronger than me because they can ward off my senses."

"Oh." Meng Qi responded curtly and turned her gaze to the red flying artifact that was approaching their location. 'Who are they? Should I ask for their help to leave this realm? I've been living in this realm for almost five months, but I've never been comfortable with Ma Mingxin's treatment of me. She forced me to be intimate with her, even though I refused her repeatedly. She eventually forced me to swallow a strange liquid, causing my mind to go blank and my lust to soar.'

"Hmm?" Ma Mingxin furrowed her brows as the flying artifact abruptly shifted its direction toward the lowlands. 'Do they want to free the men? Or do they want to go to the Sun Tower? It's fine if they want to go to the tower, but it will be a big problem if they release them.'
*Tweet*
After Ma Mingxin whistled to call it, a white-winged horse quickly flew towards them and landed right in front of them.
"Let's go! We'll meet those people." Ma Mingxin immediately took Meng Qi on the flying horse, and they rushed after the flying artifact.

Meanwhile, the flying artifact had landed in front of the Sun Tower, and several people hurriedly descended from it. They were none other than Feng Tian, Feng Jiu, Gong Ren, the Nameless One, and the white beast Xue Bao.

Xue Bao then turned to the men who were crowding in front of the wall surrounding the Sun Tower. "What happened to those men? Why do they look so bad? Look at them! Chains bind their necks, hands, and feet."

"Those men are slaves to the women in this realm." Xue Bao turned to Gong Ren, who immediately explained the situation in the Blossom Heaven Realm to him and the others. "We don't need to care about them, and our purpose in coming here is only for the Sun Tower."
"Hmm?" Feng Jiu suddenly looked up at the white-winged horse. "The purple-haired woman seems to be their leader, and she was the one who tried to observe us with her senses earlier."

Feng Tian agreed with his wife, but his attention fell on Meng Qi. "Wife, look at the expression of the black-haired woman behind her; her expression seems to be expecting something, and I can feel the remnants of something unusual in her body."

"The purple-haired woman seemed to have fed her something addictive." Feng Jiu responded after closely examining Meng Qi's body. "Moreover, the Qi in the black-haired woman's body is different from the Qi of the residents of this realm, so I'm sure that she's not a native."

Unlike them, the Nameless One didn't care about Ma Mingxin or Meng Xi, and he hurriedly walked toward the stone obelisk in front of the tower. Xue Bao, who was lying on his shoulder, immediately spoke. "Apparently, this stone obelisk is used to measure one's strength, Master."

"Yeah." The Nameless One gave a slight nod. "I want to know whether this tower is the key to going to those realms or not, but we must wait for the others to arrive in this realm and enter it together."
"Are you not confident in your abilities to challenge this tower?"

"Haha." The Nameless One laughed at that. "Bao'er, you know that I have always been confident in my abilities, but you must always remember that there is another sky above the sky. This Sun Tower and the Star Tower in the Nine Stars Realm appeared out of thin air, and no one knows their true origins. Moreover, Little Yao'er has told her parents a lot about the Star Tower, so we can't underestimate this tower and all the challenges in it."

Xue Bao immediately spoke confidently. "This tower may be unusual, but we are not ordinary cultivators either. I'm sure we will overcome all the challenges in it and reach the peak to discover the truth about this tower."
"I hope so." The Nameless One then sat cross-legged in front of the stone obelisk and closed his eyes, ignoring everything around him.

Unlike his master, Xue Bao turned to face the two women who had just dismounted the white-winged horse, but his attention was solely on Ma Mingxin. 'Heh! She looks innocent on the outside, but her soul is as rotten as a rotten corpse. Unfortunately, she is a weakling, and my master will scold me if I eat her soul.'

As she glanced at Xue Bao and the Nameless One, Ma Mingxin immediately walked up to the other three and cupped her hands to them. "Seniors, my name is Ma Mingxin, the leader of this realm. If you don't mind, I would like to know the purpose of your visit to my realm."
"We have no interests in this realm except for this Sun Tower, so you need not mind our presence."

Gong Ren's answer relieved Ma Mingxin, but Feng Jiu suddenly moved and pulled Meng Qi with her, causing her to become tense again. 'What is she going to do to her? Does she intend to take her away from me?'

Feng Jiu did not care about Ma Mingxin's expression and asked Meng Qi directly. "Which realm are you from? After you were in front of me, I could smell my daughter's scent on your body, indicating you've met her before."

After Feng Jiu's question, Ma Mingxin appeared shocked and grew anxious, fearing that she might take Meng Qi away. Even so, she didn't dare to say anything, especially since the aura emanating from the Phoenix Empress's body gave her a calm but deadly feeling.
"Who is your daughter, Senior?" Meng Qi confusedly asked.

"Our race is not an ordinary race, and our scent will continue to linger on the bodies of those we have met before, but only our members can smell it." Feng Jiu's words confused Meng Qi even more. "My daughter is Feng Yao, and you must have met her, right?"
"Ah!" Meng Qi released a low cry of surprise. "Do you mean Feng Yao, the sect master of the Blazing Phoenix Sect?"
Feng Jiu nodded to Meng Qi. "Does this mean you came from the Sky Jade Realm? My daughter has lived in that realm for decades, so I'm sure that you met her there."

"Yes, Senior. I did come from the Sky Jade Realm, and the space rift brought me to this realm." Meng Qi then told Feng Jiu about the events starting from the incident in the demon cave until she was trapped in the Blossom Heaven Realm.
'Damn it!' Ma Mingxin cursed in her heart after hearing all that. 'I didn't expect that Meng Qi would have a relationship with the daughter of this powerful woman.'
"Is Feng Yao really your daughter, Senior?" Meng Qi asked.
"Yes." Feng Jiu touched her forehead and shared Feng Yao's image with her, convincing Meng Qi that the two were indeed the same person. "How long have you been in this realm?"

"Four and a half months, Senior." Meng Qi glanced at Ma Mingxin, who looked furious. "Honestly, I miss my home realm because my younger sister and family still live there, and I have always wanted to go back to see them again. Unfortunately, my cultivation is still too low, and I don't have a flying artifact capable of exploring outer space."

"Actually, my daughter has left the Sky Jade Realm, and she followed someone to the Nine Stars Realm, so she is living there now." Although Feng Jiu did not say the person's identity clearly, Meng Qi could immediately guess that the Phoenix Princess had followed Zhang Fei to that realm, especially since he had the ability to move between realms. "If you want to return to your home realm, I can help you with that. Although my daughter is no longer living there, someone from our race has taken her place to protect that realm, so you will still be safe to live there."

Ma Mingxin clenched her fists tightly, especially since she liked Meng Qi so much, and she didn't want to lose her. Unfortunately, her cultivation was far below Feng Jiu's, and fighting her would be akin to courting death. Moreover, the Phoenix Empress was not alone, and the other four were no less powerful than her.

Given the outcome, Ma Mingxin made the quick decision to leave, but she couldn't help but glare at Meng Qi in frustration. 'Tch! At least I know that her home realm is the Sky Jade Realm in the lower realm, so I can go there and bring her back to me in the future.'

After Ma Mingxin left, Meng Qi was overjoyed, but she then spoke to Feng Jiu. "Senior, I want to return to my home realm, but that woman repeatedly gave me a strange liquid, and I have become addicted to it."

"Hehe." Feng Jiu chuckled as she touched Meng Qi's chest. "My race is unique, and our flames can neutralize various substances, such as poison and others. Actually, I had guessed from the beginning that she used something on you, so I will help you to remove the effects, and you will no longer be addicted to it."

"Mhmm..." Meng Qi groaned softly as Feng Jiu channeled her phoenix flame into her body, and it quickly spread throughout. Additionally, she sensed an unusual sensation within her body as her flame seemed to rejuvenate her organs. 'A mythical beast, the Phoenix is truly extraordinary.'

A while later, Feng Jiu simultaneously withdrew her flame and her hand before presenting Meng Qi with a miniature flying artifact. "This flying artifact is not as fast as my main flying artifact, but its protection is very strong, so it is more than enough to take you back to the Sky Jade Realm. However, that realm is too far from here, and you need one to two months to get there. Given your familiarity with my daughter and Zhang Fei, I recommend meeting them in the Nine Stars Realm first. That realm is significantly closer than your home realm, and you can reach it in about two weeks using my flying artifact. Once you've met them, you can ask for their help to return to your home realm."

"Yeah, you're right, Senior." Meng Qi immediately received the miniature flying artifact from Feng Jiu. "Zhang Fei has the ability to go to various realms, so he should be able to send me back to the Sky Jade Realm."
Feng Jiu nodded before telling Meng Qi the direction of the Nine Stars Realm. "You must leave now, or that woman will change her mind and capture you again."

"Thank you, Senior. I will never forget your help." Meng Qi then looked at Feng Tian and Gong Ren, nodded to them, and enlarged the flying artifact. "In that case, I will leave for the Nine Stars Realm right now."

After Meng Qi left, Gong Ren immediately spoke to Feng Jiu. "You're still as soft-hearted as ever, Empress Feng. You don't know that little girl, but you helped her to that extent. By the way, is Zhang Fei the man at Princess Yao's side?"

"I could see that the little girl had great potential, and I was even more convinced after I examined her whole body. That's why I decided to save her from that woman's clutches, or her potential would be wasted, and she would only become her doll." Feng Jiu then returned to her husband's side. "Anyway, you are right, Old Ren. Zhang Fei is indeed the one, but my daughter doesn't have a special relationship with him yet."

"I see." Gong Ren then looked towards the Sun Tower. "We just need to wait for the others to arrive in this realm, and we can challenge this Sun Tower after we pass the strength test on that stone obelisk."

The three of them then approached the stone obelisk and touched it, but they did not activate it right away, especially since they had heard from Feng Yao that someone was controlling the tower at the top. That person had full control over the tower and could easily change all the challenges inside it, so they chose to wait for the others before challenging it. They then sat cross-legged on the ground, surrounded the stone obelisk, and closed their eyes.

At dawn, Murong Qianying decided to stop dual cultivating with Zhang Xiaolong [3] and asked him to pamper her second daughter, especially since she had to return to the Red Sun Realm, or her husband would be suspicious of her if he returned before her. "Are you sure they won't die there?"
"If you're worried that they'll die, I'll take Big Sis Yaolin there to check on their condition." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then carried Shang Yaolin out of bed before getting dressed.

"All right, you two can go there and make sure they are safe, especially since they are still useful to me." After she finished dressing, Murong Qianying hurriedly went to the fortress. Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] took Shang Yaolin to Shang Xiaoyin's secret place.

chapters.title: Chapter 625 Prepare To Fight
paragraphs: When they arrived at the location, they discovered Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin had already fallen asleep due to exhaustion, particularly after having sex the previous day.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then crouched beside them, used his memory manipulation ability, and altered some of their memories, ensuring they would not remember that they had brought him there.
After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] took out a pill and forced Shang Xiaoyin to swallow it. 'Hey! I wonder how Shang Ziyuan will react when she finds out about their relationship later.'

"Long'er, do you want to dig up these stones again? I think it will be difficult for us to come to this place after this, so I think we could dig up as many of them as possible." Shang Yaolin posed this question while examining each type of stone on the cave wall.

"I do want to do that, Big Sis." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then proceeded to the side of the Beast Blood Pond. "I'm also thinking about draining the contents of this pond and moving it to another place so that I can cultivate my body at any time."
"Hmm?" Shang Yaolin immediately turned to him. "Where do you want to move this pond?"

"I think the western island is the best choice, especially since no humans dare to go there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked Mei to open the gate to the Azure Sky Realm. "I'll go pick up Big Sis Xinyu first, and she can help us dig up these stones. Additionally, I need to buy a lot of barrels to move the beasts' blood."
"I will start digging these stones." Shang Yaolin immediately took out a dagger and started digging one by one.

However, you must avoid killing them, as their death could lead to conflict with the Black Fang Sect and the Venomous Serpent Sect."
"Yes, Emperor."

After Old Feng disappeared, Yang Caojing informed Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang about something else. "Li Yiping and her two sons have already woken up, and they continued to scream hysterically after they discovered their condition. 'Tch! It's no use lying to an old witch like my mother.' Yun Xinyue muttered to herself as she pouted.

I plan to go to the Xian Kingdom today, but your father is still busy with kingdom affairs. Therefore, you must accompany me to the Xian Kingdom, and you can meet him later."

Moreover, I have never tasted the dishes at his restaurant, so I will accompany you there. However, you must coerce my brother to accompany us; otherwise, he may continue to shut himself in his room due to depression."
"Let's meet your brother now."

"We tried to persuade Qinghai, but he just chased us away, Mother." Li Yao was the first to answer.

Yun Aoxian then asked his mother. "Should I break into his room, Mother? He is a man and a prince, but he is too whiny just because of his failure at the tower. Back then, I also failed repeatedly, but I never whined like him. Moreover, his enemy was Zhou Tai, who was stronger than him, so he should be able to stand tall and accept his defeat."
"Let me do it." Guo Xuehua immediately walked to her second son's bedroom door, pushed it open slightly, and went straight in. "You guys wait here, and I'll talk to Qinghai first."

Yun Xinyue moved to Li Yao's side and hugged her arm. "Would you like to join us, Sister-in-law? After this, we're going to the Xian Kingdom to see Zhang Fei's new shop and buy some things there. Additionally, our mother has mentioned that the dishes in his restaurant are delicious, so I am eager to try them."

"Actually, your big brother and I have already planned to go there today, and we came here to invite Qinghai to join us." Yun Xinyue laughed upon hearing that, but Li Yao then teased her. "Why are you so excited to go there? Are you looking forward to seeing Zhang Fei again?"
'If my mother is an old witch, then my sister-in-law is a young witch!' Yun Xinyue then asked him. "Do I look like I miss Zhang Fei?"

"Haha." Li Yao laughed softly and pinched Yun Xinyue's nose. "Did you think I didn't notice your behavior when we were still at the Star Tower? I don't know what happened between you and Zhang Fei there, but I can see that you've fallen in love with him. It started after he saved you from Bai Shouyi's poison, and you became much closer to him after the maze challenge. You even seemed jealous of Xian Xianqin, especially since she was so close to him."

Yun Xinyue let out a heavy sigh as she couldn't control her behavior while at the Star Tower. "You are right, Sister-in-law. I have indeed fallen in love with Zhang Fei, but I have not thought about becoming his lover."

"What made you fall in love with him, Yinyue?" Yun Xinyue immediately told Yun Aoxian and Li Yao about the incident in the previous maze challenge. "That guy is not bad, especially since he didn't take advantage of the adversity to do anything indecent to you and Xianqin, so I'm not surprised that you fell in love with him."

"I also think that Zhang Fei is a good man." Yun Xinyue replied with a nod. "Unfortunately, he already has 19 wives and dozens of partners, so I feel hesitant to get closer to him, let alone become his lover. Xianqin might be able to accept his relationship, but I find it too messy, especially considering that some of his wives are his mother, big sister, and little sister. Some of his wives, such as Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu, are even mothers and daughters.

Yun Xinyue's revelation of Zhang Fei's messy relationship shocked Yun Aoxian and Li Yao. Although they were grateful for Zhang Fei's actions for their sister, they felt he was not worthy of being her husband.
*Crack*
The bedroom door suddenly opened, and Guo Xuehua walked out with Yun Qinghai, who looked disheveled.

"Brother! You are really stupid!" Yun Xinyue immediately shouted at her second brother. "I know you are disappointed about your failure, but you failed because your opponent was stronger than you, so you shouldn't keep blaming yourself like this!"
"All right, you don't need to scold your brother, Yinyue." Guo Xuehua then led them to leave the place. "Let's go; we will go to the Xian Kingdom now."
"What about your Zheng Clan people?" Ximen Gongfu immediately inquired after his wife's return.

"Some are on their way here and will join us at the Star Tower." Zheng Moyue answered as she sat on her husband's lap and kissed him briefly. "I have ordered Zheng Qinwen and Zheng Yumin to infiltrate your big brother's kingdom, and I am sure they will succeed in bringing Ximen Yueliang here."

I'm sure my brother will not leave his children unguarded, and he will probably leave Ximen Gui to protect them. That old demon's abilities cannot be underestimated, and our parents respect him very much. Unfortunately, he has a strong loyalty to my brother, making it difficult for me to convince him to side with me. If they do not exercise caution, they will undoubtedly meet their demise at his hands."

"I've already told them about him, so they won't act rashly." Zheng Moyue then put her arm around Ximen Gonfu's neck. "We're leaving in a few days, and we'll be spending quite a long time in the tower, so I want to have some fun with you and Xian Hong. What do you think about that?"
Ximen Gonfu frowned for a moment before agreeing to his wife's idea. "Call him."
Zheng Moyue happily called Xian Hong, and she immediately got off her husband's lap before stripping off their clothes, leaving them both naked.

As Zheng Moyue began to serve her husband, Ximen Gongfu, Xian Hong walked into their room. Upon seeing Empress Zheng naked, he immediately became aroused and quickly stripped off his clothes before having a threesome.

A jet-black-haired old demon knelt before Ximen Changtian, who told him several things, including his plan to go to the Star Tower. "Uncle Gui, I believe Ximen Gongfu and Zheng Moyue have already planned something to capture my daughter while we are away, so I hope you can stay in this castle for the time being specifically to protect her. "All right, I will protect Yueliang myself." Ximen Gui then asked him. "Are you sure your little brother won't betray you in the tower?"

Ximen Changtian nodded before answering. "I know my little brother's character very well, and I know there is a possibility that he will betray me. That's why I have already prepared measures to protect myself and Huangjin, so you don't have to worry about us.

"Yeah, you're right."

"All right, I asked people to leave the volcano when the lady came here so no one would disturb them." After that, they discussed other topics related to Zhang Fei and Feng Yao.
"Why did you call me to come here, Father?" Xian Jinglan asked the Elf Emperor.

Xian Lianghua looked at his wife for a moment before answering. "Jinglan, I want you to go to Mutou Town to meet some important people. I heard that they want to set up a shop there, but the villagers won't let them without our consent, so I want you to meet them on my behalf."
"Hmm?" Xian Jinglan felt that there was something else behind her father's decision, especially after she saw Xue Jingling's strange expression. "Are those people related to Zhang Fei?"

"You are indeed smart as usual." Xian Lianghua said with a smile. "They are natural races from another realm, and Zhang Fei brought them to our kingdom. Since you said that he has two shops in the Xian Kingdom, I suspect that they want to open a shop in our kingdom because of him. That's why I think this is a good opportunity for us, and we can establish a good relationship with him if we help them."
Xian Jinglan nodded in understanding. "In that case, I will take Lang to Mutou Town now, and I will ask Xi Xianzi to accompany me."
After their daughter left, Xue Jingling asked her husband, "Do you really want to bring our daughter closer to Zhang Fei?"

"Do you still doubt Zhang Fei after our daughter told us so much about him?" Xian Lianghua immediately grabbed his wife's hand. "I understand your concerns about him being a demon, but he is not as evil as you think. I do want to bring our daughter closer to him, but I will not force my will on her. If Jinglan falls in love with him, then I will approve of their relationship. If she doesn't have interest in him, then I won't force her, so you don't need to worry, okay?"
"All right."

Since it was already morning outside, Zhang Fei decided to stop dual soul cultivating with all his wives. He immediately brought Zhang Lingxue, Liu Hua, the Wen Twins, and the Chu Sisters to the capital.
As usual, Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters went to the Sky Jade Shop, and Liu Hua took the Wen Twins to the Sky Jade Restaurant.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei decided to go to the array shop to see Fa Zhen, but the old man was working on a project and did not want to be disturbed. He then went to find Gang Zhishou to discuss something with him about blacksmithing, especially since Tie Xuan had not returned to the Wasteland Realm. "I thought you were still busy with your business, Old Gang."
"Haha." Gang Zhishou laughed at that. "My master asked me to see him a few days ago, so I had to leave for a few days. How is your blacksmithing? Have you successfully forged your weapon perfectly?"
Zhang Fei immediately showed Gang Zhishou the mortal-grade sword he had forged ten days earlier, as well as some rudimentary spirit-grade swords.
Gang Zhishou immediately snatched a rudimentary spirit-grade sword from Zhang Fei's hand. "Since when did you start learning to forge a spirit-grade sword?"

chapters.title: Chapter 627 Seven Profound Treasures
paragraphs: "I started learning to forge the spirit-grade weapon about ten days ago from an old friend, but I haven't managed to forge it to perfection yet."

Gang Zhishou gazed at Zhang Fei briefly before sharing his thoughts. "Actually, you shouldn't be disappointed with the results, especially considering your rapid progress as a beginner blacksmith. Moreover, this sword is almost perfect, and you only need to modify it a little, such as increasing the sharpness and thickness of the blade. If you can do that, you will successfully forge your first perfect spirit-grade weapon, and you will officially become a spirit-rank blacksmith."

"I see." Zhang Fei then stored all the swords before taking out an item that perplexed the Gang Zhishou, particularly because it didn't exist in the Nine Stars Realm. "In one realm, people call it a gun, and we need bullets to use it."
Zhang Fei, through his fifth clone, deliberately asked Huang Rong to find him the gun, especially since she had access to it.
"Guns and bullets?"

"Actually, I came from another realm, Old Gang." Gang Zhishou wasn't too surprised by that because the dishes in Zhang Fei's restaurant were completely different from the dishes in their realm, so he had long suspected that. "There are no cultivators in my realm, and my transformation into a cultivator was the result of a fortunate encounter. Ordinary people in my realm use this gun as a weapon, and it can easily kill others, but it will be useless against cultivators. That's why I want to make this kind of weapon, and I want to replace the normal bullets with Qi bullets."

"Let me see it." Zhang Fei immediately gave the gun to Gang Zhishou, who immediately scanned it with his senses. "I don't know how people in your home realm could create it, but it's really unique. Unfortunately, I don't have the ability to create the weapon you want, but my master or fellow disciples may be able to create one."
"Should we head to Senior Duan's place now?"

Gang Zhishou nodded and returned the gun to Zhang Fei. "My master also wants to see you, so we can go there now. However, it will take us a day's journey to get there, so you should finish your business first."
"I don't have any business, so we can leave now." Zhang Fei eagerly spoke.
Gang Zhishou promptly led him out of his shop, but Zhang Fei swiftly grabbed his shoulder and used the Nine Cloud Steps to take him away from the capital.

In a matter of minutes, they arrived in front of Duan Zhao's residence, which greatly shocked Zhishou Gang. "You kid! Your blacksmithing skills, along with your cultivation, body cultivation, and movement speed, are simply astounding! I usually fly here all day, but you have the ability to bring me here this fast."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "Old Gang, my movement ability is only a small part of my abilities."
Gang Zhishou softly sighed as he shook his head. "The young will always surpass the old, and you have proven that. Sooner or later, you will also surpass me in blacksmithing."

"Old Gang." Zhang Fei called out and patted Gang Zhishou's shoulder. "Even if I manage to surpass you in blacksmithing in the future, I will never forget your kindness because you were the one who taught me blacksmithing in the first place."

"Hahaha!" Gang Zhishou laughed and put his arm around Zhang Fei's shoulder, leading him into Duan Zhao's house. "I certainly did not misjudge your character, Kid. Let's go! My master is probably busy in the backyard right now, so he won't notice our arrival."
When Gang Zhishou and Zhang Fei arrived behind, they found Duan Zhao forging something. Meanwhile, his female disciple, Xian Xian, was watching from the sidelines.
"Oh?" Xian Xian immediately turned to them. "Is he the boy you mentioned back then?"

"His name is Zhang Fei, and I brought him here because he wants to create a unique weapon." Gang Zhishou introduced Xian Xian to Zhang Fei. "Her name is Xian Xian, and she is more active in the Zhou Kingdom."
"Nice to meet you, Senior Xian." Xian Xian suddenly moved in front of Zhang Fei and groped all over his body. 'This woman's grip is really strong!'

Xian Xian nodded repeatedly after she had touched Zhang Fei's body. "You really amaze me, Kid. Usually, a body cultivator needs two to three years to break through from the Skin Refining Stage to the Flesh Tempering Stage, but you can do it in a few months, and your body is much stronger than that of body cultivators at your level."

"Honestly, I don't know the exact measure of my body strength, and I am constantly tempering it using several methods." Xian Xian suddenly took out a small pillow-like item. "Is this a tool to measure my strength?"
Xian Xian nodded to him. "Use all your strength to hit him so I can measure your body strength."
"All right." Zhang Fei immediately took a stance, but he didn't use his enhanced condition ability or any other strengthening techniques; he directly punched the tool with all his strength.
*Bam*

"Guah!" Zhang Fei's single blow sent Xian Xian flying, causing Gang Zhishou's jaw to drop. Duan Zhao, who had been concentrating on forging, swiftly shifted his focus to his female disciple, who had already stabilized her body by stomping her feet on the ground. "What the hell with you, kid? How can your attack power be that heavy? What kind of methods do you use to train? Even Zhishou's attack couldn't knock me back a step."
Zhang Fei awkwardly smiled as he rubbed his head. "I train two body cultivation techniques, and one of them requires lightning tribulations to practice."
"Lightning tribulations?" Duan Zhao, Xian Xian, and Gang Zhishou were completely shocked by that.

"I experienced four lightning tribulations when I broke through to the 1-Star and 2-Star Earth Realm, and I underwent a hundred more tribulations in the Star Tower." Even so, Zhang Fei did not explain in detail the effects of his body cultivation techniques.
Duan Zhao, Xian Xian, and Gang Zhishou glared at Zhang Fei in shock. One lightning tribulation was already terrifying, but he actually went through a hundred of them.
"Have you really challenged the Star Tower?" Xian Xian doubtfully asked.

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Actually, I went to the Star Tower for the first time with a group from the Xian Imperial Sect two weeks ago, and I managed to pass all the challenges on the first floor. I faced a hundred lightning tribulations in the Sin Challenge, but they paled in comparison to the lightning tribulations I faced when I broke through."

Zhang Fei's answer left Xian Xian speechless, mainly because she needed several tries to complete all the challenges on the first floor, yet he was able to clear them all in just one try, and he completed them in just two weeks.
Duan Zhao then pointed to the big hammer lying on the ground. "Try lifting it, Kid."
"Master, that hammer—"
Duan Zhao shook his head at Xian Xian. "Try it, kid."
"All right." Zhang Fei immediately approached the hammer and held the handle. 'Oh? This hammer should weigh 5000 pounds.'
[You are right, Master. That hammer really does weigh 5000 pounds, but it's not a problem for you to lift it.]

'Yeah.' When he first came to the Nine Stars Realm, Zhang Fei did not want to show his strength to anyone. However, the situation slowly changed, and more and more people came to know of his strength; even several emperors from kingdoms started targeting him.

Zhang Fei's battles with Zhou Fang and Zhou Tong had already given him a lot of insight into his potential and strength, and their battles made him more confident in himself, so he decided to hide his strength no longer.
Without hesitation, Zhang Fei lifted the 5000-pound hammer and swung it, leaving Xian Xian dumbstruck while Gang Zhishou fell onto his butt.

"As expected." Duan Zhao muttered under his breath as he nodded in satisfaction with Zhang Fei's actions. "Your attack power should be equivalent to a cultivator at the Seven Divine Realms, and your body strength is higher than Xian Xian's, perhaps equivalent to a body cultivator at the Bone Forging Stage or higher."
"Is Zhang Fei's strength really that high, Master?"
"Do you still need to doubt it, Zhishou?" Duan Zhao responded with a frown. "You, Xian Xian, and the others can't even lift the hammer perfectly, yet he can swing it so easily."
Gang Zhishou and Xian Xian smiled bitterly at that, and they looked at Zhang Fei, who was still swinging the hammer in awe.
Duan Zhao then asked him. "What brought you here, Kid?"

Zhang Fei immediately put down the hammer and took out the gun, showing it to Duan Zhao. "This is a weapon from my home realm, but it is useless against cultivators, especially since it uses ordinary bullets. That's why I want to create a weapon similar to this, using my own Qi as the bullets."
Duan Zhao first scanned the gun before speaking to Zhang Fei. "Show me how to use it."
"All right." Zhang Fei then looked around before firing the gun at an empty can twice.
*Bang... Bang...*

The sound of the gunshot and the hole in the can shocked Xian Xian and Gang Zhishou. In contrast, Duan Zhao approached the can, picked it up, and examined the hole. "If I'm not mistaken, the bullet is made of steel filled with gunpowder and some other materials."
"Honestly, I don't understand how to make it, but the materials are more or less as you mentioned, Senior." Zhang Fei then asked him. "Can you create one with Qi as the bullet for me, Senior?"

Duan Zhao didn't dare to immediately agree with Zhang Fei because he had only seen the gun for the first time, but he already more or less understood how it worked. "I have to try it first, but I can't promise you that I will succeed in creating it, and I need a lot of time to determine the concept of the weapon. If I have the concept, I will ask Zhishou to contact you, and you can come to me again to discuss it."

"I don't need it in a hurry, so you can try creating it slowly, Senior." Duan Zhao nodded to Zhang Fei. "By the way, Old Gang told me once about a competition against blacksmiths from the Divine Flame Realm, and I am interested in joining that competition."

"It would be beneficial for you if you want to join that competition." Duan Zhao said as he nodded. "However, the competition is scheduled to take place in a month, and to participate, you must be able to forge at least a spirit-grade piece of equipment perfectly."
Zhang Fei nodded understandingly in response. "Don't worry, Senior. I will succeed in forging a perfect spirit-grade weapon before the competition takes place."

"That's good." Duan Zhao then spoke to his disciples. "You guys can go back to your respective places and prepare yourselves for the competition. You must win against your opponents, or I will punish you severely."
"We will return now, Master."
After they said goodbye to Duan Zhao, Gang Zhishou immediately led Zhang Fei away, but Xian Xian followed them and wanted to join them. "Hey! I'll go with you two to the Xian capital."
"Why do you want to go with us there?"
"Him." Xian Xian pointed at Zhang Fei. "I want to witness how he trains his body, as everything about him seems too absurd."

Zhang Fei smiled wryly at that. "Senior Xian, I don't train in the capital, but I train in another place. Regrettably, that location is off-limits to outsiders, so I am unable to take you there, lest my master in body cultivation punish me harshly."
"Can't you take me there?" Xian Xian was disappointed by Zhang Fei's shaking head. "All right, I won't force you to take me there, and we'll meet again in a month."
After that, Xian Xian took out her flying artifact and hurriedly flew towards the Zhou Kingdom, and Zhang Fei brought Gang Zhishou back to the Xian capital using the Nine Cloud Steps.
Inside the house, Duan Zhao immediately took out some parchment and began sketching the weapon that Zhang Fei wanted, excited to create something he had never seen before.
After they arrived in the Xian capital, Zhang Fei rushed to the Sky Jade Shop, and Gang Zhishou began his training inside his shop.

When he arrived, Zhang Fei saw that his shop was filled with customers, many of whom came from other kingdoms. He immediately thought of opening a branch of his restaurant and shop in the Yun Kingdom, but he had to go there first to meet Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua.

Zhang Fei rushed to the alchemy room and contacted Yun Xinyue directly, but the Yun Princess told him that she was on her way to the Xian Kingdom. 'Since they will be here soon, I will wait for them to talk to Guo Xuehua about my plan.'

Mei suddenly reminded Zhang Fei. [Master, you still haven't opened the reward for the quest to open a shop and the reward for clearing the first floor of the Star Tower.] (A/N: Actually, I forgot about these two quests, and I just added them in chapters 608 and 609.)
'Oh, that's right; you can open both, Mei.'
[You obtained a fragment of an old map.]
[You obtained one of the seven profound treasures: the Sealed World Pearl.]
Zhang Fei immediately took the two items from the inventory, but the old map fragment immediately shot into his body through his forehead.
[Ding]
[The host obtained a 1/6 map fragment of the Temple of Forgotten Flames.]

'Temple of Forgotten Flames?' Zhang Fei wondered to himself as he tried to see the map in his consciousness, but it only showed a portion of the entire map, so he couldn't find out the location. 'Sigh; forget it then. I'll wait until I obtain the remaining five fragments, but I don't know where to find the rest, or if they are rewards from the upcoming quests.'
Zhang Fei then observed that the white pearl in his hand was as large as a tennis ball. 'Do you have any information about the seven profound treasures, Mei?'
[I will display the list for you, Master.]
[Seven Profound Treasures]
1. Heaven And Earth Pagoda
2. Ancient Void Gate
3. Mirror of Eternity
4. Sky-Severing Sword
5. Lotus of Annihilation
6. Mystic Jade Cauldron
7. Sealed World Pearl
'Hmm? The Sealed World Pearl is ranked seventh, huh? What is the use of this pearl? Are there any details about the other treasure?'
[Unfortunately, the system does not explain the details of each treasure, Master. As for the Sealed World Pearl, you can try dripping your blood on it.]

Zhang Fei immediately tried it, and the Sealed World Pearl sparkled as he dripped his blood on it. In a few seconds, it immediately shot into his forehead, and some information appeared in his mind. 'Oh? What a marvelous treasure! Only the first of its five features has been unlocked, and there is no method for unlocking the others.'
[Are you going to check it now, Master?]

'No.' Zhang Fei immediately took out his alchemy furnace. 'We are in a public place, and my clones are busy dual soul cultivating. Moreover, Guo Xuehua and the others will be here soon, so I will try to check after we get back.'

After that, Zhang Fei took out the ingredients to concoct the rank 3 Bone Mending Pill, and he wanted to concoct it perfectly as soon as possible. He was confident that this concoction would unlock the level three alchemy feature, which would enable him to access even more useful pill recipes.
Since dawn, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the two women had already dug up so many precious stones in Shang Xiaoyin's secret place, so they decided to stop.
"What are we going to do about them?" Shang Yaolin asked as she pointed at Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin.

"We must bring them back to our residence so that people won't be too suspicious." Zhang Xialong [3] then said to Shang Xinyu. "Big Sis, I'll send you to the Azure Sky Realm again, and I'll bring you back after the situation in this realm is more conducive."
"All right."

paragraphs: A while later, they had arrived at the Shang Clan residence. Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately sent the two men to Shang Baishi's room, and he brought Shang Yaolin back to their room afterward.
"Phew! Digging up so many precious stones is really tiring." Shang Yaolin made this comment as she undressed and lay down on the bed. "What pill did you give Xiaoyin before, Long'er?"
"A pregnancy pill." Shang Yaolin immediately looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in shock. "If the pill works, then Shang Xiaoyin will be pregnant with Shang Baishi's child."

"Hahaha!" Shang Yaolin laughed at the thought. "You are really crazy, Long'er! However, I like your idea, and Shang Ziyuan will be enraged if she finds out her little brother impregnated her only daughter. Such an incident has never occurred within my Shang Clan, and it could potentially damage their reputation among other members of the main clan."

"My parents always told me that I should dare to act cruelly towards anyone who has evil intentions towards me. Given that Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin harbored evil intentions towards us, I deliberately did that." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then took off his clothes, got into bed, and lifted Shang Yaolin onto his lap. "Big Sis, I know you're tired, but I want to dual soul cultivate with you. Senior Hun Di will arrive in this realm tomorrow, but my soul power hasn't broken through to the Earthly Soul level, so I have to increase it before he arrives."

"I have to do my task, but Senior Sister Yingyue should be able to understand it, so let's do it now." Shang Yaolin embraced Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s neck as they released their souls. However, her expression became confused when she noticed the presence of dozens of white lotus buds in Zhang Xiaolong's soul, particularly since these buds weren't there during their previous dual soul cultivation. "Where do those lotus buds come from, Long'er?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] put on a pretended confused look. "Big Sis, this is my first time seeing them, so I don't know how they could appear in my soul."
"That's weird." Shang Yaolin silently observed them. "You should ask Senior Brother Liangren or Senior Sister Yingyue about them, lest something happen to your soul."
"Okay, I'll consult with them later, but let's get started right away." Shang Yaolin moaned as Zhang Xiaolong [3] used the enhanced demon touch, and his dick swiftly penetrated her buttocks.
However, they did not engage in sexual activity, and they quickly channeled their Yin and Yang Qi into their bodies and souls, immersing them in dual soul cultivation.

"Sure, I'll join you guys." Aqua immediately agreed.

paragraphs: 'This capital city is truly magnificent and beautiful!' That was what Yuhe and the others thought as soon as they arrived at the Natural Race's royal capital.

Despite the beauty of their fairy forest in the Sky Jade Realm, they felt it fell short of the grandeur of the royal capital of the Natural Race. Furthermore, the diversity of races living there surpasses that of their forest, including pixies, giants, druids, nymphs, and several others.
Even the elves in the city were divided into two: one was an ordinary elf like Elmyra, and the other was a high elf like Xian Jinglan and her parents.
Xian Jinglan then asked them. "Are you all willing to stay at the royal palace?"

They exchanged glances for a moment before Yuhe answered Xian Jinglan. "Please forgive us, Princess. We are accustomed to living in the forest with our race's members, so the atmosphere of the kingdom is unfamiliar to us. Moreover, we need to inform our leader about the current situation in this kingdom, so we plan to stay in town and observe it."

"If you guys want it that way, I won't force you to stay in the royal palace. Instead of staying in an inn, I will take you to a house that is rarely used." Xian Jinglan then led them towards a house a little away from the hustle and bustle of the city. "For the time being, you can stay in this house, and you can look at the buildings in this town. If you find a suitable building, and Zhang Fei agrees with it, then you can contact me directly, and I will take care of everything."
"Thank you, Princess."
Once the house guard led Yuhe and the others into the house, Xian Jinglan immediately turned to Aqua and inquired. "Shall we go to the palace?"
"Haha." Aqua laughed softly. "It's been years since I came to this capital, and I haven't seen your parents for a long time, so I'll visit them now."
"They must be happy with your arrival, Miss Aqua."
"Jinglan, I'll go back to my house first, or my mother will nag at me."
After Xi Xianzi left, Xian Jinglan led Aqua to the royal palace. "How do you know them?"

"Yuhe is an undine like me, and she can sense my underwater city. She chose to explore underwater, but the barrier of my city drew her in. She has been living with me ever since, and she took me to meet her friends three days ago." Aqua then asked Xian Jinglian. "Who exactly is Zhang Fei? I've never heard them mention his name before, so I was surprised to hear them acknowledge him as their leader."

"According to my father, Zhang Fei is a heavenly fox." Xian Jinglan's answer surprised Aqua. "At first, I didn't believe it, but he already showed his heavenly fox form when I met him at the Star Tower. His cultivation is in the 2-Star Earth Realm, yet his strength surpasses it, and his speed surpasses that of cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms. Even if my father uses his top speed and wind law, he may not be able to keep up with his speed."
"Are you serious about that? How can a cultivator at the ten mortal realms surpass your father's speed?" Aqua asked in disbelief.

"I don't know how Zhang Fei trained his strength and speed, but that's the truth. He managed to defeat Zhou Fang in the battle challenge, even though his opponent's cultivation had reached the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm." Xian Jinglan's statement left Aqua in a daze. "Anyway, the situation in the Star Tower is much different from the past, and we met many strange beasts inside. According to him, those strange beasts are chimeras, and they are the creation of humans."
Aqua turned to Xian Jinglan in shock. "How is it possible for humans to create beasts?"

paragraphs: "Oh?" Guo Xuehua turned to Zhang Fei, who had just arrived. "Your cultivation has reached the 2-Star Earth Realm, and your body cultivation has broken through to the Flesh Tempering Stage; even your soul power seems to be on the verge of breaking through."

"Princess Xinyue must have told you a lot about me, right?" Guo Xuehua nodded to Zhang Fei. "My cultivation broke through in the tower, and I cultivated my body in another realm. As for my soul power, I will probably break through to the Earthly Soul Level tonight."
"In that case, schedule a time to visit my Guo Clan, where you can cultivate your body in our lightning pond." Guo Xuehua then asked. "May I see the pill you just concocted?"

Zhang Fei took out the rank 3 bone mending pill and handed it to her. "Empress Guo, I actually plan to go to your Guo Clan to train at the lightning pond soon, and I also plan to open a branch of my restaurant and shop in the Yun Capital."

"Oh?" Guo Xuehua was surprised by Zhang Fei's plan to open a branch of my restaurant and shop in her kingdom. "If you truly desire this, feel free to visit our kingdom and select the building of your choice. Our capital is not as crowded as the Xian capital because our kingdom is the smallest of the five kingdoms, and our population is smaller, so your shop and restaurant may not make as much money."

Zhang Fei shook his head. "Your Yun kingdom may not be as big as the other five, but it borders the Zhou Kingdom directly. Ever since our shop opened, Lingxue has noticed that only a few buyers come from that kingdom, especially since it is located in the north, and the terrain they have to cross to get here is not easy. That's why I want to open a branch in your kingdom, so your people don't have to travel here to buy my goods, and I can also get buyers from the Zhou Kingdom."

Guo Xuehua nodded in understanding. "However, the alchemy union still exists in my kingdom, and selling pills at your branch could lead to a direct clash with them. Wei Chao is more aggressive than Lian Jinshu, and his subordinates are also stronger than Huan Ya and the others."
"How does Wei Chou's strength compare to Cheng Feng's?"

"Wei Chou is stronger than my husband and me, with his cultivation being at the 1-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm." Guo Xuehua's answer surprised Zhang Fei. "The alchemy union sent him because they knew that the Zhou and Huangfu kept their eyes on our kingdom, and they had interests in our kingdom, so people from both kingdoms would not be able to interfere with their interests."
"If Wei Chou dares to bother us, we'll just have to ask Big Sis Yao to suppress their higher-ups one more time, husband." Guo Xuehua simply smiled after Zhang Lingxue said that.

Zhang Fei agreed with that. "Even so, I would rather not look for trouble with Wei Chou, at least for the time being. We will just sell other goods at our branch, and I think they are enough for us to earn a lot of income."

"Well, that's true." Zhang Lingxue nodded in response. "Compared to pills, those items from your home realm sell much better in our store since they don't exist in this realm. Moreover, you will also open a branch in the Natural Race Kingdom soon, so I think they're enough for now."
"Are you guys really going to open a branch in the Natural Race Kingdom?" Guo Xuehua asked in shock.

"Yes." Zhang Fei did not hide it from Guo Xuehua. "Some of my people have been living in their kingdom since we arrived, and Xian Lianghua has been aware of their presence since the beginning. Moreover, I met Xian Jinglan in the tower, and she must have told her father about me, so he deliberately sent her to meet them and bring them to their royal capital. Given their desire to build a relationship with me, I will seize this opportunity and establish my second branch in their capital."

"Since Xian Lianghua has given you such an opportunity, I think it's good for you." Guo Xuehua then warned Zhang Fei. "I can understand your desire to become strong, but you should not act like a madman by going to the top of Cyanwood Mountain. Even with my cultivation and understanding of the lightning element law, I still can't get close to that place, and you will die if you go there."

paragraphs: When he arrived at the shop, Zhang Fei found that Fa Zhen had already finished his research. "Why did you look for me earlier?"
"Old Fa, do you have a portable formation array for trapping?"
"Hmm?" Fa Zhen raised his eyebrows for a moment. "Did you encounter a powerful enemy that required one?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei then told Fa Zhen about his enemies. "Honestly, I have confidence in my abilities, especially my ability to escape. However, I can't possibly run away from them all the time, so I need something to deal with them, especially if they gang up on me."

Fa Zhen stared at Zhang Fei for some time before shaking his head. "Your relationship with Xian Feng and his family has already given you a lot of trouble, and your troubles will increase if Huangfu Shou or Zhou Xiaochuan decide to step in directly to deal with you."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed wryly in response. "My issues with those people originated from my interactions with Emperor Xian and his family, and they escalated following my performance in the Star Tower. I managed to complete all the challenges on the first floor, so they started targeting me. Some wanted to kill me, while others wanted to control me, so I was left with no choice but to fight them."

"I didn't expect you to be able to clear the first floor of the Star Tower with your current cultivation, but I'm not too surprised at your results there." Fa Zhen then took out an array and placed it on the table. "This is a portable illusion formation array, and all the enemies trapped in it will face a real illusion based on their strength."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei took it straight away. "How long will the effect last?"
"The illusion disappears after an hour, so use your time wisely to defeat them." Fa Zhen then asked him. "How is your progress in formation arrays?"

"I'm still busy with my alchemy and blacksmithing, so I haven't made any progress in formation arrays." Zhang Fei's answer made Fa Zhen let out a heavy sigh. "Currently, I can concoct rank 3 pills, and I'm almost at the point of successfully forging a perfect spirit-grade weapon. After this, I'll start focusing on formation arrays."

"Oh?" Fa Zhen was surprised by that. "I've seen the items in your shop, and most of your pills are much better than the alchemy union in terms of effects and grade. However, I'm sure you weren't the one who concocted them, and it was your wife who concocted them, right?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to him. "I have only been studying alchemy for about a month, so her alchemy skills are much better than mine."

"Your talent is too terrifying, so I shouldn't be surprised if Huangfu Shou or Zhou Xiaochuan wants to kill or control you." Fa Zhen released a heavy sigh before continuing. "You've managed to become a grandmaster alchemist in just a month, which is already impressive, and you will also become a spirit-rank blacksmith after you successfully forge a spirit-grade weapon. As for your array master rank, you should have reached rank 4 due to your successful creation of the intermediate-high grade Heavenly Qi Convergence Array. However, to advance to rank 5, you will need to master the creation of an advanced-entry grade array."
"Do you have an advanced-entry grade array for me to study, Old Fa?" Zhang Fei asked in expectation.

"I have some." Fa Zhen answered with a nod. "However, you can't possibly create one with your current cultivation, especially since your qi won't be sufficient to activate all the materials needed, and you must first reach the Heaven Realm to be able to create one. Once you reach that stage, I will teach you about it, and you can try creating it then."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "In that case, I will focus on pursuing my cultivation to reach the Heaven Realm so I can start studying it. How much does this portable illusion formation array cost?"
"Just take it."

"Eh?" Zhang Fei was surprised by that, especially since Xian Feng and the others said that Fa Zhen was too stingy. However, he immediately took out several bottles containing his basic pills from the system shop before giving them to him. "Old Fa, I know you have swallowed basic pills before, but these are different from the common ones. That's why you can swallow them again, and you will definitely experience good changes in your cultivation foundation."

"All right, I'll accept them." After Zhang Fei left the shop, Fa Zhen immediately opened one of the bottles, and his eyes widened when he saw the superior-grade Meridian Cleansing Pill. "Where did he get these pills? Although I haven't swallowed them, I'm sure their effects are much better than the ones I've swallowed in the past."
After that, Fa Zhen hurriedly closed his shop and went to the back room, where he began to swallow the pills.

A while later, Zhang Fei arrived at the Sky Jade Restaurant and talked with Zhu Yan about his plans to open a branch restaurant in the Yun Kingdom. "Do you want to send me to that kingdom? If I go there, you can ask your mother or grandma to manage this restaurant."

"I won't send you to the Yun Kingdom." Zhang Fei's answer confused Zhu Yan. "I will install a teleportation device in this restaurant, and it will connect this place to the branch. That way, we don't need to hire a chef for the restaurant there, and we can handle everything from here. However, you can't possibly manage two restaurants at once, so I'll send my mother here to help you."

Zhu Yan immediately agreed with Zhang Fei's idea. "As long as your mother or grandmother helps me in this restaurant, I don't have a problem with that. Aren't you afraid that those people will find out about your teleportation device?"

"My teleportation device consists of two parts, so it doesn't matter if they discover the one in the Yun Kingdom. If that happens, we can simply destroy the one in this restaurant." Zhang Fei then looked at the five members of the demon fox group. "We will use people from our group as waitresses, and they will work as our spies as well."
"All right, you can tell me when you are ready to implement your plans."

Since the sun had set and there were no more customers in the restaurant, Zhang Fei asked Zhu Yan to close it. He then took Liu Hua and the Wen Twins to their shop, and after picking up Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters, they immediately returned to their residence.
