"Mother, Xianqin lives in Zhang Fei's residence and has entered seclusion." Yun Xinyue answered her mother.
"I see." Guo Xuehua then asked. "Does that mean you two have approved their relationship?"

Shi Qingzhuang smiled at her question. "Sister Xuehua, Zhang Fei indeed has many wives and partners by his side, and his relationships are also quite messy, but we cannot deny that he is the best man of his generation. Since my daughter has chosen to accept his relationship, we have decided to approve it. Unfortunately, their relationship won't be moving to the next stage anytime soon, so we still have to wait to make it official."
"You are right; Zhang Fei is indeed the best in his generation." Guo Xuehua then turned to her daughter. "What about you? What did you two talk about before?"

Yun Xinyue lowered her face and replied in a low tone. "I find it challenging to accept Zhang Fei's relationships with some of them, but I can't deny my feelings, so I've already confessed to him that I like him. He offered me to live with them in his residence in the hope that I would accept their relationship, and I have accepted his offer."

Guo Xuehua, Li Yao, and Yun Aoxian were surprised by Yun Xinyue's decision. Unlike them, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang were not surprised by her decision, and they even supported it, but they had no right to say anything about it.
"Are you really going to live with them, Xinyue?" Li Yao asked her sister-in-law.

"Yes." Yun Xinyue replied with a nod. "At first, I thought that Zhang Fei had an interest in me because of my face, body, or status. However, I realized that all his wives were much better than me in every aspect, and he didn't care about my status as a princess, so I decided to stay with them for the time being."

Li Yao nodded in agreement. "I've never met Zhang Fei's other wives, but the three women in his shop are incredibly beautiful, and their beauty really makes me jealous. Even though he is the best of his generation, I still feel that he is not worthy to be your husband, especially since you have to share him with numerous women."

"I think you should reconsider your decision, Xinyue." Yun Aoxian also spoke to persuade his little sister. "Zhang Fei's wives are simply too numerous, and I don't believe that he can treat them all fairly. I'm afraid that if he ends up showing favoritism among them, you will be marginalized if that happens, which will only make you suffer."

Yun Xinyue let out a soft sigh and looked at them. "Big brother! Sister-in-law! I know you are thinking of my good, but I don't want to give up on my feelings and try to accept Zhang Fei's relationship first. Moreover, he told me that he would never force me to become his woman if I couldn't accept his relationship after we lived together long enough, so I will bury my feelings if that happens, and I will move on with my life."
"Are you sure about your decision, Xinyue?" Guo Xuehua asked.
Yun Xinyue nodded, her face filled with determination. "I am sure about my decision, Mother."

Guo Xuehua slightly nodded in response. "Since you have decided, I will allow you to stay with Zhang Fei. Regardless of the outcome, I hope you will not regret your decision. If you cannot accept his relationship, you should move forward with your life."
"Yes, Mother."

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei brought all his official wives and several of his unofficial women, such as the Wen Twins, Xu Ling'er, Guo Lan, Lin Dong'er, and Mu Lingshu, into the cloud mansion.

Without wasting time, Zhang Fei began to dual-cultivate and dual-soul-cultivate with all his official wives again. He was only dual-soul-cultivated with his unofficial woman who had broken through to the soul realm.
Zhang Fei instructed his unofficial women, who had not yet reached the Soul Realm, to cultivate with his Yang Qi in order to accelerate their advancement.

Since Shang Yaolin was exhausted after digging those precious stones and dual soul cultivating with him for so long, Zhang Xiaolong [3] let him rest first. He then went to the mountaintop, where Shang Yingyue and Qiao Liangren were already waiting for him.

"Long'er, our master will arrive in this realm tomorrow night." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding before taking a seat in front of them, but Qiao Liangren immediately questioned him. "What exactly happened to your soul? How did those dozens of white lotus buds appear in your soul?"
"Eh?" Qiao Liangren's question surprised Zhang Xiaolong [3].

Shang Yingyue spoke directly to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "At first, I was looking for you and Yaolin to ask about the fate of Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, but I found you dual soul cultivating with her, and I accidentally saw those white lotus buds in your soul."

"Honestly, I have a soul technique that my mother gave me in the past, and I started practicing it three days ago. To practice it, I have to use Yin Qi and Yang Qi together, so I used the Yin Qi of many women that Aunt Qianying gave me. At first, there was only one lotus bud, but their number continued to increase every time I cultivated my soul."
"Can you tell us the name of the technique?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded and told them, " The technique is called the Lotus Ascension Art, but I don't know where my mother got it from."
"Have you heard of that technique before, Senior Brother?"

Qiao Liangren shook his head at Shang Yingyue. "There are countless soul cultivators in the universe, and many of them have their soul techniques. However, our master may have heard of it, so we will ask him tomorrow. Anyway, I'll be back now, so you can start dual soul cultivating with Long'er, especially since his soul power is already on the verge of breaking through."
After Qiao Liangren disappeared, Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked Shang Yingyue. "Do you want to learn that technique, Senior Sister?"

"No." Shang Yingyue immediately released her soul, followed by Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Not all techniques suit everyone, and I am already satisfied with the soul techniques given to me by my master. Let's get started so your soul power can break through, and you will be ready to meet my master."

When it was almost midnight, Huangfu Lian's entourage finally arrived at the outermost border of the Xian Kingdom. The Huangfu Prince hurriedly landed his flying artifact, led the three women down, and stored it. "Yunjie and Cunhua, you two go straight to the Xian Capital, and you must be very careful when infiltrating there, lest Xian Feng or his aides catch you."
"Yes!"

After the two women left, Huangfu Lian immediately grabbed Ling Long's hand and activated his concealment artifact. The two quickly left the area, but they took a slight detour because they had received information that Zhang Fei always appeared from the south.
Unbeknownst to them, several people were watching them from afar. Some immediately moved to follow Xuan Cunhua and Ming Yunjie, and others followed Huangfu Lian and Ling Long.

chapters.title: Chapter 632 Earthly Soul Level
paragraphs: Old Feng suddenly appeared behind Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang. "Emperor, Huangfu Lian and the three women have entered our kingdom. Xuan Cunhua and Ming Yunjie are on their way here, and they will probably arrive at dawn. The Huangfu Prince and Ling Long are turning south, and their target seems to be Zhang Fei."

"I see." Xian Feng nodded in understanding. "Old Feng, you can let Xuan Cunhua and Ming Yunjie sneak into my daughter's room. Once they become trapped in the formation, you can capture them. Zhang Fei appears to have plans for Huangfu Lian and Ling Long, so you should direct our men to monitor them, instructing them to act only if he is unable to defeat them."
"Yes, Emperor."
After Old Feng vanished, Shi Qingzhuang questioned her husband. "What do you think Zhang Fei's plans are for Huangfu Lian and Ling Long?"

"Zhang Fei will probably enslave Huangfu Lian, just like Ximen Yan. However, I am skeptical that he will do that, particularly given his lack of knowledge about the mysterious man behind Huangfu Shou. If that person could see his slave mark, it would only increase the danger to both him and us." Xian Feng then directed his gaze far away, specifically toward the south. "I can't guess his plans for Ling Long, as he didn't enslave Huan Ya and Zhou Meiling, but I still don't understand how he can make both women obey him and our daughter."

Shi Qingzhuang agreed with her husband. "Huan Ya is clearly still conscious, but she is obedient to Zhang Fei. I don't know where he hid Zhou Meiling, but our daughter said that she was completely obedient to her, even though she still had her consciousness."

"Sigh." Xian Feng released a soft sigh in response to that. "We've been looking for ways to fight back against those emperors, but we can't do anything against them. The situation began to shift after Zhang Fei's arrival, and some of them have fallen into his hands. I heard that Zhou Tai was dead, but no one knew the killer, and his corpse was left in the Star Tower. Zhou Fang and Zhou Meiling are under his control, and Zhou Shenxin might also fall into his hands soon, but they are just tools for Zhou Xiaochuan."

"Although there is still no change in the situation in the Bai Kingdom, Zhang Fei has already sent Bai Yaowei's three children to another realm, which is no different from weakening their kingdom because he and Linghu Yincheng have no other children." Xian Feng nodded to Shi Qingzhuang, who immediately continued. "Ximen Yan has become his slave, and Changyue has informed me that he has taken action against Ximen Yueliang, putting the two demon kingdoms under his control. If Huangfu Lian and Ling Long also fall into his hands, it means all our enemies are under his control."

Xian Feng directly added to his wife's words. "Not to mention, people from the beast and natural races also want to establish good relations with Zhang Fei, so he will be the only person who has connections with all the kingdoms in our realm. That's why I decided from the start to be on his side, especially since he's too scary with his three identities, and my decision proved to be the right one."
"Yeah."
"Let's get some rest, wife."
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts in the Earth realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was cultivating his soul with Shang Yingyue's help, was unconcerned when the two notifications appeared.
*Bang*
A loud bang suddenly sounded from the mountaintop, accompanied by a powerful surge of soul power, which came from Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul.

Shang Yingyue, who realized this, immediately prepared to draw her Yin back from Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul, especially since her soul was about to break through to the Earthly Soul Level. However, his soul began to absorb her Yin Qi at an increasingly rapid pace, rendering her unable to withdraw it.

In a few moments, dozens of people were already standing around the mountaintop, especially since the surge of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul could be felt throughout the northern island and even as far away as the western and eastern islands.
Fortunately, the demihumans and beasts from the western and eastern islands avoided direct contact with humans, primarily because they originated from the Red Sun Realm, located in the upper realms.

Qiao Liangren, who had previously returned to his residence, was forced to return to the mountaintop. He was worried that cultivators from the other clans, especially those who lived in the northern and eastern areas, would attack Zhang Xiaolong [3] while he was having his soul breakthrough.

Murong Mengying also appeared at Qiao Liangren's side. Her eyes stared at the crowd of cultivators from the northern and eastern areas. In an instant, her body released a faint aura, forcing the cultivators from both areas to fly backward. However, they remained in place and continued to pay attention to Zhang Xiaolong [3].

Since his wife was assisting Zhang Xiaolong [3], Wu Xueming couldn't possibly remain silent at the arrival of those people around them. Therefore, he went to the mountaintop and stood behind Shang Yingyue, holding a black saber in his right hand.

Unexpectedly, several other people also surrounded the two of them to protect them, surprising most of them. They were Miao Miao of the Miao Clan, Lai Minhua of the Lai Clan, and a middle-aged man from the Tie Clan, who Tie Xuan assigned to protect Zhang Xiaolong [3].

The cultivators from the northern and eastern areas raised their eyebrows slightly at Miao Miao and the others' attitudes, but they said nothing and focused their attention on Zhang Xiaolong [3]. One of them looked curiously at the dozens of white lotus buds within his soul, and they began to bloom as he continued to absorb Shang Yingyue's Yin Qi.
As time passed, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul fluctuations became more intense and violent as the dozens of white lotus buds began to bloom, and a petal began to open on each of them.
*Swoosh*

After five petals opened under the dozens of white lotus buds, a few bright white lights suddenly shot out from Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul before shooting into the sky. Those white lights quickly converged and formed a giant white lotus, which revolved above the night sky. The dazzling brilliance radiating from it caused the dim and dark sky to regain its brightness once again.

All of them suddenly raised their heads, looking at the giant white lotus in shock and awe. However, only one person among the dozens realized its meaning, which indicated that Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul would soon break through to the Earthly Soul Level.

Despite this, Qiao Liangren harbored many questions about how those dozens of white lotus buds appeared inside Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul, especially since they utilized Shang Yingyue's Yin Qi to bloom.

Moreover, Qiao Liangren could feel that Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s Yang Qi was continuously flowing out of those lotus buds and entering Shang Yingyue's soul, and they were strengthening her soul. 'As expected, Long'er was indeed the right choice to be Yingyue's soul cultivation partner, and his soul breakthrough had a significant impact on her soul, allowing her soul to break through as well.'

"Even though Senior Brother Liangren lied to me, I am still grateful for it, or else my soul power would not have been broken through this fast. However, my journey on the soul cultivation path is still long ahead, and I must continue to strive hard to reach Senior Hun Di's level."

Moreover, I can feel that you and your clone are completely identical, and I have never seen such a clone technique before."

'Dang! I didn't expect her to have such a technique! Even you and the system couldn't detect this eye, Mei.' The female AI was speechless in response to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Why don't you reveal my clone to them, Senior Sister?"

After removing the eye, Murong Mengying first sat at the foot of the bed, crossed her right leg over the other, and propped her chin up. "Before I tell you about my goal, I want to hear about your true self. You may still doubt me, but I really have no ill intentions toward you. Instead, I can provide you with a lot of help, but I won't help you if I don't know the real you, so you can tell me the truth."

sentences.text: Old Feng suddenly appeared behind Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang.
"Emperor, Huangfu Lian and the three women have entered our kingdom.

Zhou Fang and Zhou Meiling are under his control, and Zhou Shenxin might also fall into his hands soon, but they are just tools for Zhou Xiaochuan."

"Yeah."

chapters.title: Chapter 633 With Murong Mengying
paragraphs: "Do you expect me to tell you everything, Senior Sister?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] then pulled the chair from the side toward him and took a seat in front of Murong Mengying. "You've been watching me since I arrived in this realm, but I don't know anything about you. By the way, you don't need to think about restricting my movements or threatening me, especially since you won't be able to capture me, and I'm not that afraid of them."
"Haha." Murong Mengying softly laughed. "As expected, you are a cunning grown man, but I wonder how you can be this confident."

"My cultivation is still in the Earth Realm, but I've trained myself so hard since I started cultivating, especially my speed." Zhang Xiaolong [3] suddenly vanished from her sight, and Murong Mengying looked around the room to no avail. A few seconds later, he returned to his chair, leaving her stunned. "My cultivation is far below yours, but my speed is superior to yours. Despite being in such a small room, you are unable to see my movements."
"No wonder you are so confident." Murong Mengying commented with a slight nod. "Even my master might not be able to see your movements."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled at that. "There are so many powerful cultivators, and I am afraid of death, so I have been relentlessly honing my speed to escape from them. If you want to know about me, I want a guarantee that you will not tell anyone. Furthermore, your objectives may not align with mine, and your information may not be useful to me."
"What kind of guarantee do you want from me?" Murong Mengying casually asked.
"Let me implant my soulmark in your soul." Murong Mengying immediately released her soul, surprising Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Are you sure about this?"
"Do it."
"All right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately stood in front of Murong Mengying, released his soul, and touched her soul.

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a cunning fox, and he did not completely trust Murong Mengying. Moreover, her master was clearly a powerful cultivator from the upper realms, and her master might have a way to remove his soul mark from her soul.

Unbeknownst to Murong Mengying, Zhang Xiaolong [3] used his soul manipulation ability and replicated her soul. He merged her soul replica with his own so he could control her like Hu Qiaomu and the Amaris Twins without worrying about her master, and he could also get a lot of information from her memories.

"Done." Both of them immediately put their souls into their bodies again, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] returned to his seat. He then used his body modification ability to restore his bone age, surprising Murong Mengying. "You should be able to detect it, right? My true age is 20 years old, and my real name is Zhang Fei. As for this body, this is one of my clones."

"Eh?" Murong Mengxin was shocked to hear that the person in front of her was just a clone, especially since she always thought that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was his real body. "Where did you get such a perfect clone technique?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded with a shake of his head. "I didn't use a clone technique, but I used my demon abilities to create my clones. My real body is in another realm with all my wives and family, but I won't tell you about it, especially since each of us has our own affairs."

"No wonder you're not too afraid of your identity being exposed, especially since this is just your clone, and you can retract it whenever you want." Murong Mengying then questioned Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "What is your goal in infiltrating the Shang Clan?"
"Shang Huaqiang."
Murong Mengying was surprised by that. "Why are you targeting Shang Huaqiang?"

"You know about his actions in the Netherworld Realm, right?" Murong Mengying nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "The realm he targeted was my first realm, and I started my cultivation path there. Additionally, several of my wives came from that realm, and Shang Huaqiang's actions have caused several of them to suffer. The father of my two wives died because of him, and his death was a heavy blow to them. They couldn't find his corpse because he died in another realm, so they were forced to use his personal belongings to build a grave for him. My brother-in-law and sister-in-law have turned into demons, preventing them from returning to our realm to reunite with their families."

"You have so many wives, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] just smiled, causing Murong Mengying to shake her head. "What about Shang Yaolin? She is a good girl, but you have deceived her to such an extent, and you have also had sex with her too many times."

"Shang Yaolin is a good girl, but she is Shang Huaqiang's accomplice. She and Shang Guangming assisted him during that incident, which made them my enemies. I will crush all my enemies without mercy." Murong Mengying narrowed her eyes at Zhang Xiaolong [3], and she could see the seriousness in his gaze. "I originally didn't have any problems with Murong Qianying, but she insisted on controlling me, and you knew the rest of the story."

Murong Mengying nodded in response. "Aunt Qiangying always thought that controlling others was the best solution to everything, and she did not hesitate to use her two daughters as tools to fulfill her ambitions. Regrettably, a cunning fox such as yourself deceived her, leading the three of them to fall into your trap. Speaking of this matter, Hong Xinxin was on the same boat as my aunt, and she brought Shang Yumei to the Huo Clan to get the potion, which didn't work on you. Does that mean you will also take action against her?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] answered without hesitation. "Hong Xinxin and Shang Guangming are my enemies, so I will do something about them. However, I can't do it openly, and I will do everything slowly without them knowing."

"Aunt Qiangying holds complete control over our Murong Clan; since she has fallen into your hands, our clan has also fallen into your hands." Murong Mengying thought for a while before continuing. "Hong Xinxin does have a strong influence on the Hong Clan, but the control of the clan is still in the hands of her grandfather. Even so, you can still influence the clan if you manage to make her fall into your arms, and her clan is more beneficial than our Murong Clan."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was slightly surprised by her answer about the Hong Clan. "Does this mean you want me to take over that clan? Why do I feel that you are so indifferent about your Murong Clan?"

"I do want you to take over the Hong Clan." Murong Mengying admitted it directly. "However, you won't be able to do it now, and you have to raise your cultivation to the Seven Divine Realms first. Regarding my Murong Clan, I hold it in high regard and care about it more than my aunt. However, certain events have led me to realize that our clan's destruction is imminent. paragraphs: Zhang Fei's question made Huangfu Lian realize that something was wrong, so he immediately contacted Ming Yunjie and Xuan Cunhua, but to no avail. He then glanced at his fiancée and informed her of the situation. 'They've fallen into the trap.'
Ling Long raised her eyebrows slightly. 'What should we do now? Should we run away now? Since they have fallen into the trap, I am sure that people from the Xian Kingdom are hiding around here.'

'I will try to talk to him first, and we will run away if my attempt to persuade him fails.' Ling Long immediately agreed to Huangfu Lian because there was no way they could immediately run away, or Huangfu Shou would punish them.

Huangfu Lian looked left and right as he carefully walked over to Zhang Fei, but his returning jade was already in his hands. This way, if the enemies suddenly surrounded them, he could escape directly.
Ling Long remained vigilant, holding her returned jade in her right hand, and her eyes never stopped monitoring the area around them.

Huangfu Lian maintained a distance from Zhang Fei, not approaching him too closely. "Brother, I came here on behalf of my father, and he offered you to join us. If you are willing to join us, we will give you anything you want, be it women, cultivation resources, or anything else."

"Does that mean you are willing to give Ling Long to me?" Zhang Fei's question caused Huangfu Lian to stiffen, and his face darkened. "I haven't been in this realm for too long, but I already have a deep understanding of the situation. Do you think I am that stupid to join forces with a person who prefers to control other people? Do you think I didn't know that Huangfu Shou wanted to control me in order to fulfill his ambition of taking over the Xian Kingdom? Your fiancée is not bad, but she is just ordinary in my eyes. Regarding cultivation resources, I believe your Huangfu Kingdom is too small to meet my needs."
"You—"

"You what?" Zhang Fei immediately took out the moonlit whisper sword and pointed it at Huangfu Lian. "Didn't you come here to capture me? How about we fight now? If you don't dare to fight me, I will regard you as a coward who can only hide in Huangfu Shou's shadow."

Huangfu Lian, with his senses expanded to the surrounding area, circled his spot to search for Zhang Fei's whereabouts. However, his eyes widened when he looked at Ling Long, especially since he was already behind her. "Long'er! Behind you!"
Hearing that, Ling Long immediately jumped forward, spun around in mid-air, and kicked at Zhang Fei.

"Argh!" Ling Long let out a low cry.
"Long'er!" Huangfu Lian immediately flew over and caught Ling Long before landing in the distance. "Are you okay?"
Ling Long nodded and warned Huangfu Lian. "Be careful! That guy has a strange ability! He can absorb my Qi."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and used his cloud illusion steps, and his five illusion figures immediately surrounded them. "Huangfu Lian, your cultivation is indeed far above mine, but you are just a prince who has never directly participated in actual combat, and you have always lived under the protection of Huangfu Shou. Your fiancée is also inexperienced in battles, and she relies on her technique, so you guys will not be able to defeat me."
'My technique has no effect on him!'

Huangfu Lian scowled in response to Ling Long's revelation, but Zhang Fei's illusions unexpectedly advanced toward them at the same time. The two launched their attacks immediately, but their attacks penetrated their bodies. Before they could react, the real him had already moved behind them and slashed their backs.
*Slash... Slash...*
"Argh!"
"Ugh!"

Huangfu Lian and Ling Long screamed in pain as they staggered forward, and blood flowed from the slash wounds on their backs. They immediately used their qi to stop the bleeding and turned to face Zhang Fei, but he had already disappeared from that place again.

"I am indeed too weak compared to your cultivation level, and I cannot possibly fight you with my current cultivation, but you are underestimating me if you think you can suppress me with your aura. Your aura pressure is indeed powerful, and other people might feel pressured by it, but it is useless against me."
"Uncle! No need to talk too much! Capture that bastard now!" Huangfu Lian shouted.

"I knew from the start that Huangfu Shou would never let his eldest son go into the enemy's lair by himself, but I didn't expect that he would send you to protect him."

Feng Yao instantly appeared beside Zhang Fei, shocking the three of them. Huangfu Lian and Ling Long were even more shocked when two hands gripped their shoulders, instantly sealing their cultivation.
'Xian Changyue!' Huangfu Lian and Ling Long screamed in their hearts as soon as they looked back.

"Since Huangfu Shou sent them to us, we must use his gift well, right?" Zhang Fei immediately squatted in front of Huangfu Ziyuan and touched his head.

"Argh!" Huangfu Ziyuan screamed in pain as soon as Zhang Fei used the demon absorption on him. "Argh!" 'Fuck! What kind of technique did he use on me? How did he absorb both my cultivation and life force?'

Xian Changyue, who had witnessed Zhang Fei using some of his abilities, could only shake her head. 'This kid is truly insane! He repeatedly used shortcut methods to improve himself! I worry that his addiction to using his abilities could lead him down a heretical path.'

[Ding]
[You gained 2,500,000 Qi from Huangfu Ziyuan.]

"I have no intention of killing them." Zhang Fei then told her. "I heard that the Black Fang Sect has the best concealment technique, so I wanted that technique for my subordinates."
"I see." Xian Changyue nodded in understanding. "You are right, and you can force Xuan Cunhua to give you the technique."

Zhang Fei entered their room and woke up Xuan Cunhua, who had become frightened upon realizing her situation. "Give me your concealment technique, or I will make you suffer more because you tried to hurt Xian Xianqin."

chapters.title: Chapter 636 Meeting Zhou Shenxin
paragraphs: Seeing Zhang Fei's fierce expression, Xuan Cunhua agreed to his request and immediately passed the technique to him once Xian Changyue unsealed her cultivation.
[Ding]
[You obtained the Vanishing Mirage Steps.]
"Done."

Xiang Changyu nodded to Zhang Fei before sealing Xuan Cunhua's cultivation once more. She then led them out of the prison, relieving the female prisoner. 'Sigh! I didn't expect to fall into their trap! Sooner or later, my master will know my situation, and she will come here to save me, so I just need to wait for her to arrive.'
"What are your plans next?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei directed his gaze toward the north. "Zhou Shenxin is resting in a small town located on the border between the Huangfu and Yun Kingdoms, and she will probably arrive in about two days. However, I don't want to wait that long, so we'll go there now."
"What are your plans for Zhou Shenxin?" Xian Changyue asked.
"Feng Yao, I want you to help me stop Zhou Hanling." The Phoenix Princess nodded at Zhang Fei. "Senior Changyue, you will accompany me to talk to Zhou Shenxin."
Xian Changyue was surprised. "Do you want to persuade her to side with you?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded. "You yourself said that Zhou Xiaochuan regards his children as tools, and he favors Zhou Tong, even though Zhou Shenxin's strength is equal to her brother's. She's a strong woman, and I'm sure she doesn't want to endure such oppression and treatment, but she lacks the strength and allies to fight her father. That's why I considered convincing her to join us, as she could play a crucial role in our efforts to subjugate the Zhou Kingdom."
"Are you really still 20 years old?" Xian Changyue asked in doubt.
"Haha." Feng Yao laughed at that. "Even though he still often acts rashly, he is more mature than the kids of his generation, and he will continue to grow in the future."
"Let's go then."

A few minutes later, the three of them arrived at the border of the Zhou and Yun Kingdoms. As soon as Zhang Fei pointed out Zhou Hanling's hiding place, Feng Yao immediately made her move, and it was not difficult for her to immobilize him.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei took Xian Changyue to the inn where Zhou Shenxin was staying, and the two immediately snuck into her room.

Zhou Shenxin, who was cultivating on the bed, abruptly opened her eyes as soon as someone sealed her cultivation. She was completely shocked to see Zhang Fei and Xian Changyue standing before her, but she quickly calmed herself down. "I don't know how you two managed to find me in this city, but I'm guessing that you have spies in our palace. Are you here to capture and hold me hostage?"
"I have a spy inside your kingdom, and you would be surprised if you knew the identity of my spy." Zhang Fei then lifted Zhou Shenxin's chin. "I will give you a choice, and it will affect your fate."
"What's that?"
"Join us by becoming my woman, and I will help you change your fate." Zhou Shenxin and Xian Changyue frowned at Zhang Fei.
Zhou Shenxin shook her head in refusal. "You can kill me or do whatever you want to me, but I'll never be your woman."
Zhang Fei then sat by Zhou Shenxin's side before pulling her onto his lap, which made her feel uncomfortable. "I'll show you something," he said.

Zhou Shenxin wanted to say something, but the portal that suddenly appeared diverted her attention to it. She was stunned for a moment when Zhang Fei [5] walked out from inside, especially since he brought her half-sister, Zhou Meiling, with him.
Despite Xian Changyue sealing her cultivation, Zhou Shenxin could still sense that Zhang Fei's clone was completely identical to his real body, based on his aura and others.
"Save me, eldest sister!"
Zhou Meiling's shout brought Zhou Shenxin back to her senses. "Can't you see my situation? Do you think I can save you in this kind of situation?"

Zhou Meiling lowered her face without being able to argue, but she was also shocked that Zhang Fei could take her half-sister hostage. However, Zhang Fei [5] immediately brought her back into the Yin-Yang Space again.
Zhou Shenxin tilted her head to Zhang Fei. "My father suspected that Meiling was in your hands, and his suspicion proved correct. Do you intend to use her as another spy?"

"Do you think your sister has the ability to spy on your father?" Zhou Shenxin shook her head at Zhang Fei. "I have never met Zhou Xiaochuan, but I can guess that he has never valued his daughters, be it you, Zhou Meiling, or his other daughters. Since he values his sons more, I'm sure that he wouldn't care if any of you died at the hands of your enemies."
Zhou Shenxin nodded. "We are just tools for our father to bring down his enemies, and he will not hesitate to ask us to sacrifice our bodies to help him fulfill his ambitions."

"That's why I came to you and made that offer." Zhou Shenxin trembled as Zhang Fei hugged her and rubbed her abdomen. "Even though you're not the best, you're still one of the most attractive women I've ever met, and it would be a shame if you had to die for your father's rotten ambitions. Moreover, you are a strong and tough woman, and you must have your own ambitions for your future, so I'm sure you don't want to die for silly things. Unfortunately, you are not strong enough, and you have no allies to help you fight your father back, so you have no choice but to follow his orders like an obedient carabao."
"I don't—"

"Shh." Zhang Fei covered Zhou Shenxin's mouth. "Honestly, I have many ways to subdue you at this very second, and you will not be able to resist me. However, I do not intend to use them on you, and I find it more interesting if you submit to me of your own volition."

'This brat! He never stops seducing women!' Xian Changyue, who had only been silent, finally spoke. "You don't have to doubt him, Zhou Shenxin. If he uses one of his abilities on you, I dare to guarantee that you will be under him without any resistance. Furthermore, you've likely heard a lot about him from Zhou Tong, so you should already be aware that he is not your typical cultivator. If you want to live freely and control your own destiny, then he is your best choice."

Zhou Shenxin pulled Zhang Fei's hand down from her mouth. "What can you do to help me? I admit that your Star Tower results are extraordinary, but I have never seen all of your abilities, and my father is stronger than you think."
Zhou Shenxin was taken aback when Zhang Fei unexpectedly carried her like a princess. Given that her cultivation was sealed, she immediately wrapped her arms around his neck.
"I'll show her a little of what I'm capable of."
After they disappeared, Xian Changyue immediately left the room and went to Feng Yao's location, where she found Zhou Hanling fast asleep.
Meanwhile, Zhou Shenxin stared at Zhang Fei with wide eyes before looking around them. "Isn't this island the Natural Races' kingdom? How did you manage to bring me here this fast?"

"This island is indeed the Natural Races' kingdom." Zhang Fei nodded and looked far away. "If you wish, I can take you to explore every corner of this realm, so bringing you here is only a trivial matter for me."
Zhou Shenxin was dumbstruck and found it hard not to believe Zhang Fei's words, especially since it only took them a few minutes to arrive at the Natural Races' kingdom from their previous location.
"Do you want to try it?"
"Yeah."

In order to avoid other people's detection, Zhang Fei immediately took Zhou Shenxin into an invisible state, shocking her further. After that, he took the Zhou First Princess to various places in the realm, including all the kingdoms there.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins sent to the inventory.]

As the sun began to rise, the two of them had finished touring the entire realm. Zhang Fei then brought Zhou Shenxin back to her inn, laid her on the bed, and pinned her down. "What are you going to do to me?"

My sister might send some people to search for us, but given the vast number of realms in this universe, they won't be able to find us quickly, ensuring our safety for some time. If her people succeed in finding us, we will move to another realm again."

"All right, we have to leave this realm as soon as possible." Shang Xiaoyin immediately agreed with that. "However, I have to talk to Shang Yifen and Shang Jiali first, or they will tell my mother about our relationship."
"Call them."

A while later, the two women arrived at their room, and Shang Xiaoyin immediately told them about Shang Baishi's plan. Shang Yifen and Shang Jiali were really shocked by this, but they were also relieved, especially since there would be no one to order them around anymore if she left with her uncle.
Shang Baishi then threatened Shang Yifen and Shang Jiali. "You guys should keep your mouth shut about our relationship, or you both will face the consequences."

"However, Aunt Ziyuan will definitely find out about this matter sooner or later, and we can't lie to her, or she will kill us and our family."
"If my mother forces you two, simply inform her that you are unaware of our destination." Shang Xiaoyin then looked at her uncle. "Let's go now, uncle! We can't continue wasting time in this realm."
"Yeah."

"What kind of information did you obtain?" Shang Yingyue asked.
"Let's gather with the others first, and I will share with you all."

Murong Mengying's explanation left them all stunned. Qiao Liangren asked her. "Are you sure the Sun Tower is the key to accessing those realms beyond the upper realms?"

"One hundred percent." Murong Mengying replied with a nod. "My master has already challenged the tower, and he met some people from those realms, so you don't need to doubt his information. Once again, they were shocked by it because the strongest among them was Qiao Liangren, whose cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm. However, his cultivation was still far from the Divine Ascension Realm, and he still needed thousands of years to reach that stage.
Miao Miao then asked Murong Mengying. "If we have to reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm to go to those realms, then there's no point in us going to the Sun Tower now, right?"

Based on my master's explanation, those rewards will be very useful to speed up our cultivation, but we need a large team to be able to pass them. If all that is true, we can break through to the next stages more easily, and it is not impossible for us to reach the Divine Ascension Realm in the future. That's why I gathered all of you here, and I'm confident that we can pass them if we join forces."

"However, it is impossible for all of us to go to the Blossom Heaven Realm, especially since we have to keep an eye on those scoundrels." Lai Minhua and the others nodded in agreement with Deng Zhichao.

"Isn't that easy?" They turned to Huo Qiubing directly. "There are still many cultivators of our level in our clans, and we just need to ask one of them to replace us. Huang Shengyan then spoke. "We can tell some and invite them to join us, but we must exclude western clans. As for the northern clans, we don't need to invite the people from the Wang and Dai Clans."
"Additionally, we can choose some of our juniors to join us, so our numbers will be greater." Tao Yuan expressed his idea.

After hearing that, they looked thoughtful, and Shang Yingyue spoke to them. "That plan is indeed good, but we have to think it through more carefully before we decide, and we must find our replacement first."

"You guys can think about this matter for a week, and I want your answers by then." They agreed with Murong Mengying and left the room immediately. "Hmm? I have to go back to my clan and discuss this with my aunt first."

chapters.title: Chapter 639 Sealed World Pearl
paragraphs: After the banquet, Zhang Fei [5] led Oliver and the others to the building that Xian Lianghua had lent him. However, Xian Jinglan, Xi Xianzi, and Aqua decided to join them.

Since Zhang Fei [5] was still unfamiliar with many aspects of the Natural Races' Kingdom, Xian Jinglan provided him with extensive information, particularly the prices of each item they used to do transactions. This way, he can understand the comparison if their prices are converted into coins or jewels, and he can adjust the prices of items or dishes in his shop or restaurant later.

Arriving inside the building, Zhang Fei [5] immediately took out several mattresses, winter clothes, and several items he bought from the earth. However, he felt hesitant to bring out those sex toys and full-body-size sex dolls, especially since he didn't know anything about the sexual lives of natural races.

Like other people from the cultivation world, Xian Jinglan, Xi Xianzi, and Aqua were intrigued by the mattresses. All three looked excited after trying one, especially because of its softness and flexibility.
"Where did you get this mattress?" Xian Jinglan inquired, clearly enjoying herself. On the other side, Aqua and Xi Xianzi were already lying on it, and the little fairy was even rolling around there.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately told Xian Jinglan about the Earth, especially about technology and the like. The elf princess became curious about the planet. "Whether in this realm or the Sky Jade Realm, these mattresses have always been the best-selling items in my shop, and I'm sure your people will be interested in them, so I will return to Earth to buy them in large quantities."
"Can you take us to Earth?" Xi Xianzi asked.
The natural races from the Sky Jade Realm appeared eager to visit Earth, particularly since it was Zhang Fei [5]'s home realm, and they desired to see it at least once.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "I can bring you to Earth, but the situation there is very different from here. Moreover, the flow of time there is slower than in this realm, and one day there is equivalent to four days here. If you stay there for too long, you will lose a lot of time, so I will only bring you there to explore for a little while before returning here."
"Let's go now, and we'll come right back here after we observe the planet with our senses." Xi Xianzi spoke as she floated toward Zhang Fei [5].

The three of them were surprised by the sudden appearance of the gate, but Zhang Fei [5] quickly took them away to Earth. However, they didn't stay there for long, and only an hour had passed when they returned to the building.
"Ahh! That planet is disgusting! I will never go there again in my life!" Xia Xianzi shouted in frustration.

Xian Jinglan and others agreed with Xi Xianzi. After all, they are the living creatures closest to nature, and Earth is definitely not a friendly place for them with its high levels of pollution. They saw that the majority of the natural environment had suffered significant damage, particularly due to the continuous construction of buildings and other activities in every country.
Xian Jinglan then questioned Zhang Fei [5]. "How did your family survive in that world for so long? If I stayed there for a day, I would probably die of suffocation."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "Earth thousands of years ago was completely different from the present one, but it continued to evolve from an ancient planet to a modern one, and it will never stop because humans continue to develop all sorts of things. Since we were born and raised there, we are already used to the living conditions there."

"That's why we never liked humans, especially since they are too selfish and self-centered. They don't care about nature, which continues to provide us with unlimited valuable resources. If the humans on that planet persist in destroying nature, I'm sure it will eventually face destruction and become a dead planet. Zhang Fei [5] did not dispute Xian Jinglan's assertion, as he believed that Earth's current state would eventually lead to its destruction. "Do you desire to change the situation on that planet?"

"That's true, Fei!" Xi Xianzi joined in. Since there are no cultivators, you can easily conquer that planet. If you become the ruler of that planet, you can order those humans to obey you, and you can stop the destruction."

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in refusal. "As you said just now, humans are too selfish and self-centered. I am no different from them, and I don't care about the Earth's future. If nature is destroyed and the Earth becomes uninhabitable, I will bring my closest ones who still live there to another realm."

The two women just nodded and didn't discuss the matter further; instead, they wanted to buy some mattresses and other items. Since he didn't need to pay rent or buy the building, Zhang Fei [5] decided to give them some items, which excited them.

"Princess, I want to ask you something, but I'm afraid of offending you." Xian Jinglan looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a curious gaze. "Actually, I still have some items to sell, but I find it hard to say, especially since it has to do with something... you know... hmm... about the relationship between men and women."
Xian Jinglan's cheeks reddened as she realized the meaning behind Zhang Fei [5]'s words. "If you want to ask something like that, you can ask my father or any other man in this kingdom."
Unlike the elf princess, Xi Xianzi shamelessly asked. "Are all the items related to sex?"
"Xianzi!" Xian Jinglan and Aqua shouted at the little fairy.
"Haha!" Instead, Xia Xianzi laughed as she flew in circles around Zhang Fei [5]. "Show us one of the items."
Zhang Fei [5] first glanced at Xian Jinglan and Aqua, who nodded helplessly.

As soon as Zhang Fei [5] took out a female sex doll, Xian Jinglan, Xi Xianzi, Aqua, Yuhe, and Sabina's eyes widened, especially since the doll almost completely resembled a human woman. Unlike them, Gravir and the other men seemed curious about the doll.

"In the Sky Jade Realm, many lonely men purchase these female dolls and use them to satiate their lust." Zefyr suddenly spoke as she floated beside Xi Xianzi. "Moreover, Fei still has the male version, and the women there like it so much."

Xian Jinglan massaged her forehead before speaking. "Our people might be shocked like us if they see these dolls for the first time, but they might be interested in buying both, especially since many men and women of our races also feel lonely like those humans. I don't want to see the other items, so you can arrange them with Yuhe and the others."
"All right." Zhang Fei [5] immediately kept the female doll before speaking to Oliver and the others. "Anyway, I'm going to Earth now, and I'll come back here after I finish preparing all the items."

After Zhang Fei [5] disappeared, Xian Jinglan led the two women to leave the building. However, Xi Xianzi pulled Zefyr to come with her, and she took her to meet the other fairy race members. Meanwhile, Oliver and the others returned to the house provided for them, waiting for their leader to meet them again.

"When are you going to our kingdom?" Yun Xinyue asked Zhang Fei as they walked out of the Sky Jade Restaurant.

Zhang Fei immediately explained. "I'm preparing all the items I need for my two new shops, and I need to buy them in large quantities. It will probably take a week, but I think I'll go to your kingdom in three days to find a suitable building and renovate it first."

"The renovation should take a few days, right?" Zhang Fei nodded at Yun Xinyue. "In that case, I'll go to your residence first, and you can bring me to our kingdom in three days. After the renovation is complete, I'll enter seclusion with you."

Li Yao and Yun Aoxian seemed unhappy with Yun Xinyue's decision, especially since they still considered Zhang Fei unworthy of her. Despite their objection, they said nothing against it, especially since their mother was not against their relationship.

Although Guo Xuehua found it difficult to accept her daughter sharing a man with numerous women, she was more concerned about her daughter's feelings, especially since Yun Xinyue had clearly liked Zhang Fei. "Since you have decided like that, you can go with him, and the three of us will return to our kingdom now."
"Yes, Mother."
Unlike when they left for the Xian Kingdom, Guo Xuehua and her two children decided to use returning jade, especially since it was much faster than using a flying artifact.

After Zhang Fei informed Yang Caojing about Zhou Shenxin and Zhou Hanling's movements, he immediately took Yun Xinyue to the Sky Jade Shop. Zhang Lingxue had already installed half of the teleportation device there, and they went to his residence through it.
Upon arrival, Zhang Fei took Yun Xinyue into the training space, which greatly surprised her. "Why are Aunt Changyue and the others having such difficulty moving?"

"Why don't you try it yourself by joining them?" Yun Xinyue immediately ran towards them, but she fell to the ground as soon as she stepped into the center area, causing Zhang Fei to laugh in satisfaction. "Princess Yun! You have to train hard to adapt to that gravity, especially since there are still several more levels of gravity waiting for you."

After that, Zhang Fei rushed into the Cloud Mansion, but Xu Ling'er was already waiting for him in her room. He immediately approached the little girl and sat her on his lap. "Why don't you cultivate like the others, Ling'er?"

"Big brother, can't you feel that my cultivation has broken through to the 2-Star Soul Realm?" Zhang Fei nodded after he sensed Xu Ling'er's cultivation. "I will stop cultivating for a few days to stabilize my cultivation, and I will accompany you. When will you go to the Yun Kingdom? I want to go sightseeing in the kingdom."

"I'll take you there in three days." Xu Ling'er appeared to be delighted by this, but Zhang Fei abruptly moved her to the center of the bed. "Before we go to the Yun Kingdom, I will take you to a new place."

[The Sealed World Pearl: A profound treasure containing a miniature world sealed within it, which is isolated from external realms. It was created by a powerful ancient cultivator who wished to preserve a fragment of their world from chaos and destruction. The world has its own Qi veins, which continuously produce high-level Qi, hidden treasures, and so on. To expand its internal world, the pearl needs nourishment from the owner's Qi, soul power, or rare resources. Currently, several areas are still sealed, and opening the seals without soul power risks unleashing the chaotic forces of its world, causing massive destruction.]
[The Sealed World Pearl Five Features]
1. Pocket dimension: The pearl acts as a portable world, allowing its owner to enter and leave at will while bringing other people. It can be used for cultivation, refuge, or even to hide resources.
2. Self-Sustaining Environment: The world inside is self-sufficient, with Qi veins, rare herbs, and many other precious resources, making it a perfect location for cultivation or alchemy.
3. Sealed Domain: No one knows what's inside.

4. Time Acceleration: The flow of time within the pearl can be adjusted based on the owner's soul level, enabling rapid cultivation, alchemy, blacksmithing, or artifact forging. However, this feature has a huge drawback, especially since it will significantly drain the user's soul power.
5. World Suppression: The owner can unleash the weight of the pearl's internal world upon an opponent, crushing his or her will and mentality.

In a split second, they had entered the Sealed World Pearl. Xu Ling'er's mouth instantly formed an O shape due to the otherworldly nature of the place, despite the interior appearing relatively small. "What is this place, Big Brother? How can this place be this beautiful?"

"This is my new pocket dimension, and this is my first time here." Zhang Fei then looked around them. There were no houses or anything similar inside, but the entire area was filled with tall trees, herbs, and beasts. "Do you like this place, Ling'er?"

"Yes." Xu Ling'er then jumped down from Zhang Fei's arms and ran into a collection of rainbow-colored plants. She seemed to really like the plants, especially since they moved according to the little girl's movements. "Big Brother! These plants are pretty and funny!"

Unlike Xu Ling'er, Zhang Fei had many questions and doubts about many things inside his mind. 'How did this pearl fall into the hands of the creator of the system? Why did she give me a profound treasure? All her gifts have helped me so much, but she left no information about herself, let alone her reason for helping me. I did die because of her, but I don't believe that she didn't have an ultimate motive for helping me.'

[Master, I know you have many doubts about that girl, but you can't do anything about it now, and the only thing you can do is to use all her gifts to strengthen yourself. If your guess is right that she came from those realms beyond the upper realms, you will meet her someday in the future, so you don't need to think about her for now and focus on the path ahead.]
Zhang Fei just nodded. 'Mei, do you think I can speed up the flow of time in this place for a few days with my current soul power?'
[Master, I don't have clear information about the Sealed World Pearl, so I can't measure it for now. I think you should try it first, and I will calculate it for you.]

Zhang Fei immediately sat on the ground and tried to use the time acceleration feature with his soul power, but his head immediately became dizzy, causing him to fall backward. 'Damn it! How much time flow have I managed to speed up?'
[Only five minutes faster, Master.]
'What the fuck!' Zhang Fei instantly cursed. 'I've used almost all my soul power, and my head is really dizzy from it, but I can only speed it up by five minutes.'
[Master, I think you have to raise your soul level to the heavenly soul to be able to speed up the flow of time in this place by a day.]

Zhang Fei took a deep breath of air after hearing that. 'My soul level has just broken through to the initial stage of the earthly soul level, and Qiao Liangren forbade me to cultivate my soul for the time being. How long do you think it will take me to reach the half-perfection stage?'
[As long as you and your clones continue to dual soul cultivate with them, you should be able to reach the half-perfection stage in three months, Master.]
'Three months, huh? Once my soul has stabilized, I will start dual soul cultivating with them again.' Zhang Fei then swallowed a pill and stood up. 'Have you mapped the entire area?'

[Yes, Master. Currently, five areas are sealed, so I can't detect them. You have to open them first, but you won't be able to do it with your current soul power. For the time being, you must nourish the pearl with your Qi and soul power so you can expand this place.]
'Yeah.'

After they spent some time inside the Sealed World Pearl, Zhang Fei immediately brought Xu Ling'er back to the cloud mansion, especially since the world inside the pearl was still useless if he couldn't speed up the time flow.
"Ling'er, I will try to do something important." Zhang Fei immediately closed his eyes and tried to nourish the pearl.

Meanwhile, Xu Ling'er lay prone in front of Zhang Fei, propped her head with her hands, and looked at him. 'Hehe! Big Brother is getting stronger and more handsome, but I still have to wait 7 more years to be his wife.'

sentences.text: After the banquet, Zhang Fei [5] led Oliver and the others to the building that Xian Lianghua had lent him.
However, Xian Jinglan, Xi Xianzi, and Aqua decided to join them.

Since Zhang Fei [5] was still unfamiliar with many aspects of the Natural Races' Kingdom, Xian Jinglan provided him with extensive information, particularly the prices of each item they used to do transactions.
This way, he can understand the comparison if their prices are converted into coins or jewels, and he can adjust the prices of items or dishes in his shop or restaurant later.
Arriving inside the building, Zhang Fei [5] immediately took out several mattresses, winter clothes, and several items he bought from the earth.
However, he felt hesitant to bring out those sex toys and full-body-size sex dolls, especially since he didn't know anything about the sexual lives of natural races.
Like other people from the cultivation world, Xian Jinglan, Xi Xianzi, and Aqua were intrigued by the mattresses.
All three looked excited after trying one, especially because of its softness and flexibility.
"Where did you get this mattress?" Xian Jinglan inquired, clearly enjoying herself.
On the other side, Aqua and Xi Xianzi were already lying on it, and the little fairy was even rolling around there.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately told Xian Jinglan about the Earth, especially about technology and the like.
The elf princess became curious about the planet.

"Whether in this realm or the Sky Jade Realm, these mattresses have always been the best-selling items in my shop, and I'm sure your people will be interested in them, so I will return to Earth to buy them in large quantities."
"Can you take us to Earth?" Xi Xianzi asked.
The natural races from the Sky Jade Realm appeared eager to visit Earth, particularly since it was Zhang Fei [5]'s home realm, and they desired to see it at least once.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them.
"I can bring you to Earth, but the situation there is very different from here.
Moreover, the flow of time there is slower than in this realm, and one day there is equivalent to four days here.
If you stay there for too long, you will lose a lot of time, so I will only bring you there to explore for a little while before returning here."
"Let's go now, and we'll come right back here after we observe the planet with our senses." Xi Xianzi spoke as she floated toward Zhang Fei [5].
The three of them were surprised by the sudden appearance of the gate, but Zhang Fei [5] quickly took them away to Earth.
However, they didn't stay there for long, and only an hour had passed when they returned to the building.
"Ahh!
That planet is disgusting!
I will never go there again in my life!" Xia Xianzi shouted in frustration.
Xian Jinglan and others agreed with Xi Xianzi.
After all, they are the living creatures closest to nature, and Earth is definitely not a friendly place for them with its high levels of pollution.
They saw that the majority of the natural environment had suffered significant damage, particularly due to the continuous construction of buildings and other activities in every country.
Xian Jinglan then questioned Zhang Fei [5].
"How did your family survive in that world for so long?
If I stayed there for a day, I would probably die of suffocation."
"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed.

"Earth thousands of years ago was completely different from the present one, but it continued to evolve from an ancient planet to a modern one, and it will never stop because humans continue to develop all sorts of things.
Since we were born and raised there, we are already used to the living conditions there."
"That's why we never liked humans, especially since they are too selfish and self-centered.
They don't care about nature, which continues to provide us with unlimited valuable resources.
If the humans on that planet persist in destroying nature, I'm sure it will eventually face destruction and become a dead planet.
Zhang Fei [5] did not dispute Xian Jinglan's assertion, as he believed that Earth's current state would eventually lead to its destruction.
"Do you desire to change the situation on that planet?"
"That's true, Fei!" Xi Xianzi joined in.
Since there are no cultivators, you can easily conquer that planet.
If you become the ruler of that planet, you can order those humans to obey you, and you can stop the destruction."
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in refusal.
"As you said just now, humans are too selfish and self-centered.
I am no different from them, and I don't care about the Earth's future.
If nature is destroyed and the Earth becomes uninhabitable, I will bring my closest ones who still live there to another realm."
The two women just nodded and didn't discuss the matter further; instead, they wanted to buy some mattresses and other items.
Since he didn't need to pay rent or buy the building, Zhang Fei [5] decided to give them some items, which excited them.
"Princess, I want to ask you something, but I'm afraid of offending you." Xian Jinglan looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a curious gaze.
"Actually, I still have some items to sell, but I find it hard to say, especially since it has to do with something... you know... hmm... about the relationship between men and women."
Xian Jinglan's cheeks reddened as she realized the meaning behind Zhang Fei [5]'s words.
"If you want to ask something like that, you can ask my father or any other man in this kingdom."
Unlike the elf princess, Xi Xianzi shamelessly asked.
"Are all the items related to sex?"
"Xianzi!" Xian Jinglan and Aqua shouted at the little fairy.
"Haha!" Instead, Xia Xianzi laughed as she flew in circles around Zhang Fei [5].
"Show us one of the items."
Zhang Fei [5] first glanced at Xian Jinglan and Aqua, who nodded helplessly.
As soon as Zhang Fei [5] took out a female sex doll, Xian Jinglan, Xi Xianzi, Aqua, Yuhe, and Sabina's eyes widened, especially since the doll almost completely resembled a human woman.
Unlike them, Gravir and the other men seemed curious about the doll.
"In the Sky Jade Realm, many lonely men purchase these female dolls and use them to satiate their lust." Zefyr suddenly spoke as she floated beside Xi Xianzi.
"Moreover, Fei still has the male version, and the women there like it so much."
Xian Jinglan massaged her forehead before speaking.

"Our people might be shocked like us if they see these dolls for the first time, but they might be interested in buying both, especially since many men and women of our races also feel lonely like those humans.
I don't want to see the other items, so you can arrange them with Yuhe and the others."
"All right." Zhang Fei [5] immediately kept the female doll before speaking to Oliver and the others.
"Anyway, I'm going to Earth now, and I'll come back here after I finish preparing all the items."
After Zhang Fei [5] disappeared, Xian Jinglan led the two women to leave the building.
However, Xi Xianzi pulled Zefyr to come with her, and she took her to meet the other fairy race members.
Meanwhile, Oliver and the others returned to the house provided for them, waiting for their leader to meet them again.

Zhang Fei immediately explained.
"I'm preparing all the items I need for my two new shops, and I need to buy them in large quantities.
It will probably take a week, but I think I'll go to your kingdom in three days to find a suitable building and renovate it first."
"The renovation should take a few days, right?" Zhang Fei nodded at Yun Xinyue.

chapters.title: Chapter 640 Soul Emperor Hun Di
paragraphs: "The Sun Tower?" Murong Qianying said with surprise. "Are you sure that the tower is the key to those realms, Mengying? Where did you get the information about it?"
"My master." Murong Qianying was surprised again, but she looked doubtful toward Murong Mengying. "If you don't believe me, you can contact my master."
"No need." Murong Qianying replied with a shake of her head. "How many people are you going to bring there? Who will you choose among them?"

Murong Mengying immediately told her aunt the identities of those people, which Murong Qianying immediately agreed to. "I will also bring my two cousins and Long'er with me, and you can send Murong Yinghua to replace me."

'Tch! She wanted to keep Long'er away from me!' Murong Qianying then nodded. "All right, you can take the three of them. I'm sure that Shang Yingyue will have no problem with my children leaving, but I'm not sure about the person who will replace her."

"Shang Yingyue has not made up her mind about it, but she doesn't seem to want to go there. Moreover, Senior Hun Di will arrive at the Wasteland Realm soon, and he probably won't let him or Qiao Liangren go." Murong Mengying then stood up from her seat. "We'll talk again after they decide whether to go to the tower."
"Wait." Murong Qianying tossed a storage ring to her. "Give it to Long'er."
"All right."
After her niece returned to the Wasteland Realm, Murong Qianying rushed to the Hong Clan to meet Hong Xinxin and discuss the Sun Tower.

Murong Mengying had already arrived at the Shang Clan's residence in the Wasteland Realm and rushed to find Zhang Xiaolong [3], but she found him sitting on the bed with his eyes closed, especially since Shang Yaolin was still busy with her tasks.
Murong Mengying immediately approached the bed and sat in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3], but she could not feel the movement of Qi in her body, which meant that she was not cultivating.

'What is he actually doing? Is he asleep?' Murong Mengying then stretched out her hand and touched her cheek. 'If I look closely, this kid is more handsome than most of the men in this realm, with only Qiao Liangren being less handsome than him.'
Murong Mengying was shocked when Zhang Xiaolong [3] grabbed her hand, pushed her down, and pinned her beneath him. "What are you doing in my room, Senior Sister?"
"What do you want to do to me?" Murong Mengying turned to inquire with a relaxed smile.

A slight smirk appeared on Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face, and he quickly sealed Murong Mengying's lips, causing her eyes to widen. 'This brat! Why did he suddenly kiss me? Why does his kiss give me a strange feeling?'
"You are such an intoxicating beauty, and I want to eat you, Mengying." Zhang Xiaolong [3] spoke after their lips parted.
"Haha." Murong Mengying laughed and embraced Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s neck. "If you are not afraid of death, you can eat me now."
Naturally, Zhang Xiaolong [3] wouldn't do anything so crazy, and he sat Murong Mengying down on the bed again. "Have they agreed to go to the Sun Tower?"

"Not yet." Murong Mengyin then gave the storage ring to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Everyone, except for Shang Yingyue, has expressed interest in challenging the Sun Tower. However, they can't leave all of a sudden, and they have to find their replacements first. That's why I'm giving them a week to think and find the right person to be their replacement, and I'll also meet some other clans to invite them to join us. Anyway, my aunt has agreed that if I bring Shang Guangming and Shang Yaolin with us, and you should accompany us."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately rejected that. "I've already cleared the first floor, so I won't be able to challenge it again for a few years. I can't challenge the second floor because the minimum requirement is the Heaven Realm, and I don't want to waste my time going there."
"What are you going to do then?" Murong Mengying asked.

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his chin in thought. "Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin have already escaped from this realm, so I will bring Shang Xinyu back. You can bring Shang Yaolin there, as it will be beneficial for her, and her strength will make her more useful to me in the future."

"You really think of Shang Yaolin as a tool for your revenge, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] responded to Murong Mengying with a smirk, causing her to sigh helplessly. She said nothing about that and got out of bed straight away. "I will go to the northern area to meet the people from the Li, Wu, Ren, and Jin Clans now."

Following Murong Mengying's departure, Zhang Xiaolong [3] hastened to the mountaintop, particularly with the imminent arrival of Soul Emperor Hun Di in that realm. Moreover, Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue were already there, waiting for their master to arrive.
"Did you just meet Mengying, Long'er?" Qiao Liangren directly asked.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded. "Aunt Qiangying entrusted a lot of Jianshen Liquid from Aunt Xinxin to Senior Sister Mengying, so she came to me to give it to me. But how did you know about it, Senior Brother? Were you peeping at me?"

"Do you think I'm a peeping tom?" Qiao Liangren asked with a darkened face, causing Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Shang Yingyue to laugh. "I've known Mengying since we were little, and I know her scent very well, so it wasn't difficult for me to find out."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately teased him. "Does that mean you fell in love with Senior Sister Mengying? My father said-"
"No." Qiao Liangren immediately denied it. "My relationship with Mengying is like blood siblings, and I have no interest in anything other than cultivation."
'Sometimes, I feel like Qiao Liangren is gay.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked them. "Do you two think I can break through to the half-perfection stage in three months?"

"I doubt that, Long'er." Shang Yingyue answered with a shake of her head. "You have just broken through to the initial stage, and stabilizing our earthly soul is more difficult. Perhaps you can only fully stabilize it after a month, and you may need a year to break through to the half-perfection stage."

Qiao Liangren agreed with her. "Yingyue is right, Long'er. The earthly soul level is different from the levels below it, so you won't be able to break through to the next stage in three months, and one year is the fastest for you to break through."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded and didn't take their words to heart, especially since Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue didn't know that he had so many dual cultivation partners. "In that case, I have to work harder to reach the half-perfection stage faster."
Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue sighed helplessly at the strong determination on Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face, but they liked his persistence in becoming strong in the soul cultivation path.

Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue suddenly felt a familiar aura descending from the dark sky, so they stood up and looked above. Zhang Xiaolong [3] also realized this and immediately stood in the middle of them.

In a few moments, Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw a middle-aged man with long gray hair appear above them. He slowly descended towards them as if descending the invisible stairs with his gaze focused on him, and his soul power suppressed his.
However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was relieved when something appeared in his soul, which came from the dozens of white lotus buds in his soul. 'Scan him, Mei.'
[Yes, Master.]
Name: Hun Di
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation: 1-Moon Divine Ascension Realm
Elements: Fire [Peak Stage], Ice [Peak Stage]
Elemental Laws: Fire [Half-Perfection Stage], Ice [Advanced Stage]
Cores: Peak-Rank Fire Core, Peak-Rank Ice Core
Physique: Human Physique
Special Physique: None
Special Bloodline: Infernal Frost Wyrm
Partner: None
Likes: All his disciples.
Dislike: The Nameless One

'Damn! He is indeed worthy of the nickname the Soul Emperor! He didn't do anything, but my soul was greatly oppressed by his presence, and I would have fallen unconscious if it weren't for those white lotus buds.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] silently gazed at Hun Di. 'I didn't expect him to hate the nameless one.'
"Master." Shang Yingyue and Qiao Liangren respectfully greeted Hun Di.

"Yingyue, I didn't expect your soul power to reach the Heavenly Soul Level." Hun Di said that, but his gaze did not leave Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s figure. "This kid is indeed an exceptional one. This is the first time I have met a ten-year-old Earthly Soul Cultivator, and his normal cultivation has also reached the 2-Star Earth Realm. Although my soul power suppresses his soul, he is not flinching in the slightest or losing consciousness."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed in relief in his heart, especially since Hun Di could not see through his body and soul disguise. At first, he was still afraid that the soul emperor would see through his disguise, but his worries proved to be unfounded.

"Master, my soul power was able to break through thanks to Long'er." Hun Di turned to Shang Yingyue directly. "I was accompanying him in dual soul cultivation when he was about to break through, and his soul breakthrough actually had a significant impact on mine."
Hun Di then returned his gaze to Zhang Xiaolong [3] again. "Release your soul, kid."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] took a deep breath to calm himself down, and then, as Huan Di requested, he released his soul.

"Hmm?" The soul emperor raised his eyebrows as he saw dozens of white lotus buds inside Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul. 'Did these lotus buds appear because he dual soul cultivated with so many women? I can sense the Yin Qi of many women inside his body and soul, so my guess should be correct.'
"Do you recognize these white lotus buds, master?" Qiao Liangren asked.

"I have been a soul cultivator for over ten thousand years, but I saw them for the first time today." Hun Di then questioned Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "How can you have so much women's Yin Qi inside your body and soul?"

'Fortunately, Murong Qianying sent me a lot of Yin Qi.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then took out a few bottles from the storage ring that Murong Mengying had given him earlier. "Aunt Qianying and Aunt Xinxin repeatedly sent me the Yin Qi of female cultivators from their clans, and I used them to cultivate my body and soul. As for these lotus buds, they appeared within my soul after I used the soul cultivation technique my mother gave me."
"What's the name of that technique?"
"The lotus ascension art."
"Have you ever heard of that technique, Master?"

Hun Di shook his head at his two disciples. "There are too many cultivators in this universe, and many of them have created their own soul techniques. Although I can't recognize his technique, I can see that these lotus buds have extraordinary effects, and they help him withstand the pressure from my soul power."
"Are you interested in my techniques, Senior?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] asked to test Hun Di.

"Haha." Hun Di laughed in response. "Your soul technique is indeed good, but I have more confidence in the techniques I created. They have helped me greatly in reaching this stage, so I am not interested in other techniques. Do you want to be my disciple, kid? If you—"
*Bam*
Zhang Xiaolong [3] fell to his knees and cupped his hands in front of Hun Di. "Yes! I am willing to be your disciple, Senior!"

"That's good! You will be my disciple from now on." Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue smiled in relief after hearing that. Hun Di then touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s forehead and imparted a technique to him. "I created the Origin Soul Art after encountering a great soul cultivator in the past, whose techniques inspired me to create my own. My technique has five stages: awakening, refinement, expansion, manifestation, and ascension. For their details, you can read them in the technique, and I have written down the methods to master each stage."

sentences.text: "The Sun Tower?" Murong Qianying said with surprise.
"Are you sure that the tower is the key to those realms, Mengying?
Where did you get the information about it?"
"My master." Murong Qianying was surprised again, but she looked doubtful toward Murong Mengying.
"If you don't believe me, you can contact my master."
"No need." Murong Qianying replied with a shake of her head.
"How many people are you going to bring there?
Who will you choose among them?"
Murong Mengying immediately told her aunt the identities of those people, which Murong Qianying immediately agreed to.
"I will also bring my two cousins and Long'er with me, and you can send Murong Yinghua to replace me."
'Tch!
She wanted to keep Long'er away from me!' Murong Qianying then nodded.
"All right, you can take the three of them.
I'm sure that Shang Yingyue will have no problem with my children leaving, but I'm not sure about the person who will replace her."
"Shang Yingyue has not made up her mind about it, but she doesn't seem to want to go there.
Moreover, Senior Hun Di will arrive at the Wasteland Realm soon, and he probably won't let him or Qiao Liangren go." Murong Mengying then stood up from her seat.
"We'll talk again after they decide whether to go to the tower."
"Wait." Murong Qianying tossed a storage ring to her.
"Give it to Long'er."
"All right."
After her niece returned to the Wasteland Realm, Murong Qianying rushed to the Hong Clan to meet Hong Xinxin and discuss the Sun Tower.

Murong Mengying immediately approached the bed and sat in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3], but she could not feel the movement of Qi in her body, which meant that she was not cultivating.
'What is he actually doing?

Is he asleep?' Murong Mengying then stretched out her hand and touched her cheek. 'If I look closely, this kid is more handsome than most of the men in this realm, with only Qiao Liangren being less handsome than him.'
Murong Mengying was shocked when Zhang Xiaolong [3] grabbed her hand, pushed her down, and pinned her beneath him.

"What do you want to do to me?" Murong Mengying turned to inquire with a relaxed smile.
A slight smirk appeared on Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face, and he quickly sealed Murong Mengying's lips, causing her eyes to widen. 'This brat!
Why did he suddenly kiss me?
Why does his kiss give me a strange feeling?'

"If you are not afraid of death, you can eat me now."
Naturally, Zhang Xiaolong [3] wouldn't do anything so crazy, and he sat Murong Mengying down on the bed again.
"Have they agreed to go to the Sun Tower?"
"Not yet." Murong Mengyin then gave the storage ring to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Everyone, except for Shang Yingyue, has expressed interest in challenging the Sun Tower.

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed his chin in thought.

Qiao Liangren agreed with her.

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was relieved when something appeared in his soul, which came from the dozens of white lotus buds in his soul. 'Scan him, Mei.'

Elemental Laws: Fire [Half-Perfection Stage], Ice [Advanced Stage]

He didn't do anything, but my soul was greatly oppressed by his presence, and I would have fallen unconscious if it weren't for those white lotus buds.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] silently gazed at Hun Di. 'I didn't expect him to hate the nameless one.'
