paragraphs: "I have lived for more than ten thousand years, but I have never met a talent as astonishing as yours. When I first started on the soul cultivation path, I could not accomplish such things as quickly as you." Hun Di suddenly grabbed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder and took him away from the mountaintop.
"Why did our master suddenly take Long'er away, Senior Brother?"
Qiao Liangren shook his head. "Since our master has accepted Long'er as his disciple, he will not do anything detrimental to him, and he probably wants to talk to him about something."
"Are you going back to your Qiao Clan?"

"Yes." Qiao Liangren then looked towards his clan's residence. "Since our master has asked us to go with him, we can't possibly refuse him. That's why I'm going back to see my father, so he can prepare my substitute."

Shang Yingyue agreed with that. "I will also return to the Shang Main Clan, but I am still worried about the situation of Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin. They have already escaped together, and no one knows their destination."

"Sigh." Qiao Liangren sighed and faced Shang Yingyue. "You have sacrificed a lot for the Shang Clan, but they never appreciate it. You should stop minding their business and let Shang Ziyuan take care of everything, and you must focus on your family, especially your daughter."
"I know."
As soon as they reached a new location, Hun Di immediately questioned Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "What is your purpose in disguising yourself, kid?"
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked by Hun Di's question.

"I don't know what kind of technique you used to disguise your bone age and soul, but I know that you are not a ten-year-old kid." Hun Di's words caused Zhang Xiaolong [3] to stiffen. "Did you forget my nickname? Do you think people would give me the nickname if I were an ordinary soul cultivator? I didn't say anything in front of Liangren and Yingyue regarding this matter, and I wanted to hear your reasons first."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] took a deep breath before using body modification and soul manipulation abilities to restore the age of his bones and soul, which surprised Huan Di because he could restore them instantly. "Why did you accept me as your disciple if you already knew that I was in disguise, master?"

"Everyone has their reasons, and I am an expert soul cultivator who has seen and experienced many things in my life, both good and bad." Zhang Xiaolong [3] slightly nodded his head. "I can see that you are not bad, and you did it for a certain reason. Moreover, you have high enthusiasm for soul cultivation, so I still accept you as my disciple."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft sigh before explaining everything to Hun Di, starting with the Sky Jade Realm to the Netherworld Realm, as well as his decision to disguise himself to infiltrate the Shang Clan in the Wasteland Realm.

"Shang Huaqiang, huh?" Hun Di muttered and nodded in understanding. "That brat has always been like that, and many people from the Red Sun Realm are eager to kill him, but none of them dare to openly oppose him because his Shang Clan is the largest there. I don't know the reason he invaded your home realm, and I don't care about it. However, I support your action to take revenge on him, and you don't need to show mercy to him, especially since his actions caused the people on your side to suffer."
"Do you really not mind my lies, master?"

Hun Di shook his head and patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder. "Our family members are the most important to us, and they will be the first to help us if we encounter trouble. Other people may be willing to help us, but they will never be as loyal as our family, and they may have ulterior motives for doing so. If others cause our family members harm, we must hold them accountable multiple times over."

"Yes, master." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied as he clenched his fists. "Seeing Qingyu, Ying'er, Xing'er, and Qing'er cry heartbrokenly over Chu Hong's death made my heart ache so much. Luan'er and Lingxue also experienced heartbreak upon learning that their big sister and big brother had turned into demons; they often had to separate from them due to their frequent trips to the Netherworld Realm to bolster their demon power. Since Shang Huaqiang's ambition started everything, I decided to infiltrate the Shang Clan, and I will destroy them as payment for their sorrow."

Hun Di then said. "You are my disciple, and my other disciples are your family. I don't like it when there are lies in the family, so I want you to tell the truth to Liangren and Yingyue. They may be disappointed at first, but they'll understand your reasons for lying to them."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] released a soft sigh before nodding to him, and Hun Di instantly disappeared from his sight. However, he didn't leave for too long, and he returned together with his two disciples a few seconds later.

Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue were instantly shocked when they realized Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s bone age. They had long suspected that he was not a ten-year-old boy but a grown man, but they never got proof. Today, they finally found out the truth, which shocked them.
"Long'er, you—"

"Yes, Senior Sister Yingyue. I am not a child, but I am already 20 years old." Shang Yingyue's expression turned disappointed after Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that, especially since she had always treated him well. She even helped him in dual soul cultivation, but she did that because he was a child in her mind. "I'm sorry I lied to you two, but I have my reasons for doing so."
Shang Yingyue did not respond to Zhang Xiaolong [3], and she continued to stare at him with a disappointed gaze. Qiao Liangren then spoke. "Please tell us your real reason, Long'er."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded and recounted everything to Shang Yingyue and Qiao Liangren, based on his earlier story to Hun Di. After hearing all the stories, both looked shocked and turned to their master. "I have confirmed everything through his soul wave, and he told the truth to both of you."

"I see." Qiao Liangren nodded before looking at Zhang Xiaolong [3] again. "What are your plans for Yaolin next? Are you going to continue treating her like now? She has fallen deeply in love with you, but you deceived her to this extent. If she finds out that you are only using her, she will definitely fall into a pit of misery."

"Senior Brother, she assisted Shang Huaqiang in carrying out his plans, and several members of my family suffered because of them." Qiao Liangren frowned at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Shang Yaolin is a good woman, but my family is much more important to me. I don't care who they are, but I will never be merciful to anyone who makes my family suffer, and I will make them taste my family's suffering."
Qiao Liangren wanted to refute Zhang Xiaolong [3], but Hun Di immediately stopped him. "What have I always taught you, Liangren?"
"Family is everything, and we must always do the best for our family, Master."

"That's right." Hun Di nodded. "I know you have a good relationship with Shang Yaolin, but she is not your family; Long'er is your family, as you are both my disciples. Furthermore, you are aware that Shang Huaqiang is targeting your family and intends to annex your Qiao clan, so there's no need for you to protect her. You don't need to help Long'er in his revenge against them, but you shouldn't stop him."
Qiao Liangren let out a heavy sigh and nodded to Hun Di. "I understand, master."
"Master, I—"

"Have you forgotten the feeling of devastation you experienced in the past, Yingyue?" When Hun Di asked that, Shang Yingyue swallowed her words back. "You are indeed a member of the Shang Clan, but they never cared about you. After that incident, they blamed you, called you stupid, and nearly drove you to commit suicide. If it weren't for Xueming, you would be dead by now, and Little Lianzhi would never be born. You have made numerous sacrifices for them, yet they have never shown any concern for you. Since you are my disciple, they no longer dare to bully you, so it's time for you to move on and enjoy a happier life with your husband and daughter. Do you understand?"
"Yes, Master."

Hun Di then enveloped them with his aura, and they moved into the fortress in the blink of an eye. Shang Yingyue then led her master to meet her family, and she asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] to join them, especially since she had to explain the truth to her husband.
However, Qiao Liangren did not join them, and he rushed back to the Red Sun Realm to discuss his replacement with his father.

"Grandpa Hun!"
"Hahaha." Hun Di laughed and lifted the little girl into his arms. "How are you, Little Lianzhi? Are you always so well-behaved?"
"Grandpa! I am a good girl, so I always behave well." Wu Lianzhi protested with a pout. "Did you take Long'er as your disciple, Grandpa?"
Hun Di nodded to the little girl. "Long'er is my disciple now, but he is not the last, and you will be my last. However, you must grow up first, and I will teach you the best soul technique."
"Hehe." Wu Lianzhi giggled in response. "Let's go out, Grandpa! I haven't seen you for a long time, and I have a lot of stories to tell you."
"You three can talk." Hun Di then took Wu Lianzhi away.

Shang Yingyue immediately sat down with her husband and told him everything, which shocked him. Like his wife, Wu Xueming had always suspected that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a grown man, and his suspicions were finally proven right. "Who exactly are you, Long'er? Do you have ulterior motives toward my wife?"

"Senior Brother, I have never approached Senior Sister Yingyue, and she took the initiative to dual soul cultivate with me. Moreover, there are no problems between us, and she has always treated me well, so I have no ill will towards her." Shang Yingyue supported Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s words by telling Wu Xueming that he had never done anything to her, and they were purely just dual soul cultivating. "My real name is Zhang Fei, and I come from the Sky Jade Realm. My original purpose in coming to this realm was only for Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan, but the situation slowly changed, and I got to know more people in it. Thanks to this, I was able to become a body and soul cultivator, and my master even accepted me as his disciple, even though he knew I was lying."

Wu Xueming let out a soft breath before speaking. "Shang Huaqiang is overly ambitious and vicious, always striving to become the sole ruler of our realm, and he does not hesitate to destroy other clans who oppose his ambitions. My wife is indeed a member of the Shang Clan, but I have never liked that clan, so I will support you in destroying them. "Hmm?" Murong Mengying abruptly raised her eyebrows upon receiving several voice transmissions from other clans, all of whom had agreed to go to the Blossom Heaven Realm to challenge the Sun Tower. "I will go with the others to the Blossom Heaven Realm, where we will meet my master and his friends." Murong Mengying then warned the woman. "Murong Yinghua, you must monitor those scoundrels well, and you must not approach the little kid named Zhang Xiaolong [3] in the Shang Clan residence."

'Who is that kid? Why is she acting like this?' Murong Yinghua inwardly wondered. "When are you leaving?"
"This morning."

sentences.text: Zhang Fei [5] was sitting with the seven women in Huang Rong's house in Paris.
However, she and Yang Lu'er were busy with their smartphones.
Since he needed a large amount of goods from Earth for his new shops in the Yun and Natural Races' Kingdoms, the two women had to contact some people in their country to prepare them.
After all, their country was a producer and exporter of quality goods at low prices, so they could only buy them there.
"When will you bring us to your residence in the Nine Stars Realm?" Hong Yao, the former police chief, asked him.
Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment before telling them.
"Our shops in this country have been open for eight days, and sales have also been increasing steadily.
Moreover, the system is already running smoothly, so you guys don't need to monitor it every day, and you can hand this shop over to some people you can trust while monitoring them from afar.
That way, you can rest, and I will take you to that realm to gather with the others.
Unfortunately, you are not cultivators like us, and the cultivators there are powerful, so I cannot take you all on a walk, like in the Sky Jade Realm."
"I think that's fine." Zou Ling said.

"Moreover, you said that your residence is close to the sea and some beautiful places, so we don't need to go to the kingdom or other places, and we can enjoy our vacation in the area around your residence."
Qiu Mei nodded in agreement with Zhou Ling.
"I'm bored here, so I want to go to that realm as soon as possible, especially since the air is much more refreshing."
"How long are we going to stay there?" Ren Xia asked.
Fang Chen then spoke.
"Since time in the Nine Stars Realm is four times faster than Earth, we should be able to stay there for at least a month, right?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded to them.
"You guys can stay there for a month or two, so you will be fresh again before you come back here."
"That's great!" The women immediately cheered.
"Did you find any interesting new products in the Nine Stars Realm?" Yang Lu'er inquired after turning off her smartphone.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head.
"I have a lot of matters in that realm, so I haven't had time to look at other items, but I'll ask Lingxue and the others to look for new items if you want."
"Yes." Yang Lu'er then gave Zhang Fei [5] an outline of the items she wanted for their company, which would increase the variety of goods in their store and attract more buyers.
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"In that case, you can tell Lingxue and the others about all that, and they will help you find items that suit your wishes."
"When will we leave for your realm?" Huang Rong impatiently asked.
"You guys can't wait to have sex with my real body, huh?
The current me is even stronger, especially after my body cultivation broke through to the second stage.

Therefore, you guys have to prepare yourselves first, or you all won't be able to get out of bed for a few days." Huang Rong and the others were not afraid to hear that, and their expressions showed even more excitement.
"You guys can prepare now, and I will take you to the Nine Stars Realm, but it's still midnight there."
"We still want to go there now, and you can go to our country to pick up the goods in our company's warehouse.
However, due to the large quantity of goods, the preparation process may take several days." Huang Rong then informed Zhang Fei [5] of something else.
"I have long prepared the people to manage our store in this country, and they have begun working with us in the last two days, so I'm confident they can handle everything while we're away."
"You can manage everything yourself, and my people will protect them from those who intend to harm them."
After that, Huang Rong and the women returned to their rooms to prepare some things, especially since they would be staying in the Nine Stars Realm for a month or two.
Zhang Fei [5] then walked to the balcony of the house, and his four male slaves immediately appeared before him on their knees.
"Did any of those winged humans descend on this planet while I was away?"
"None of them have come down here yet." Zheng Mohei then asked.
"Shall we attack them, Master?"
"Not now." Zhang Fei [5] then looked towards the location of the two female angels, and he found them relaxing in their house.
"I still have a lot of other things to do right now, so I'll settle them first.
Once everything is settled, we will go to their realm, and I will challenge their tower.
All right, you guys can leave now, and you must do your duties well."
"Yes, Master."
[Are you going to face the winged races head-on, Master?]
Zhang Fei [5] gave a slight nod.
"Before I fought Zhou Fang, I always doubted whether I could defeat them with my current strength.
After I defeated him and killed Hu Gao, I'm sure it won't be difficult for me to defeat Seraph, especially since he won't be stronger than them.
Rather than waiting for them to descend here, I thought of attacking them first, and these earthlings wouldn't know about our battle."
Sometime later, Huang Rong and the six women had finished packing, and Zhang Fei [5] sent them to his residence in the Nine Stars Realm.
They wanted to have fun there right away, but it was still the middle of the night, so they decided to rest in empty rooms in the main building.
Zhang Fei [5] then went to Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianshi's apartment, embarrassing the two women, especially since they were only wearing thin pajamas that accentuated their curves and breasts.
"You guys truly deserve the title of angels."
Unlike Meng Tianshi, who smiled at Zhang Fei [5]'s praise, Jiang Yingyua gave no response and asked him.
"Why did you suddenly come to see us?
The Throne's subordinates haven't come down here yet."
"I plan to go to your realm in the near future." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer shocked Meng Tianshi and Jiang Yinghua.
"Back then, I wasn't sure if I could win against Seraph, but now I'm confident that I can defeat him.
Rather than dragging the matter out for too long and making it complicated, I decided to settle it sooner so I could focus on my other problems.
Before that, I wanted to know about the tower, so I came to you."
"What do you want to know about the tower?" Jiang Yinghua asked.
"Can I only meet Seraph by climbing from the first floor?"
Jiang Yinghua answered him directly.
"Let alone you are an outsider; even members of our race also have to climb from the first floor to get to the top.
However, we can't climb too high, and we can only go to floors according to our rank."
"So you two can only go to the seventh floor, right?"
Both women nodded to Zhang Fei.
"Our rank is in the Power of the Top Level, so we can only go to that floor.
However, we can also go to the Throne's floor if he summons us, but our higher-up, like Gabriel, will take us there."
'No wonder the system gave me the quest to challenge each floor.' Zhang Fei [5] then asked them.
"Are only Seraph's subordinates living in the tower?"
"No." Jiang Yinghua shook her head.
"Since you have never entered our tower, you probably don't know the size of it yet.
Each floor of our tower is no less spacious than Guangzhou, so you should be able to imagine its size."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei [5] was surprised.
"Your tower does look gigantic, but I didn't expect that each floor would be that spacious.
What is the total number of members of your race?"
"Ten million in total." Jiang Yinghua replied.
Meng Tianshi then informed him.
"Seventy percent of them are loyal followers of the Throne, twenty percent are neutral, and ten percent are rebels.
Although the number of those rebels is small, their leaders are strong, and some of them are stronger than Dou Haishang."
"How can I differentiate the members of the three groups?" Meng Tianshi and Jiang Yinghua immediately showed Zhang Fei [5] a cloth with a symbol.
"Do your group members use it as a marker?"
"Yes." Jiang Yinghua then took out something else.
"The rebels use this symbol to identify their members, but they don't show it openly.
You'll have to find out their identities yourself, but I'm sure it's a trivial matter for you, right?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly.
"I didn't expect the number of Seraph's followers to be so large, and they will definitely put up a strong resistance against me.
If that happens, seven and a half million winged race members will die by my hands, and their blood will soak the ground on every floor."
'This guy is truly a madman!' Both women screamed in their hearts.
"Are you really going to kill them?"
Zhang Fei put on a serious expression and replied.
"If they oppose me, then they must die.
If they want to live, they must know their place and not hinder me from meeting the Seraph."
"Unfortunately, that's not possible." Jiang Yinghua sighed helplessly.
"The Throne's followers are very old-fashioned, and they always look down on humans or demons.
Moreover, you are an intruder in our realm, so they will definitely give you a fierce fight."
"If that's the case, just let them die." Jiang Yinghua frowned at Zhang Fei [5].
"I know it will disrupt the balance of the four realms, but I don't care about that.
Moreover, your realm will be calmer and more peaceful if Seraph and his subordinates disappear, right?
Regarding the Xian Realm, I also intend to visit it, but I require someone who can unlock the gate to their realm, which is located within your realm."

"The two of us can open that gate, but we can't do it as long as Seraph and her subordinates exist." Zhang Fei [5] already knew this, as Theo had informed him that only winged races with a rank in the third order of the middle level could open that gate, and the two women's rank was one level above it.
"When exactly will you go to our realm?"

"After I opened my two new shops in my current realm, which takes around seven to ten days." Zhang Fei [5] then took out twenty bottles and placed them on the table, confusing Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianshi.
"The contents of these bottles can strengthen the bodies of both of you, and you will become stronger than the other members of your race."
[Hahaha!
Master, you are truly cunning!
You didn't tell them the contents of the bottles, and they will definitely be shocked if they find out one day.]
Zhang Fei [5] inwardly laughed. 'I specifically asked Lingxue to concoct it for them, and she mixed some herbs into my cum to concoct it.'
"Why do you want to help us?" Jiang Yinghua doubtfully inquired.
"If you two want to become stronger, you can drink them, and vice versa." After he said that, Zhang Fei [5] entered the training space to forge a spirit-grade weapon.
Meng Tianshi then took one of the bottles, opened the cap, and smelled it.
When she smelled nothing strange, she immediately swallowed it in one gulp.
"How do you feel after drinking it?" Jiang Yinghua asked.
Meng Tianshi shook her head.
"This liquid has no smell or taste, so I believe it should be harmless.
However, I haven't felt any changes in my body, and I may have to wait a while for the effects to take effect.
I am hopeful that it will enhance our strength and enable us to evolve to the next stage."
"Yeah." Jiang Yinghua took one and immediately swallowed it.
"Hmm?
You're right; it's tasteless and odorless, so it shouldn't be a poison.
I'm curious about the effect, so let's wait for it to take effect."
After a while, Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianshi felt their bodies heating up from within as Zhang Fei's Yang Qi spread through them, causing them some discomfort.
The two women rushed to the bathroom to relieve the heat with cold water, but it was ineffective.
Instead, the heat gets hotter, and they feel something they have never experienced before, which is lust.

However, she changed her mind after I told her that I would be going with you, and she immediately agreed to send my replacement tomorrow morning."

paragraphs: In a flowering garden, in a distant realm, an old woman with white hair tied back in a bun stands in front of a young woman whose long brown hair falls to the floor.
The old woman nodded in satisfaction as she stared at the cluster of Divine Qi above the young woman's head, and it grew thicker as time passed.

The young woman's soul also grew brighter as she continuously infused it with divine Qi. A while later, a thick and bright thread of Qi emerged from her body and connected to her soul, and the Divine Qi quickly circulated between them.
*Swoosh*
The huge Qi wave that suddenly emerged from the young woman's body swept across the surrounding area, satisfying the old woman.

A while later, the cluster Divine Qi disappeared by itself, and the young woman immediately put her soul into her body again. She then exhaled a breath of relief and opened her eyes. "I did it, Master Shu Xian'er."

"Congratulations! You've finally broken through to the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm, Yumei." Shu Xian'er said this with a satisfied smile on her old face. "Back then, I estimated that you needed one year to break through to this stage, but you managed to do it in a little over three months. Moreover, your heartbinding art has reached the perfection stage now, and it makes it easier for you to seduce and control those useless men."

Shang Yumei's expression changed slightly after Shu Xian'er mentioned that. Naturally, she was elated by her breakthrough because she had been trying to break through for several years without success, but she was also frustrated about the process. She had long known that it would take her longer to break through, but she was able to do so faster than her master's estimation due to external factors.
<If it weren't for that fox brat's Yang Qi, you wouldn't have been able to break through today.>
'Master! Don't mention that brat!'
<Hahaha! Foolish girl! I told you that he is the perfect match for you because he is a heavenly fox, and his Yang Qi is too precious for beasts.>
'Tch!' Shang Yumei gritted her teeth in anger, but it only made the demon fox's soul continue to tease her.
"What are your plans next? Are you going to wander again?" Shu Xian'er asked.

"Yes, Master." Shang Yumei then stood up from her seat. "I have a problem with a man, and it's bothering me quite a bit. That's why I'm going to meet him, and I will subdue him this time. After that, I will seek out other men and control over them, and I will snatch all their resources to expedite my cultivation."

"I can't give you many valuable resources, and I can only give you all my best techniques, so you should find as many men as possible and control them." Shu Xian'er then gave Shang Yumei an item. "If you still have trouble subduing that man, you can use this Obsidian Heart Gem. Its effect is different from the heartbinding art or bewitching techniques of the nine-tailed demon fox, and it will slowly influence his deepest feelings, allowing you to instill deep emotion and loyalty to you in his heart."
"Thank you, Master." After she stored the gem, Shang Yumei immediately took out her flying artifact. "I'll go find that man now, and I'll come back here when I'm close to breaking through."
Shu Xian'er nodded. "Go now."

After Shang Yumei left, a middle-aged woman appeared behind Shu Xian'er. "Do you want me to follow Junior Sister Yumei, Master? Since that man's Yang Qi can help her break through so quickly, it will definitely benefit us, and our disciples can become strong, too."

"No need." Shu Xian'er rejected her idea. "Did you forget what Yumei said back then, Lu Xuejia? Our technique doesn't work on that man, so you're just looking for death if you meet him. He didn't do anything to her because she is a member of the Shang Clan, but we are only a middle-ranking sect and lack strong support, so we should not look for trouble with him."
"I understand, Master."
Shu Xian'er then turned to leave. "Let's go back."
At dawn, Zhang Fei left Qing Yi and Zhang Lin, who were already deeply asleep in each other's arms. He checked on all his wives to ask about their mastery of the Origin Soul Art.
Some of Zhang Fei's wives, such as Liu Hua, Liu Qingyu, Zhang Lingxue, Ye Lian, Chu Ying, Chu Xing, Shen Xueyi, Shen Yu, Boitata, and Hu Yue, managed to master the second stage of Origin Soul Art.

Meanwhile, Ru Xue, Zhong Yan, Tang Zhiyu, Zhao Ziqin, Lillea, and Janette only managed to master the first stage. Even though they had not succeeded in mastering the second stage, Zhang Fei did not mind their results and encouraged them instead.

Having trained and cultivated for more than two days in the training space, Zhang Fei asked the others to rest and brought them all back to his residence. He also brought his clones' partners with them, especially since his cultivation and soul were not yet completely stable.
Zhang Fei [1], Feltia [2], and Zhang Fei [4] also exited the training space and proceeded to another forest to complete the daily quest to kill beasts.

Upon their arrival, the disciples from the Heavenly Sword Sect and Yin-Yang Pavilion, including Lin Dong'er and Mu Lingshu, immediately went into the forest to hunt beasts and hone their fighting skills. The senior cultivators decided to rest, and the senior women joined Zhang Chen to prepare breakfast.
"How do you feel after training there for more than two days?"
"Dead tired!" Yun Xinyue was the first to answer Zhang Fei.
Xian Changyue agreed. "I'm exhausted, but I'm eager to adapt to the gravity."

"Fortunately, I am a beast, and my cultivation is higher than both of you. Although I was overwhelmed by the gravity at first, I have become more and more adapted to it, and I might be able to adapt if I train for another week." Feng Yao then told Zhang Fei. "I forgot to tell you that my mother and the others met Meng Qi in the Blossom Heaven Realm, and the realm leader gave her something addictive. However, my mother had already removed it from her body and sent her here."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was really surprised to hear that. "How long will it take her to arrive in this realm?"
Feng Yao thought for a moment. "Meng Qi left two days ago, and she will probably arrive in this realm in ten days."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I will immediately send Meng Qi back to the Sky Jade Realm, and she can reunite with her family."

"According to my mother, Meng Qi had something special in her body, so she freed her and sent her here." After Feng Yao said that, Zhang Fei immediately asked Mei to display the woman's data, but he couldn't find anything special about her. "My mother didn't explain it in detail, but she hopes that you will keep her by your side."

Zhang Fei shook his head immediately. "I don't know Meng Qi, and I've only met her once, so I don't have the intention to keep her by my side. Moreover, she may not agree to stay here, so we'll ask her first after she arrives."

"Are you going to the capital, Fei?" Xian Xianqin suddenly asked. "I haven't seen my parents since I returned from the tower, so I want to go back and see them first. Moreover, I've already broken through to this stage; I'm sure they'll be shocked if they find out."

Zhang Fei nodded at Xian Xianqin. "I want to build a pool in the training space, so I'll go to the capital to buy some stuff. Anyway, Lingxue has already installed a teleportation device in my shop, saving us the trouble of traveling there. We can access it through the portal in front of this residence."
"Can you also install one in my kingdom, Zhang Fei?" Yun Xinyue expectantly asked, especially since she could meet her family more easily if he installed it there.

"I've planned that, but I'll install it once I find the right building." Zhang Fei's answer pleased Yun Xinyue. "You guys can rest first while waiting for my grandmother and the others to finish cooking."
"All right." Even though they were cultivators, they still needed to rest, so they rushed to the main building.
After the four women left, Zhang Fei approached the four moon foxes who were gathered in another area. "Are you still thinking about returning to your sub-realm, Lili?"

"No." Hu Lili responded by shaking her head. "After practicing in your training space, I realized that I was still too weak, so I focused on improving myself in the past week. Although Hu Xiufu's cultivation is still in the core realm, she has already surpassed me in terms of speed, especially since she has been with you for several months."

"Haha." Hu Xiufu laughed awkwardly at that. "Back then, those heavenly foxes kidnapped me, but Zhang Fei saved me from them. Moreover, I didn't want to continue being taken advantage of by the elders, so I decided to hide in his training space."
Hu Qiaomu suddenly questioned Zhang Fei. "Why don't you take Hu Xiufu as your partner, Master? She's been with you since then, so I thought you'd already eaten her."
"Elder Qiaomu!" Hu Xiufu shouted in embarrassment.

Zhang Fei smiled as he looked at Hu Xiufu. "She's pretty and sexy, and our relationship has gotten better since we left the Sky Jade Realm. However, Xiufu obviously has no feelings for me, and she is more interested in my half-sibling."
"Your half-sibling?" Zhang Fei immediately pointed at Wang Xiaofeng, who was talking to Wang Zhuxian, Ming Hao, and Ming Yanyu in the distance.
"Do you really like him, Xiufu?" Hu Lili asked her.
Hu Xiufu nodded slightly. "I like Wang Xiaofeng, Elder Lili. Even though he is a human and his cultivation is far below mine, he has always been kind and friendly to me."
"I see." Hu Lili nodded in understanding. "If you like Wang Xiaofeng, I think it's okay for you to be with him."
"Are you okay with them being lovers, Master?"

"If I had liked Xiufu, I would have approached her long ago, and she would have been my partner by now. Although my relationship with Wang Xiaofeng is not really close, he is still related to me by blood, and I always think about my family. Since they like each other, they can become a couple." Zhang Fei turned to Hu Lili, who immediately shifted her face to the side. However, he pulled her into a hug and kissed her directly, causing her to curse in her heart. "My Lili, you won't be able to avoid me all the time, and you will be my woman soon."
"Haha." Hu Yue softly laughed. "Husband, you need a little coercion if you want my mother to be your wife, or she will never accept you."

Hu Lili glared at her daughter, but Hu Yue responded with a loud laugh. Zhang Fei suddenly cupped her cheeks and stared at her eyes intensely, making her waver. "Yue'er is right that I need a little force to get you, but I won't do it, and I want you to accept me of your own accord. You guys can rest and have fun first, and I will bring you guys into the training space again tonight."

After that, Zhang Fei talked to other people, such as the Hai Twins, Lian Xiang, Qing Tan, Ming Han, Wang Zetian, and all of his in-laws' families. He also talked with several people from other clans, such as Qin Zheng, Chang Wuhen, and their families.

Hearing the bustling sound outside, the seven women from Earth immediately woke up from their sleep and rushed to look for Zhang Fei. However, the number of people in the residence surprised them, especially since it was several times greater than the number in the Chu Clan.

Since they were always busy handling his affairs on Earth, Zhang Fei took Huang Rong and the others to the southern ocean, where they had fun while venting their longing for him. Naturally, they vented their longing by having sex with him, and they had never had outdoor sex before, which made their activities even hotter.

Inside the training space, Zhang Fei [5] was relentlessly forging a few spirit-grade weapons, but the results were still not to his satisfaction. Moreover, the system had yet to give him any notification, so all the weapons he had forged before were still not perfect.
*Clang... Clang...*

"These are the last materials I have, and Tie Xuan hasn't returned to the Wasteland Realm, so I must succeed in forging a perfect spirit-grade weapon this time." Quickly, three hours passed in the training space, and Zhang Fei [5] had already given the final touches to the weapon he was forging.
Once he was sure of the results, Zhang Fei [5] immediately dipped the weapon into a cooling liquid to cool it so he could see the final result.
[Ding]
[The Blacksmith feature has been upgraded to level 2.]
[New items are available.]

"Phew." Zhang Fei [5] breathed a sigh of relief at the appearance of the two notifications, and his hard work over the past few days was not in vain. After the weapon cooled, he immediately took it out and observed its shape and sharpness. "This sword is indeed much better than the previous ones, but it's still not as good as those forged by Gang Zhishou and Tie Xuan, and I still need to hone my forging skills more to reach their level."

[Even though this sword is still not as good as their forging, this is good enough, and you are a Spirit Rank Blacksmith now, Master. However, you still can't create a true spirit weapon like the demon extermination sword, so you can improve your forging ability while learning how to create a true spirit weapon.]

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in response. "Tie Xuan has already given me the method to create a true spirit weapon, but my soul power isn't enough to create one. Moreover, the process of creating one necessitates the use of numerous precious materials, which come at an exorbitant cost. Before I try to create one, I should deepen my forging skills first so I won't waste a lot of precious materials."

[Would you like to purchase weapon and armor blueprints at the blacksmith shop, Master? Currently, there are six blueprints, and three of them are spirit grade. As for the materials, you may want to ask Gang Zhishou, Xian Xian, or Duan Zhao for help in getting them.]

"All the items in the system are not ordinary, so I'm sure those blueprints are not for creating ordinary spirit-grade equipment, and I will buy them after I can forge it smoothly." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly remembered something. "Unlock the reward from the easy quest, Mei."
[You obtained 1 Eclipse Shadow Cloak. Grade: Heaven.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately stored the sword and took out the cloak.
[Eclipse Shadow Cloak: Grants the user the ability to hide in shadow, making the user almost impossible to track.]
Zhang Fei [5] promptly put the cloak back into storage. "I have my invisibility and shadow techniques, so the cloak is useless to me. However, it will be useful to Hua'er, so I will give it to her."
After that, Zhang Fei [5] decided to rest and cultivate first so he could complete one of the daily quests.

Shang Yifen suddenly heard a sound from the bathroom, but her eyes widened when she saw two people walking out of it. 'Is this their room? Why am I here?'

sentences.text: In a flowering garden, in a distant realm, an old woman with white hair tied back in a bun stands in front of a young woman whose long brown hair falls to the floor.
The old woman nodded in satisfaction as she stared at the cluster of Divine Qi above the young woman's head, and it grew thicker as time passed.
The young woman's soul also grew brighter as she continuously infused it with divine Qi.
A while later, a thick and bright thread of Qi emerged from her body and connected to her soul, and the Divine Qi quickly circulated between them.
*Swoosh*
The huge Qi wave that suddenly emerged from the young woman's body swept across the surrounding area, satisfying the old woman.
A while later, the cluster Divine Qi disappeared by itself, and the young woman immediately put her soul into her body again.
She then exhaled a breath of relief and opened her eyes.
"I did it, Master Shu Xian'er."
"Congratulations!
You've finally broken through to the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm, Yumei." Shu Xian'er said this with a satisfied smile on her old face.
"Back then, I estimated that you needed one year to break through to this stage, but you managed to do it in a little over three months.
Moreover, your heartbinding art has reached the perfection stage now, and it makes it easier for you to seduce and control those useless men."
Shang Yumei's expression changed slightly after Shu Xian'er mentioned that.
Naturally, she was elated by her breakthrough because she had been trying to break through for several years without success, but she was also frustrated about the process.
She had long known that it would take her longer to break through, but she was able to do so faster than her master's estimation due to external factors.
<If it weren't for that fox brat's Yang Qi, you wouldn't have been able to break through today.>
'Master!
Don't mention that brat!'
<Hahaha!
Foolish girl!
I told you that he is the perfect match for you because he is a heavenly fox, and his Yang Qi is too precious for beasts.>
'Tch!' Shang Yumei gritted her teeth in anger, but it only made the demon fox's soul continue to tease her.
"What are your plans next?
Are you going to wander again?" Shu Xian'er asked.
"Yes, Master." Shang Yumei then stood up from her seat.
"I have a problem with a man, and it's bothering me quite a bit.
That's why I'm going to meet him, and I will subdue him this time.
After that, I will seek out other men and control over them, and I will snatch all their resources to expedite my cultivation."
"I can't give you many valuable resources, and I can only give you all my best techniques, so you should find as many men as possible and control them." Shu Xian'er then gave Shang Yumei an item.
"If you still have trouble subduing that man, you can use this Obsidian Heart Gem.

Its effect is different from the heartbinding art or bewitching techniques of the nine-tailed demon fox, and it will slowly influence his deepest feelings, allowing you to instill deep emotion and loyalty to you in his heart."
"Thank you, Master." After she stored the gem, Shang Yumei immediately took out her flying artifact.
"I'll go find that man now, and I'll come back here when I'm close to breaking through."
Shu Xian'er nodded.
"Go now."
After Shang Yumei left, a middle-aged woman appeared behind Shu Xian'er.
"Do you want me to follow Junior Sister Yumei, Master?
Since that man's Yang Qi can help her break through so quickly, it will definitely benefit us, and our disciples can become strong, too."
"No need." Shu Xian'er rejected her idea.
"Did you forget what Yumei said back then, Lu Xuejia?
Our technique doesn't work on that man, so you're just looking for death if you meet him.
He didn't do anything to her because she is a member of the Shang Clan, but we are only a middle-ranking sect and lack strong support, so we should not look for trouble with him."
"I understand, Master."
Shu Xian'er then turned to leave.
"Let's go back."
At dawn, Zhang Fei left Qing Yi and Zhang Lin, who were already deeply asleep in each other's arms.
He checked on all his wives to ask about their mastery of the Origin Soul Art.
Some of Zhang Fei's wives, such as Liu Hua, Liu Qingyu, Zhang Lingxue, Ye Lian, Chu Ying, Chu Xing, Shen Xueyi, Shen Yu, Boitata, and Hu Yue, managed to master the second stage of Origin Soul Art.
Meanwhile, Ru Xue, Zhong Yan, Tang Zhiyu, Zhao Ziqin, Lillea, and Janette only managed to master the first stage.
Even though they had not succeeded in mastering the second stage, Zhang Fei did not mind their results and encouraged them instead.
Having trained and cultivated for more than two days in the training space, Zhang Fei asked the others to rest and brought them all back to his residence.
He also brought his clones' partners with them, especially since his cultivation and soul were not yet completely stable.
Zhang Fei [1], Feltia [2], and Zhang Fei [4] also exited the training space and proceeded to another forest to complete the daily quest to kill beasts.

Upon their arrival, the disciples from the Heavenly Sword Sect and Yin-Yang Pavilion, including Lin Dong'er and Mu Lingshu, immediately went into the forest to hunt beasts and hone their fighting skills.
The senior cultivators decided to rest, and the senior women joined Zhang Chen to prepare breakfast.
"How do you feel after training there for more than two days?"
"Dead tired!" Yun Xinyue was the first to answer Zhang Fei.
Xian Changyue agreed.
"I'm exhausted, but I'm eager to adapt to the gravity."
"Fortunately, I am a beast, and my cultivation is higher than both of you.
Although I was overwhelmed by the gravity at first, I have become more and more adapted to it, and I might be able to adapt if I train for another week." Feng Yao then told Zhang Fei.
"I forgot to tell you that my mother and the others met Meng Qi in the Blossom Heaven Realm, and the realm leader gave her something addictive.
However, my mother had already removed it from her body and sent her here."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was really surprised to hear that.
"How long will it take her to arrive in this realm?"
Feng Yao thought for a moment.
"Meng Qi left two days ago, and she will probably arrive in this realm in ten days."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"I will immediately send Meng Qi back to the Sky Jade Realm, and she can reunite with her family."

"According to my mother, Meng Qi had something special in her body, so she freed her and sent her here." After Feng Yao said that, Zhang Fei immediately asked Mei to display the woman's data, but he couldn't find anything special about her.
"My mother didn't explain it in detail, but she hopes that you will keep her by your side."
Zhang Fei shook his head immediately.
"I don't know Meng Qi, and I've only met her once, so I don't have the intention to keep her by my side.
Moreover, she may not agree to stay here, so we'll ask her first after she arrives."
"Are you going to the capital, Fei?" Xian Xianqin suddenly asked.
"I haven't seen my parents since I returned from the tower, so I want to go back and see them first.
Moreover, I've already broken through to this stage; I'm sure they'll be shocked if they find out."
Zhang Fei nodded at Xian Xianqin.
"I want to build a pool in the training space, so I'll go to the capital to buy some stuff.
Anyway, Lingxue has already installed a teleportation device in my shop, saving us the trouble of traveling there.
We can access it through the portal in front of this residence."
"Can you also install one in my kingdom, Zhang Fei?" Yun Xinyue expectantly asked, especially since she could meet her family more easily if he installed it there.
"I've planned that, but I'll install it once I find the right building." Zhang Fei's answer pleased Yun Xinyue.
"You guys can rest first while waiting for my grandmother and the others to finish cooking."
"All right." Even though they were cultivators, they still needed to rest, so they rushed to the main building.
After the four women left, Zhang Fei approached the four moon foxes who were gathered in another area.
"Are you still thinking about returning to your sub-realm, Lili?"
"No." Hu Lili responded by shaking her head.
"After practicing in your training space, I realized that I was still too weak, so I focused on improving myself in the past week.
Although Hu Xiufu's cultivation is still in the core realm, she has already surpassed me in terms of speed, especially since she has been with you for several months."
"Haha." Hu Xiufu laughed awkwardly at that.
"Back then, those heavenly foxes kidnapped me, but Zhang Fei saved me from them.
Moreover, I didn't want to continue being taken advantage of by the elders, so I decided to hide in his training space."
Hu Qiaomu suddenly questioned Zhang Fei.
"Why don't you take Hu Xiufu as your partner, Master?
She's been with you since then, so I thought you'd already eaten her."
"Elder Qiaomu!" Hu Xiufu shouted in embarrassment.
Zhang Fei smiled as he looked at Hu Xiufu.
"She's pretty and sexy, and our relationship has gotten better since we left the Sky Jade Realm.
However, Xiufu obviously has no feelings for me, and she is more interested in my half-sibling."
"Your half-sibling?" Zhang Fei immediately pointed at Wang Xiaofeng, who was talking to Wang Zhuxian, Ming Hao, and Ming Yanyu in the distance.
"Do you really like him, Xiufu?" Hu Lili asked her.
Hu Xiufu nodded slightly.
"I like Wang Xiaofeng, Elder Lili.
Even though he is a human and his cultivation is far below mine, he has always been kind and friendly to me."
"I see." Hu Lili nodded in understanding.
"If you like Wang Xiaofeng, I think it's okay for you to be with him."
"Are you okay with them being lovers, Master?"
"If I had liked Xiufu, I would have approached her long ago, and she would have been my partner by now.
Although my relationship with Wang Xiaofeng is not really close, he is still related to me by blood, and I always think about my family.
Since they like each other, they can become a couple." Zhang Fei turned to Hu Lili, who immediately shifted her face to the side.
However, he pulled her into a hug and kissed her directly, causing her to curse in her heart.
"My Lili, you won't be able to avoid me all the time, and you will be my woman soon."
"Haha." Hu Yue softly laughed.
"Husband, you need a little coercion if you want my mother to be your wife, or she will never accept you."
Hu Lili glared at her daughter, but Hu Yue responded with a loud laugh.
Zhang Fei suddenly cupped her cheeks and stared at her eyes intensely, making her waver.
"Yue'er is right that I need a little force to get you, but I won't do it, and I want you to accept me of your own accord.
You guys can rest and have fun first, and I will bring you guys into the training space again tonight."
After that, Zhang Fei talked to other people, such as the Hai Twins, Lian Xiang, Qing Tan, Ming Han, Wang Zetian, and all of his in-laws' families.
He also talked with several people from other clans, such as Qin Zheng, Chang Wuhen, and their families.
Hearing the bustling sound outside, the seven women from Earth immediately woke up from their sleep and rushed to look for Zhang Fei.
However, the number of people in the residence surprised them, especially since it was several times greater than the number in the Chu Clan.
Since they were always busy handling his affairs on Earth, Zhang Fei took Huang Rong and the others to the southern ocean, where they had fun while venting their longing for him.
Naturally, they vented their longing by having sex with him, and they had never had outdoor sex before, which made their activities even hotter.
Inside the training space, Zhang Fei [5] was relentlessly forging a few spirit-grade weapons, but the results were still not to his satisfaction.
Moreover, the system had yet to give him any notification, so all the weapons he had forged before were still not perfect.
*Clang...
Clang...*

"These are the last materials I have, and Tie Xuan hasn't returned to the Wasteland Realm, so I must succeed in forging a perfect spirit-grade weapon this time." Quickly, three hours passed in the training space, and Zhang Fei [5] had already given the final touches to the weapon he was forging.
Once he was sure of the results, Zhang Fei [5] immediately dipped the weapon into a cooling liquid to cool it so he could see the final result.

"Phew." Zhang Fei [5] breathed a sigh of relief at the appearance of the two notifications, and his hard work over the past few days was not in vain.

"This sword is indeed much better than the previous ones, but it's still not as good as those forged by Gang Zhishou and Tie Xuan, and I still need to hone my forging skills more to reach their level."
[Even though this sword is still not as good as their forging, this is good enough, and you are a Spirit Rank Blacksmith now, Master.
However, you still can't create a true spirit weapon like the demon extermination sword, so you can improve your forging ability while learning how to create a true spirit weapon.]
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in response.

Moreover, the process of creating one necessitates the use of numerous precious materials, which come at an exorbitant cost.
Before I try to create one, I should deepen my forging skills first so I won't waste a lot of precious materials."

Currently, there are six blueprints, and three of them are spirit grade.
As for the materials, you may want to ask Gang Zhishou, Xian Xian, or Duan Zhao for help in getting them.]

"All the items in the system are not ordinary, so I'm sure those blueprints are not for creating ordinary spirit-grade equipment, and I will buy them after I can forge it smoothly." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly remembered something.

Grade: Heaven.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately stored the sword and took out the cloak.

Zhang Fei [5] promptly put the cloak back into storage.

However, it will be useful to Hua'er, so I will give it to her."
After that, Zhang Fei [5] decided to rest and cultivate first so he could complete one of the daily quests.
