"Let's meet my brother now, so we won't keep Senior Hun waiting too long."

chapters.title: Chapter 645 Hong Xinxin's Return
paragraphs: After Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Shang Yaolin left, Shang Yifen rushed to wake Shang Xinyu up. "Hey, Xinyu! Wake up!"
"Stop it, Yifen! I'm tired now! If you're curious about why you're here, you can wait for Long'er to come back." Shang Xinyu immediately closed her eyes again and continued sleeping.
"Tch!" Then, Shang Yifen jumped out of bed and hurried to the door, only to find it sealed from the outside. "This must be Shang Yaolin's or that brat's doing!"

Shang Yifen let out a heavy sigh and got back into bed, but she didn't dare to sleep again because she was afraid that Zhang Xiaolong [3] would do something to her. "Sigh! I wonder what his purpose was for bringing me here."
When Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the Shang Siblings arrived at the fortress, Hun Di and the others were already there, but Shang Yingyue told them that she still had to wait for her replacement to come.
"Long'er, I entrust our daughter to you." Wu Xueming said as he pushed the excited Wu Lianzhi towards Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "After we return from the tower, we will immediately pick her up."
"Hehehe." Wu Lianzhi laughed and hugged Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s arm. "This way, I can play around with you to my heart's content, Long'er."
'This little girl.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] silently sighed in his heart. "Don't worry, Senior Brother. I will definitely look after and protect him."

Suddenly, a man in his early thirties entered the room, causing Shang Yaolin and the others to frown. Shang Ziyuan's decision to send him to replace Shang Yingyue caught them off guard, and they worried about Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Wu Lianzhi.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] sensed a negative vibe from the man, prompting him to ask Mei to check his status. However, he felt confused after reading the man's status, especially since his surname was not Shang. Instead, his name was Ning Menghao, and his cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm. 'Dang! I thought I could relax in this realm, but a new problem has appeared now.'
"Yingyue, I—"
"Brat." Ning Menghao immediately turned to Huan Di. "I know Shang Ziyuan's purpose in sending you here, so you don't need to act friendly with my daughter."
"Senior, I—" Ning Menghao swallowed his words as Hun Di released his aura.

Hun Di then pointed at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "This kid is my new disciple, so you must remember his face well. I dare to guarantee the annihilation of your Ning Clan if anything happens to him and my granddaughter."

'What the hell? Why did this crazy old man take such a smelly brat as his disciple?' Ning Menghao cupped his hands in front of Hun Di. "Senior Hun, I will not dare to touch them, and I will help you ensure their safety."

Hun Di said nothing and led them out of the room, and Ning Menghao immediately took a deep breath. 'Shang Ziyuan should have known that the crazy old man was in this realm, but she deliberately pressured my father to send me here. Sigh! For now, I will monitor the situation first, and if the opportunity arises, I will carry out her plans.'

As they exited the room, two women immediately approached them, and four people from the younger generation followed behind them, surprising Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming. "Why are you two here, Mother and Aunt Xinxin?"

"You two are going to a dangerous place, so I came here on purpose to see you." Murong Qianying then handed each of them a storage ring. "Since you two have been living in this realm for a few months, you shouldn't have many resources, so I have prepared everything for you."
"Thank you, mother."

Hong Xinxin immediately pulled Shang Guangming into her embrace and caressed his cheek, making the four people behind them laugh. "Guangming, you must remember that you are my future husband, so you must take good care of yourself in that place, or I will become a widow before we even get married."
'Fuck! Aunt Xinxin always makes me embarrassed!' Shang Guangming released a soft sigh. "I will come back safely, so you don't need to worry about me."
"I believe in you, so you have to come back to me." Hong Xinxin then turned to Hun Di. "Soul Emperor, I entrust my future husband to you, and I will be grateful if you bring him back alive."
Hun Di just nodded and looked at the four people behind them. "Are they the best young generation of your Hong and Murong Clans?"
"Murong Zheyun, Murong Ning, Hong Jingquan, and Hong Liying pay respects to Soul Emperor." The four expressed their respect with a slight bow.
Murong Qianying then spoke to Hun Di. "Murong Zheyun and Murong Ning are indeed still below Murong Mengying, but they are not too far from her, Senior Hun."

"Aunt Qianying, if you claim that they are not far from me, you are looking down upon me. They are strong, but they are still far below me." They immediately turned to face Murong Mengying, who was walking towards them. "Senior Hun, Mengying will have to trouble you to take me there."
"Haha." Hun Di laughed at that. "I'll take you with us if you give me that thing, Little Mengying."
Murong Mengying smiled and handed a jug of wine to Hun Di. "Mengying naturally still remembers Senior Hun's preferences, so I have specially prepared this Spirit Dew Wine for you."
Hun Di immediately received the jug and took a sip of the wine. "Hahaha! Your wine is as delicious as ever, and I can never get enough of just one jug."

"I've prepared quite a lot of wine, and you can enjoy it while we're there, Senior Hun." Murong Mengying then turned to Qiao Liangren and Tie Xuan, who had just arrived, followed by four younger generations. "They are our last members, Senior Hun. The others are afraid to disturb you, so they plan to depart together using another flying artifact."
"Senior Hun, please forgive me for troubling you." Tie Xuan respectfully said that.
Hun Di shook his head slightly. "Since you've all gathered, we'll depart now so we don't fall behind the Nameless One and the others."

Shang Yingyue, Wu Xueming, Qiao Liangren, Murong Mengying, Shang Yaolin, Shang Guangming, and the eight younger generations from the four clans immediately followed Hun Di. Tie Xuan first handed a storage ring to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "It contains various forging materials for forging spirit-grade and earth-grade equipment, so you can use them to practice your forging skills."
"Thank you, Senior Brother Xuan." Zhang Xiaolong [3] received it with joy, and he immediately followed them out of the fortress, where people from various clans had gathered.

Hun Di immediately took out his flying artifact and asked them to board it, but he did not immediately board it and touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s chest, inserting something into his soul. "It will instantly kill Ning Menghao and the others if they attack you."
"Thank you, Master."
Afterward, Hun Di boarded his flying artifact and led his group out of the realm, trailed by the entourage from the other clans.
"Why didn't you go with them?" Murong Qianying asked Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"Master Hun said that my cultivation is not enough to go there, so he asked me to stay here and cultivate my soul." Zhang Xialong [3] turned to Hong Xinxin. "Are you free now, Aunt Xinxin? I have a lot of questions about body cultivation, so I hope you can stay in this realm for a few days to teach me."

"My father and grandfather returned last night, and they will be taking care of our clan from now on. Moreover, the situation in this realm will be a bit chaotic, so Sister Qianying and I decided to stay here for a few days to make sure everything is safe, and I will teach you more about body cultivation." Hong Xinxin observed then Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I didn't expect that you had already broken through to the Flesh Tempering Stage, but breaking through to the Blood Condensing Stage would be a bit more difficult, and you would probably need a year to break through to that stage."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed. "My body cultivation level would not have advanced to this stage now if Aunt Qianying hadn't given me that liquid. As for the third stage, I know it will be difficult, but I will never give up, and I will train my body even harder."
Hong Xinxin nodded in satisfaction. "Let's go back, and we will start your training today."

The two women then led Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Wu Lianzhi away, but the little girl kept pouting her lips. She wanted to play with him. However, the two women did not take the two to the Shang Clan residence; instead, they took them to the secret house in the middle of the forest.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately sent a voice transmission to Shang Xinyu and informed her about it, and he also told her to do whatever she wanted for a while.

Upon their arrival, Murong Qianying took Wu Lianzhi away to a room. She had purposely brought them there so that the little girl would be safe from people who were after her, especially Ning Menghao. "Little Lianzhi, you should wait here, and Long'er will accompany you after he finishes his training."
"Yes, Grandma Qianying." Wu Lianzhi replied with a helpless sigh and hurriedly climbed into bed.
Murong Qianying then followed Hong Xinxin and Zhang Xiaolong [3], who were already in the bathroom. "Are you going to use that liquid on him again?"
"Yes." Hong Xinxin then said to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Take off your clothes and use your adult form, especially since it will be more effective."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled inwardly before taking off his clothes, leaving Hong Xinxin astounded by the size of his dick. He immediately entered the wooden tub, which was already full of water. "I'm ready, Aunt Xinxin."
"Get ready." Hong Xinxin took several bottles of Jianshen liquid and poured them into the water.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately closed his eyes and absorbed the liquid, which caused his body to turn purplish black due to the poisons in it.

At first, Hong Xinxin did not believe Murong Qianying's story that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was immune to the poisons, but she had witnessed it with her own eyes now. In the end, she decided to pour in more of the liquid, which was very beneficial for him. "Somehow, this kid frightens me, Sister Qianying. The poisons are extremely poisonous, and a cultivator at his level would die from just a drop, but he doesn't feel any pain at all."

"You're right." Murong Qianying replied with a nod. "Long'er was even able to commit such an insane act against Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, and both of them escaped from this realm now. Anyway, Ning Menghao will discover their disappearance soon, and he will definitely report it to Shang Ziyuan. I'm sure she will be enraged after learning about their relationship, and she will definitely send people to hunt them down."
Hong Xinxin let out a soft sigh. "Just let Shang Ziyuan take care of her matters, and their situation will pave the way for us to fight the Shang Clan."
"Does Long'er really need a year to break through to the third stage?"

"No." Hong Xinxin reexamined Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I previously said that he needed a year because I still doubted your story, but the facts are right before my eyes now. If I continue to use Jianshen liquid on him, he might be able to break through to that stage in three months."
"I see." Murong Qianying nodded in understanding. "You can continue using the liquid, and if he becomes stronger faster, he will be of great help to us."

Hong Xinxin immediately agreed to Murong Qianying's request, but she was oblivious to her reason for wanting Zhang Xiaolong [3] to strengthen faster, which was for the sake of their sexual relationship.

Murong Qianying suddenly sensed her interspatial communication device vibrate, so she hurried to listen to the incoming message. She was surprised for a moment before smiling. 'Yumei is on her way to this realm, and she will arrive soon. I believe she came back here because of Long'er, but she still won't be able to subdue him, and she will fall deeper into his embrace instead.'

With his current strength in bed, Zhang Fei could easily exhaust the seven ordinary women. After he helped them get dressed, he immediately took them back to his residence and let them rest in his room, especially since his bed was large enough to accommodate so many women at once.

After that, Zhang Fei joined the others for breakfast and discussed various topics, particularly Huang Rong and Yang Lu'er's desire to expand their company's products on Earth. In the end, Tang Ziyu and Zhong Yan decided to go with him to the capital.

Ru Xue wanted to help them choose the goods, but Zhang Fei asked her to focus on learning healing techniques from Elmyra, the elf. He asked Hu Qiaomu, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue to join them since they were also light element possessors.

Zhang Fei sent Lillea and Janette into the Sealed World Pearl, and he asked them to plant many kinds of herbs that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had gotten on the Western Island of the Wasteland Realm. After all, they are Dryads, and their ability to control and manipulate plants is very useful for that. Besides them, he also sent Shi Wu there to learn from them, especially since she was a wood element possessor.

Since Shi Xi is a metal element possessor, Zhang Fei sent her to his fifth clone to learn about metals and forging. This would allow her to assist him in forging weapons, and her ability to control metal would make the process easier for him.
After settling everything, Zhang Fei led some women, including Feng Yao, Xian Xianqin, and Xian Changyue, to the capital.

As usual, Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters opened their shop, assisted by several people from the Demon Fox Group. Zhang Fei then gave the Eclipse Shadow Cloak to Liu Hua, who immediately led the Wen Twins to their restaurant.
Since they had been gone for quite some time, Xian Xianqin and Xian Changyue hurried back to the Xian Palace. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei took Feng Yao, Tang Zhiyu, and Zhong Yan to the market district.
In the Xian Palace, Xian Feng, Shi Qingzhuang, Yao Yin, and Xian Xianwu were stunned when they sensed that Xian Xianqin's cultivation had already reached the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm.

"You don't need to be surprised by her cultivation, especially since she swallowed a lot of Zhang Fei's Yang Qi." Xian Changyue's words caused Xian Xianqin's face to turn a vibrant red. "Moreover, her speed has already surpassed the two of you, Big Brother and Sister-in-Law."
"Hahaha." Xian Feng burst out laughing after hearing that. "Our decision to side with Zhang Fei finally bore fruit, and our daughter reaped the benefits."
Shi Qingzhuang moved then beside her daughter and took her away from them. 'Has your relationship with Zhang Fei entered an advanced stage? Have you ever been intimate with him?'

'Ugh! Mother! My relationship with Zhang Fei hasn't gone that far yet!' Shi Qingzhuang put on a suspicious look, making Xian Xianqin sigh helplessly. 'I've kissed him many times, but we've never done anything more than that. As for his Yang Qi, I drink it from a bottle, so you shouldn't think anything strange about our relationship.'

'Oh.' Shi Qingzhuang was disappointed upon hearing that. 'Since you have fallen in love with him and swallowed his Yang Qi, I think you should start thinking about your future relationship with him. Moreover, the number of his wives might increase again, so you should secure your position as soon as possible.'
Xian Xianqin's lips twitched at that. 'I don't want to think about that for now, Mother! I want to focus on my training first, and I will enter seclusion with him until my brother's wedding.'

sentences.text: After Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Shang Yaolin left, Shang Yifen rushed to wake Shang Xinyu up.
"Hey, Xinyu!
Wake up!"
"Stop it, Yifen!
I'm tired now!
If you're curious about why you're here, you can wait for Long'er to come back." Shang Xinyu immediately closed her eyes again and continued sleeping.
"Tch!" Then, Shang Yifen jumped out of bed and hurried to the door, only to find it sealed from the outside.
"This must be Shang Yaolin's or that brat's doing!"
Shang Yifen let out a heavy sigh and got back into bed, but she didn't dare to sleep again because she was afraid that Zhang Xiaolong [3] would do something to her.
"Sigh!
I wonder what his purpose was for bringing me here."
When Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the Shang Siblings arrived at the fortress, Hun Di and the others were already there, but Shang Yingyue told them that she still had to wait for her replacement to come.
"Long'er, I entrust our daughter to you." Wu Xueming said as he pushed the excited Wu Lianzhi towards Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"After we return from the tower, we will immediately pick her up."
"Hehehe." Wu Lianzhi laughed and hugged Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s arm.
"This way, I can play around with you to my heart's content, Long'er."
'This little girl.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] silently sighed in his heart.
"Don't worry, Senior Brother.
I will definitely look after and protect him."
Suddenly, a man in his early thirties entered the room, causing Shang Yaolin and the others to frown.
Shang Ziyuan's decision to send him to replace Shang Yingyue caught them off guard, and they worried about Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Wu Lianzhi.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] sensed a negative vibe from the man, prompting him to ask Mei to check his status.
However, he felt confused after reading the man's status, especially since his surname was not Shang.
Instead, his name was Ning Menghao, and his cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm. 'Dang!
I thought I could relax in this realm, but a new problem has appeared now.'
"Yingyue, I—"
"Brat." Ning Menghao immediately turned to Huan Di.
"I know Shang Ziyuan's purpose in sending you here, so you don't need to act friendly with my daughter."
"Senior, I—" Ning Menghao swallowed his words as Hun Di released his aura.
Hun Di then pointed at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"This kid is my new disciple, so you must remember his face well.
I dare to guarantee the annihilation of your Ning Clan if anything happens to him and my granddaughter."
'What the hell?
Why did this crazy old man take such a smelly brat as his disciple?' Ning Menghao cupped his hands in front of Hun Di.
"Senior Hun, I will not dare to touch them, and I will help you ensure their safety."

Hun Di said nothing and led them out of the room, and Ning Menghao immediately took a deep breath. 'Shang Ziyuan should have known that the crazy old man was in this realm, but she deliberately pressured my father to send me here.
Sigh!
For now, I will monitor the situation first, and if the opportunity arises, I will carry out her plans.'
As they exited the room, two women immediately approached them, and four people from the younger generation followed behind them, surprising Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming.
"Why are you two here, Mother and Aunt Xinxin?"
"You two are going to a dangerous place, so I came here on purpose to see you." Murong Qianying then handed each of them a storage ring.
"Since you two have been living in this realm for a few months, you shouldn't have many resources, so I have prepared everything for you."
"Thank you, mother."
Hong Xinxin immediately pulled Shang Guangming into her embrace and caressed his cheek, making the four people behind them laugh.
"Guangming, you must remember that you are my future husband, so you must take good care of yourself in that place, or I will become a widow before we even get married."
'Fuck!
Aunt Xinxin always makes me embarrassed!' Shang Guangming released a soft sigh.
"I will come back safely, so you don't need to worry about me."
"I believe in you, so you have to come back to me." Hong Xinxin then turned to Hun Di.
"Soul Emperor, I entrust my future husband to you, and I will be grateful if you bring him back alive."
Hun Di just nodded and looked at the four people behind them.
"Are they the best young generation of your Hong and Murong Clans?"
"Murong Zheyun, Murong Ning, Hong Jingquan, and Hong Liying pay respects to Soul Emperor." The four expressed their respect with a slight bow.
Murong Qianying then spoke to Hun Di.
"Murong Zheyun and Murong Ning are indeed still below Murong Mengying, but they are not too far from her, Senior Hun."
"Aunt Qianying, if you claim that they are not far from me, you are looking down upon me.
They are strong, but they are still far below me." They immediately turned to face Murong Mengying, who was walking towards them.
"Senior Hun, Mengying will have to trouble you to take me there."
"Haha." Hun Di laughed at that.
"I'll take you with us if you give me that thing, Little Mengying."
Murong Mengying smiled and handed a jug of wine to Hun Di.
"Mengying naturally still remembers Senior Hun's preferences, so I have specially prepared this Spirit Dew Wine for you."
Hun Di immediately received the jug and took a sip of the wine.
"Hahaha!
Your wine is as delicious as ever, and I can never get enough of just one jug."

"I've prepared quite a lot of wine, and you can enjoy it while we're there, Senior Hun." Murong Mengying then turned to Qiao Liangren and Tie Xuan, who had just arrived, followed by four younger generations.
"They are our last members, Senior Hun.
The others are afraid to disturb you, so they plan to depart together using another flying artifact."
"Senior Hun, please forgive me for troubling you." Tie Xuan respectfully said that.
Hun Di shook his head slightly.
"Since you've all gathered, we'll depart now so we don't fall behind the Nameless One and the others."
Shang Yingyue, Wu Xueming, Qiao Liangren, Murong Mengying, Shang Yaolin, Shang Guangming, and the eight younger generations from the four clans immediately followed Hun Di.
Tie Xuan first handed a storage ring to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"It contains various forging materials for forging spirit-grade and earth-grade equipment, so you can use them to practice your forging skills."
"Thank you, Senior Brother Xuan." Zhang Xiaolong [3] received it with joy, and he immediately followed them out of the fortress, where people from various clans had gathered.
Hun Di immediately took out his flying artifact and asked them to board it, but he did not immediately board it and touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s chest, inserting something into his soul.
"It will instantly kill Ning Menghao and the others if they attack you."
"Thank you, Master."
Afterward, Hun Di boarded his flying artifact and led his group out of the realm, trailed by the entourage from the other clans.
"Why didn't you go with them?" Murong Qianying asked Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Master Hun said that my cultivation is not enough to go there, so he asked me to stay here and cultivate my soul." Zhang Xialong [3] turned to Hong Xinxin.
"Are you free now, Aunt Xinxin?
I have a lot of questions about body cultivation, so I hope you can stay in this realm for a few days to teach me."
"My father and grandfather returned last night, and they will be taking care of our clan from now on.

Moreover, the situation in this realm will be a bit chaotic, so Sister Qianying and I decided to stay here for a few days to make sure everything is safe, and I will teach you more about body cultivation." Hong Xinxin observed then Zhang Xiaolong [3].

"I didn't expect that you had already broken through to the Flesh Tempering Stage, but breaking through to the Blood Condensing Stage would be a bit more difficult, and you would probably need a year to break through to that stage."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed.
"My body cultivation level would not have advanced to this stage now if Aunt Qianying hadn't given me that liquid.
As for the third stage, I know it will be difficult, but I will never give up, and I will train my body even harder."
Hong Xinxin nodded in satisfaction.
"Let's go back, and we will start your training today."
The two women then led Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Wu Lianzhi away, but the little girl kept pouting her lips.
She wanted to play with him.
However, the two women did not take the two to the Shang Clan residence; instead, they took them to the secret house in the middle of the forest.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately sent a voice transmission to Shang Xinyu and informed her about it, and he also told her to do whatever she wanted for a while.
Upon their arrival, Murong Qianying took Wu Lianzhi away to a room.
She had purposely brought them there so that the little girl would be safe from people who were after her, especially Ning Menghao.
"Little Lianzhi, you should wait here, and Long'er will accompany you after he finishes his training."
"Yes, Grandma Qianying." Wu Lianzhi replied with a helpless sigh and hurriedly climbed into bed.
Murong Qianying then followed Hong Xinxin and Zhang Xiaolong [3], who were already in the bathroom.
"Are you going to use that liquid on him again?"
"Yes." Hong Xinxin then said to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Take off your clothes and use your adult form, especially since it will be more effective."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled inwardly before taking off his clothes, leaving Hong Xinxin astounded by the size of his dick.
He immediately entered the wooden tub, which was already full of water.
"I'm ready, Aunt Xinxin."
"Get ready." Hong Xinxin took several bottles of Jianshen liquid and poured them into the water.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately closed his eyes and absorbed the liquid, which caused his body to turn purplish black due to the poisons in it.
At first, Hong Xinxin did not believe Murong Qianying's story that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was immune to the poisons, but she had witnessed it with her own eyes now.
In the end, she decided to pour in more of the liquid, which was very beneficial for him.
"Somehow, this kid frightens me, Sister Qianying.
The poisons are extremely poisonous, and a cultivator at his level would die from just a drop, but he doesn't feel any pain at all."
"You're right." Murong Qianying replied with a nod.
"Long'er was even able to commit such an insane act against Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, and both of them escaped from this realm now.
Anyway, Ning Menghao will discover their disappearance soon, and he will definitely report it to Shang Ziyuan.
I'm sure she will be enraged after learning about their relationship, and she will definitely send people to hunt them down."
Hong Xinxin let out a soft sigh.
"Just let Shang Ziyuan take care of her matters, and their situation will pave the way for us to fight the Shang Clan."
"Does Long'er really need a year to break through to the third stage?"
"No." Hong Xinxin reexamined Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"I previously said that he needed a year because I still doubted your story, but the facts are right before my eyes now.
If I continue to use Jianshen liquid on him, he might be able to break through to that stage in three months."
"I see." Murong Qianying nodded in understanding.
"You can continue using the liquid, and if he becomes stronger faster, he will be of great help to us."

Hong Xinxin immediately agreed to Murong Qianying's request, but she was oblivious to her reason for wanting Zhang Xiaolong [3] to strengthen faster, which was for the sake of their sexual relationship.
Murong Qianying suddenly sensed her interspatial communication device vibrate, so she hurried to listen to the incoming message.
She was surprised for a moment before smiling. 'Yumei is on her way to this realm, and she will arrive soon.
I believe she came back here because of Long'er, but she still won't be able to subdue him, and she will fall deeper into his embrace instead.'
With his current strength in bed, Zhang Fei could easily exhaust the seven ordinary women.
After he helped them get dressed, he immediately took them back to his residence and let them rest in his room, especially since his bed was large enough to accommodate so many women at once.
After that, Zhang Fei joined the others for breakfast and discussed various topics, particularly Huang Rong and Yang Lu'er's desire to expand their company's products on Earth.
In the end, Tang Ziyu and Zhong Yan decided to go with him to the capital.
Ru Xue wanted to help them choose the goods, but Zhang Fei asked her to focus on learning healing techniques from Elmyra, the elf.
He asked Hu Qiaomu, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue to join them since they were also light element possessors.
Zhang Fei sent Lillea and Janette into the Sealed World Pearl, and he asked them to plant many kinds of herbs that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had gotten on the Western Island of the Wasteland Realm.
After all, they are Dryads, and their ability to control and manipulate plants is very useful for that.
Besides them, he also sent Shi Wu there to learn from them, especially since she was a wood element possessor.
Since Shi Xi is a metal element possessor, Zhang Fei sent her to his fifth clone to learn about metals and forging.
This would allow her to assist him in forging weapons, and her ability to control metal would make the process easier for him.
After settling everything, Zhang Fei led some women, including Feng Yao, Xian Xianqin, and Xian Changyue, to the capital.
As usual, Zhang Lingxue and the Chu Sisters opened their shop, assisted by several people from the Demon Fox Group.
Zhang Fei then gave the Eclipse Shadow Cloak to Liu Hua, who immediately led the Wen Twins to their restaurant.
Since they had been gone for quite some time, Xian Xianqin and Xian Changyue hurried back to the Xian Palace.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei took Feng Yao, Tang Zhiyu, and Zhong Yan to the market district.
In the Xian Palace, Xian Feng, Shi Qingzhuang, Yao Yin, and Xian Xianwu were stunned when they sensed that Xian Xianqin's cultivation had already reached the 1-Moon Divine Transcend Realm.
"You don't need to be surprised by her cultivation, especially since she swallowed a lot of Zhang Fei's Yang Qi." Xian Changyue's words caused Xian Xianqin's face to turn a vibrant red.

paragraphs: "What about you, Changyue?"
Xian Changyue frowned at her brother. "What do you mean by that?"

"Do you think I'm stupid?" Xian Feng responded with a shake of his head. "Even though I'm not that close to Zhang Fei, I am an emperor, and I meet too many people every day. He is clearly interested in you and wants you to be his woman; otherwise, he wouldn't have brought you to his private place for training."
Xian Changyue let out a soft sigh. "Zhang Fei does want me to be his woman, and he has conveyed it to me loud and clear. However, I have no interest in him, and I have rejected him."

"Why didn't you think about it first?" Shi Qingzhuang asked as she and Xian Xianqin returned to their side. "You have never had a lover, and Zhang Fei's talent is too impressive to be ignored, so I think he is suitable to be your husband."

Unlike her parents, Xian Xianqin felt strange and awkward listening to them discuss her aunt's relationship with Zhang Fei. Even though she already knew about his messy relationship, she still felt strange that Xian Changyue also fell into his arms.

Xian Changyue turned to Shi Qingzhuang directly. "Sister-in-law, do you think talent is that important in choosing my husband? You are right that Zhang Fei's talent is impressive, but I would rather have a talentless man as my husband than have to share a husband with dozens of women, one of whom is my niece. My brother is less talented than him, yet you chose him to be your husband, right?"
"Pft! Hahahaha!" Xian Xianqin couldn't help but laugh at her aunt's words.
Unlike his twin sister, Xian Xianwu tried hard to hold back his laughter, especially since their father would punish him if he dared to laugh at him.

If Xian Changyue were not his little sister, Xian Feng would have immediately given her a severe punishment. "Even though I am less talented than Zhang Fei, I am not less handsome than him, and I am completely loyal to your sister-in-law."

"See?" Xian Changyue responded with a shake of her head. "Just like my sister-in-law, I only want to have a husband who is completely loyal to me. If such a man never comes to me, I will live single for the rest of my life, and it will make me much happier."

Shi Qingzhuang nodded in agreement. "All right, I won't say anything about your personal life, and you can decide everything yourself. We rarely get together, so let's go to Zhang Fei's restaurant to have a meal together."
Xian Feng and the others immediately agreed, and they rushed to the Sky Jade Restaurant, especially since Zhu Yan's cooking was too delicious to miss.

"Who attacked him? What is the mysterious person's real goal? Could it be that one of Xian Feng's aides attacked him? How did they know he was there?" Zhou Xiaochuan seriously considered Zhou Hanling's report in his private room. "Moreover, the mysterious person only knocked him out of the cold and didn't kill him, and the person also didn't seem to have done anything to Shenxin."
*Swoosh*

A black shadow suddenly appeared in front of Zhou Xiaochuan, surprising him. The shadow quickly transformed into a female demon in her twenties with curly jet-black hair and two beetle-like horns on the top of her head. Her face looked scary, with two heart-red eyes and pale skin as ash. Her figure was quite small but sexy, and she was wearing a black and red leather dress.

"Why did you suddenly come here, Xin Yanluo?" The female demon approached him without saying anything and kissed him, but Zhou Xiaochuan's expression appeared pained by the kiss. 'She's absorbing my life force.'

A while later, Xin Yanluo had already moved back and sat down at Zhou Xiaochuan's table. "My master sent me here to inform you that Ximen Changtian and Ximen Gongfu will be leaving for the Star Tower tomorrow."
"What are they looking for in the Star Tower? What does my queen want from me?" Zhou Xiaochuan questioned her while he swallowed a pill.

"My master heard that Ximen Yan was once controlled by a soul that resided in the Star Tower, and there were still so many mysteries within it, so they went there to check things out." Zhou Xiaochuan was surprised by Xin Yanluo's information. "She ordered you to go to the two demon kingdoms and take them over, and she will reward you handsomely if you succeed in doing so."
Zhou Xiaochuan raised his eyebrows. "Why doesn't my queen take over the two demon kingdoms herself? With her strength, she should be able to take over both kingdoms easily."

"You are my master's slave, and a slave should not question his master's orders." Zhou Xiaochuan clenched both fists tightly, but he did not dare to refute Xin Yanluo. "She can assist you in achieving your current position, but she also has the power to destroy you and your family."

Zhou Xiaochuan nodded at her. "All right, I will head to the two demon kingdoms a few days after Ximen Changtian and Ximen Gongfu depart, or else they will return to their respective kingdoms if they discover my movements."
"You can arrange it yourself, as my master is not in a hurry." Xin Yanluo then checked the entire area of the Zhou Palace. "Where are Zhou Tai, Zhou Meiling, and Zhou Shenxin?"

"Zhou Tai died in the Star Tower, but I don't know the identity of the murderer. Zhou Meiling also disappeared there, and I'm trying to find her." Zhou Xiaochuan's explanation caused Xin Yanluo to frown. "I sent Zhou Shenxin to capture a young man, and I suspect that he is related to Meiling's disappearance. However, I'm not sure if she will succeed in capturing him, especially since he has a close relationship with a powerful woman."
"Who are they?"

"The man is named Zhang Fei, but I don't have any clear information about his origins," Zhou Xiaochuan directly informed her. "He appeared out of nowhere and caused a stir in the Star Tower. Everyone, including Huangfu Shou, was after him now. However, he has a relationship with the Xian royal family, and Xian Xianqin seems to be his woman. The woman's name is Feng Yao, and she claims to come from the upper realms, like my queen."

When she heard the name, Xin Yanluo was shocked and panicked. She immediately informed her master about Feng Yao's presence. 'This is really bad! I didn't expect that the Phoenix princess was in this realm; our situation would turn serious if she found out about our presence here.'

Zhou Xiaochuan was confused by her reaction, especially since he knew that Xin Yanluo and her master were truly powerful. He wondered in his heart. 'What exactly is Feng Yao's identity? Why does she seem afraid of her?'
"Order Zhou Shenxin to return! Don't mess with Zhang Fei!" Xin Yanluo disappeared immediately after saying that.
However, Zhou Xiaochuan did not follow Xin Yanluo's words; instead, he immediately prepared to carry out her master's orders.
Meanwhile, Xin Yanluo arrived at a dimly lit place and hurried to a room at the end of the hall, where her master was waiting for her. "Master!"

The female demon had long silver hair with long bangs covering her forehead, and she had two quite large red horns. She looked like a woman in her twenties, like Xin Yanluo. She had a lovely and cute oval face, two wide eyes with red pupils, a slender but sharp nose, and small silver-covered lips. Her figure was quite tall and voluptuous, and she wore a revealing black dress. Her breasts are quite big at an F-cup, her waist is curved like a Mexican guitar, and her legs are a little too long for her figure.

"Did you order Zhou Xiaochuan to do that, Yanluo?" Xin Yanluo nodded and approached her master, but the female demon pulled her onto the bed and pinned her down. "How many times have I told you not to address me as a master when we are alone? My name is Ju Yingzhi, and you should address me as Big Sister Yingzhi."

"Hehe." Xin Yanluo giggled upon hearing that. "I'm used to calling you my master, and I feel a little weird calling you my big sister. What do you think was Princess Feng's motivation for coming to this realm?"

"Zhang Fei." Ju Yingzhi's answer confused Xin Yanluo. "The Phoenix race has never been close to humans, and only a few of them have good relations with them, such as the Nameless One and the two alchemists. Since Zhou Xiaochuan mentioned that Zhang Fei has a close relationship with Feng Yao, I am confident that she came here because of him, but I am unsure of their reason for staying here."

Xin Yanluo nodded before asking. "Should we move to another realm? If Princess Feng finds out about our presence in this realm, she might report us to those demon hunters, and they will hunt us down again. If they manage to find and capture you, you will not be able to free your parents, and you will also die in their hands."

"No need." Ju Yingzhi then sat on her bed again. "The Phoenix race never interferes in such matters, so I'm sure that Feng Yao won't report us to them even if she discovers our existence in this realm. Even so, we should still keep our distance and not seek trouble with her, and we will leave this realm once my condition becomes much better than now."
Xin Yanluo sat beside Ju Yingzhi and touched her chest. "Are your injuries still serious?"

"Yes." Ju Yingzhi nodded. "The demon hunter's attack was truly powerful, and he almost killed me that time. If I hadn't met you at that river, and you hadn't taken me away through that portal, I would have fallen into his hand and died."

Xin Yanluo released a soft sigh and hugged Ju Yingzhi. "I really don't want you to die, and I will help you as best as I can to recover from your injuries. Are you sure the demon resources in the two demon kingdoms are enough to recover from your injuries?"

"Back then, I used my strength in a severe condition to suppress Zhou Xiaochuan, which caused my injuries to worsen. My injuries have gotten much better in the last few decades, but my current strength is only one-tenth left, so I need more demon resources to recover." Ji Yingzhi let out a heavy sigh before continuing. "Unfortunately, this realm is located in the middle realms, and the resources here are not as useful as in the upper realms. Even if I use all the resources in the two demon kingdoms, I won't be able to recover my past strength, so we'll go to the other realm after I exhaust their demon resources."

"Haha." Xin Yanluo laughed. "Ximen Changtian and Ximen Gongfu still don't realize that Zhou Xiaochuan is our pawn, and we ordered him to establish a relationship with them. Since they are going to the Star Tower, they won't be back anytime soon, and you can use their demon resources after that stupid slave takes over their kingdoms."
Ju Yingzhi turned to Xin Yanluo and rubbed her head. "Even though I need their demon resources to restore my strength, I won't use them myself, and you can use them too."

"No." Xin Yanluo refused. "My cultivation is almost breaking through to the 3-Moon Divine Manifestation, and my demon rank has reached the queen rank, so I think these two are enough for now. Moreover, your enemies are powerful, and they can find us at any time. Therefore, you should focus on restoring your strength, or you won't be able to fight them. Anyway, I will go and keep an eye on the two demon kingdoms."
After Xin Yanluo left, Ju Yingzhi took out a pendant with a picture of two people. "Father! Mother! You two must survive and wait for me to return."

Ning Menghao looked confused because he couldn't find Shang Xiaoyin in the Shang Clan's residence. However, Shang Ziyuan had already told him about the three women by his daughter's side, so he tried to look for them, but he couldn't find Shang Xinyue and Shang Yifen.
Ning Menghao then looked for Shang Jiali and found her with Shang Wuzi. "Have you two seen Shang Xiaoyin and Shang Baishi?"

"Senior Ning, I don't know where the two of them are, and I last saw them about five days ago." Shang Wuzi's answer made Ning Menghao frown. "I don't know what happened, but they were acting strange."
"What do you mean by that?"
Shang Jiali signaled to Shang Wuzi not to say anything, but he did not listen to her. "Shang Xiaoyin acted like an infatuated woman, and she stayed in Senior Baishi's room for several days."
"Are you serious about that?" Ning Menghao asked in shock.
"Yes." Shang Wuzi then pointed at Shang Jiali. "Shang Xiaoyin even asked her and Shang Yifen to serve Senior Baishi, but she refused her request because she is my lover."

Ning Menghao turned to Shang Jiali, who confirmed it with a helpless nod. "Senior Ning, Xiaoyin really asked me and Yifen to serve Senior Baishi, but we know his character, so we refused his request."
"Do you know where they are now?"
Shang Jiali shook her head. "I last saw Xiaoyin yesterday, and she didn't contact me today, so I don't know where they went."

'This is really bad! Shang Ziyuan would be furious if she knew that they were in a romantic relationship!' Ning Menghao hurriedly left their room and returned to the fortress. 'I should contact my father and discuss this matter with him first.'
"Why did you tell Senior Ning about them?" Shang Jiali asked with an annoyed expression. "Don't you know how serious this matter is?"

Instead, Shang Wuzi pushed Shang Jiali down onto the bed. "I never liked Senior Baishi because my big sister was one of his victims. Since my family couldn't fight against him, I deliberately said that to Senior Ning, and I hoped he would die at Aunt Ziyuan's hands."
"But—"

"Are you worried about Xiaoyin?" Shang Jiali nodded to Shang Wuzi. "You don't need to worry about her. She is Aunt Ziyuan's only daughter, so she will never punish, let alone kill her. Instead of thinking about her, it would be better if you thought about our relationship. Shall we do it now?"
"Yeah."

After they had wandered around for a few hours and bought many things, Zhang Fei brought Tang Zhiyu and Zhong Yan back to the Sky Jade Shop. The two women went straight back to their residence, but he didn't go back there and went to Gang Zhishou's shop instead.

Meanwhile, Feng Yao chose to take a leisurely stroll in the capital, but her attention was not focused on her surroundings. Instead, her attention was drawn to some other areas far away, and many questions emerged in her mind.
Sometime later, Zhang Fei arrived at the blacksmith shop, and he hurried to meet Gang Zhishou, who had just finished forging a weapon. "Has Senior Duan contacted you, Old Gang?"
"Yes," Gang Zhishou nodded. "My master has finished designing the weapon, and he asked me to tell you about it. Do you want to go there now?"
"In that case, let's go there now; I also want to discuss some things with him about blacksmithing."
"Wait a minute; I'll clean up this place first."
After Gang Zhishou tidied up all the leftover things, Zhang Fei immediately took him to Duan Zhou's residence.

sentences.text: "What about you, Changyue?"

"What do you mean by that?"

"Even though I'm not that close to Zhang Fei, I am an emperor, and I meet too many people every day.

Xian Changyue let out a soft sigh.
"Zhang Fei does want me to be his woman, and he has conveyed it to me loud and clear.
However, I have no interest in him, and I have rejected him."
"Why didn't you think about it first?" Shi Qingzhuang asked as she and Xian Xianqin returned to their side.

Unlike her parents, Xian Xianqin felt strange and awkward listening to them discuss her aunt's relationship with Zhang Fei.
Even though she already knew about his messy relationship, she still felt strange that Xian Changyue also fell into his arms.
Xian Changyue turned to Shi Qingzhuang directly.
"Sister-in-law, do you think talent is that important in choosing my husband?
You are right that Zhang Fei's talent is impressive, but I would rather have a talentless man as my husband than have to share a husband with dozens of women, one of whom is my niece.
My brother is less talented than him, yet you chose him to be your husband, right?"
"Pft!
Hahahaha!" Xian Xianqin couldn't help but laugh at her aunt's words.
Unlike his twin sister, Xian Xianwu tried hard to hold back his laughter, especially since their father would punish him if he dared to laugh at him.
If Xian Changyue were not his little sister, Xian Feng would have immediately given her a severe punishment.
"Even though I am less talented than Zhang Fei, I am not less handsome than him, and I am completely loyal to your sister-in-law."
"See?" Xian Changyue responded with a shake of her head.
"Just like my sister-in-law, I only want to have a husband who is completely loyal to me.
If such a man never comes to me, I will live single for the rest of my life, and it will make me much happier."
Shi Qingzhuang nodded in agreement.
"All right, I won't say anything about your personal life, and you can decide everything yourself.
We rarely get together, so let's go to Zhang Fei's restaurant to have a meal together."
Xian Feng and the others immediately agreed, and they rushed to the Sky Jade Restaurant, especially since Zhu Yan's cooking was too delicious to miss.
"Who attacked him?
What is the mysterious person's real goal?
Could it be that one of Xian Feng's aides attacked him?
How did they know he was there?" Zhou Xiaochuan seriously considered Zhou Hanling's report in his private room.
"Moreover, the mysterious person only knocked him out of the cold and didn't kill him, and the person also didn't seem to have done anything to Shenxin."
*Swoosh*
A black shadow suddenly appeared in front of Zhou Xiaochuan, surprising him.
The shadow quickly transformed into a female demon in her twenties with curly jet-black hair and two beetle-like horns on the top of her head.
Her face looked scary, with two heart-red eyes and pale skin as ash.
Her figure was quite small but sexy, and she was wearing a black and red leather dress.

"Why did you suddenly come here, Xin Yanluo?" The female demon approached him without saying anything and kissed him, but Zhou Xiaochuan's expression appeared pained by the kiss. 'She's absorbing my life force.'
A while later, Xin Yanluo had already moved back and sat down at Zhou Xiaochuan's table.
"My master sent me here to inform you that Ximen Changtian and Ximen Gongfu will be leaving for the Star Tower tomorrow."
"What are they looking for in the Star Tower?
What does my queen want from me?" Zhou Xiaochuan questioned her while he swallowed a pill.

"My master heard that Ximen Yan was once controlled by a soul that resided in the Star Tower, and there were still so many mysteries within it, so they went there to check things out." Zhou Xiaochuan was surprised by Xin Yanluo's information.
"She ordered you to go to the two demon kingdoms and take them over, and she will reward you handsomely if you succeed in doing so."
Zhou Xiaochuan raised his eyebrows.
"Why doesn't my queen take over the two demon kingdoms herself?
With her strength, she should be able to take over both kingdoms easily."
"You are my master's slave, and a slave should not question his master's orders." Zhou Xiaochuan clenched both fists tightly, but he did not dare to refute Xin Yanluo.
"She can assist you in achieving your current position, but she also has the power to destroy you and your family."
Zhou Xiaochuan nodded at her.
"All right, I will head to the two demon kingdoms a few days after Ximen Changtian and Ximen Gongfu depart, or else they will return to their respective kingdoms if they discover my movements."
"You can arrange it yourself, as my master is not in a hurry." Xin Yanluo then checked the entire area of the Zhou Palace.
"Where are Zhou Tai, Zhou Meiling, and Zhou Shenxin?"
"Zhou Tai died in the Star Tower, but I don't know the identity of the murderer.
Zhou Meiling also disappeared there, and I'm trying to find her." Zhou Xiaochuan's explanation caused Xin Yanluo to frown.
"I sent Zhou Shenxin to capture a young man, and I suspect that he is related to Meiling's disappearance.
However, I'm not sure if she will succeed in capturing him, especially since he has a close relationship with a powerful woman."
"Who are they?"
"The man is named Zhang Fei, but I don't have any clear information about his origins," Zhou Xiaochuan directly informed her.
"He appeared out of nowhere and caused a stir in the Star Tower.
Everyone, including Huangfu Shou, was after him now.
However, he has a relationship with the Xian royal family, and Xian Xianqin seems to be his woman.
The woman's name is Feng Yao, and she claims to come from the upper realms, like my queen."
When she heard the name, Xin Yanluo was shocked and panicked.
She immediately informed her master about Feng Yao's presence. 'This is really bad!
I didn't expect that the Phoenix princess was in this realm; our situation would turn serious if she found out about our presence here.'
Zhou Xiaochuan was confused by her reaction, especially since he knew that Xin Yanluo and her master were truly powerful.
He wondered in his heart. 'What exactly is Feng Yao's identity?
Why does she seem afraid of her?'
"Order Zhou Shenxin to return!
Don't mess with Zhang Fei!" Xin Yanluo disappeared immediately after saying that.
However, Zhou Xiaochuan did not follow Xin Yanluo's words; instead, he immediately prepared to carry out her master's orders.
Meanwhile, Xin Yanluo arrived at a dimly lit place and hurried to a room at the end of the hall, where her master was waiting for her.
"Master!"
The female demon had long silver hair with long bangs covering her forehead, and she had two quite large red horns.
She looked like a woman in her twenties, like Xin Yanluo.
She had a lovely and cute oval face, two wide eyes with red pupils, a slender but sharp nose, and small silver-covered lips.
Her figure was quite tall and voluptuous, and she wore a revealing black dress.
Her breasts are quite big at an F-cup, her waist is curved like a Mexican guitar, and her legs are a little too long for her figure.
"Did you order Zhou Xiaochuan to do that, Yanluo?" Xin Yanluo nodded and approached her master, but the female demon pulled her onto the bed and pinned her down.
"How many times have I told you not to address me as a master when we are alone?
My name is Ju Yingzhi, and you should address me as Big Sister Yingzhi."
"Hehe." Xin Yanluo giggled upon hearing that.
"I'm used to calling you my master, and I feel a little weird calling you my big sister.
What do you think was Princess Feng's motivation for coming to this realm?"
"Zhang Fei." Ju Yingzhi's answer confused Xin Yanluo.
"The Phoenix race has never been close to humans, and only a few of them have good relations with them, such as the Nameless One and the two alchemists.
Since Zhou Xiaochuan mentioned that Zhang Fei has a close relationship with Feng Yao, I am confident that she came here because of him, but I am unsure of their reason for staying here."
Xin Yanluo nodded before asking.
"Should we move to another realm?
If Princess Feng finds out about our presence in this realm, she might report us to those demon hunters, and they will hunt us down again.
If they manage to find and capture you, you will not be able to free your parents, and you will also die in their hands."
"No need." Ju Yingzhi then sat on her bed again.
"The Phoenix race never interferes in such matters, so I'm sure that Feng Yao won't report us to them even if she discovers our existence in this realm.
Even so, we should still keep our distance and not seek trouble with her, and we will leave this realm once my condition becomes much better than now."
Xin Yanluo sat beside Ju Yingzhi and touched her chest.
"Are your injuries still serious?"
"Yes." Ju Yingzhi nodded.
"The demon hunter's attack was truly powerful, and he almost killed me that time.
If I hadn't met you at that river, and you hadn't taken me away through that portal, I would have fallen into his hand and died."
Xin Yanluo released a soft sigh and hugged Ju Yingzhi.
"I really don't want you to die, and I will help you as best as I can to recover from your injuries.
Are you sure the demon resources in the two demon kingdoms are enough to recover from your injuries?"
"Back then, I used my strength in a severe condition to suppress Zhou Xiaochuan, which caused my injuries to worsen.

My injuries have gotten much better in the last few decades, but my current strength is only one-tenth left, so I need more demon resources to recover." Ji Yingzhi let out a heavy sigh before continuing.
"Unfortunately, this realm is located in the middle realms, and the resources here are not as useful as in the upper realms.
Even if I use all the resources in the two demon kingdoms, I won't be able to recover my past strength, so we'll go to the other realm after I exhaust their demon resources."
"Haha." Xin Yanluo laughed.
"Ximen Changtian and Ximen Gongfu still don't realize that Zhou Xiaochuan is our pawn, and we ordered him to establish a relationship with them.
Since they are going to the Star Tower, they won't be back anytime soon, and you can use their demon resources after that stupid slave takes over their kingdoms."
Ju Yingzhi turned to Xin Yanluo and rubbed her head.
"Even though I need their demon resources to restore my strength, I won't use them myself, and you can use them too."
"No." Xin Yanluo refused.
"My cultivation is almost breaking through to the 3-Moon Divine Manifestation, and my demon rank has reached the queen rank, so I think these two are enough for now.
Moreover, your enemies are powerful, and they can find us at any time.
Therefore, you should focus on restoring your strength, or you won't be able to fight them.
Anyway, I will go and keep an eye on the two demon kingdoms."
After Xin Yanluo left, Ju Yingzhi took out a pendant with a picture of two people.
"Father!
Mother!
You two must survive and wait for me to return."

paragraphs: Duan Zhao repeatedly nodded as he observed the details of the spirit-grade sword that Zhang Fei showed him. "This sword is perfect in terms of materials, model, length, and sharpness. However, you could refine it further by slightly reducing the blade's thickness and slimming down the hilt. Regardless, you have done a fantastic job by successfully forging a piece of spirit-grade equipment in less than two weeks, and you are ready to compete with the younger generation of the Divine Flames Realm."
"Please register my name in the competition as Old Gang's disciple, Senior Duan."
Gang Zhishou looked at Zhang Fei in surprise. "Why—"

Zhang Fei explained to him directly. "Old Gang, you were the first to teach me blacksmithing, remember? Even if you don't want me as a disciple, I want to do this out of gratitude, so please don't refuse."

"I think that's a good choice." Duan Zhao said. "The people from the Divine Flames Realm exhibit excessive arrogance, and their leader has strong connections with the blacksmith union. Moreover, Zhang Fei doesn't have a name in the blacksmithing world yet, so he still lacks support. If he becomes your disciple, they won't dare to do anything to him, especially since you are my disciple."

Zhang Fei wasn't too afraid of the people from the Divine Flames Realm, but he didn't know for sure about their strength. That's why he made this decision, especially since Duan Zhao had quite the popularity and influence in the blacksmithing world in the middle realms.
Gang Zhishou released a soft sigh before agreeing. "All right, you can do it, Master."
"Yeah."

After discussing various topics, Zhang Fei escorted Gang Zhishou back to the capital. Meanwhile, Duan Zhao tried to design another weapon, especially since he felt that the current one was not good enough.
Since Gang Zhishou wanted to forge other equipment to prepare for the blacksmithing competition, which was less than a month away, Zhang Fei decided to leave him and enter the training space.

Zhang Fei began building an artificial pond in the training space, especially because he wanted to transfer the blood of the beasts he had taken from Shang Xiaoyin's secret place to it. This way, all his women and people close to him could use the blood to temper their bodies.

In her private room, Murong Yinghua sat by the window and looked toward the Shang Clan residence, which was not too far from the fortress. She was curious about Zhang Xiaolong [3], especially because of Murong Mengying's attitude toward him.

Unfortunately, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still tempering his body in another area under Hong Xinxin's guidance, so Murong Yinghua was unable to find him in the residence. Her expression turned curious when she was unable to check one of the rooms, which she believed to be his. "Did that kid use something in his room to block other people's senses from checking him out? Who exactly is he? Why does my big sister seem to think highly of him? Moreover, not only is he a disciple of the Soul Emperor, but he also appears to be Hong Xinxin's disciple. Aunt Qianying also treats him differently, something she has never done for anyone in my generation, let alone the generation below."
Murong Yinghua let out a soft sigh and withdrew her senses. She immediately left the fortress and went to the Murong Clan residence in the realm, checking on every member of her clan who lived there.
A middle-aged man sat in front of Ning Menghao with a serious expression. "Are you sure that Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin are in a romantic relationship?"

"Yes." Ning Menghao replied with a nod. "Father, I have already verified this with two people close to Shang Xiaoyin, but I have been unable to locate them anywhere. I believe they are indeed in a romantic relationship, and they fled this realm to avoid Zhang Ziyuan. Should I report this matter to her?"
Ning Menghao's father, Ning Yuzhong, considered the pros and cons first. "Keep this matter to yourself for the time being, and I will ask the other clans for their opinions first."
"Which clans?"
"Murong, Hong, Hao, Qiao, Tie, and Huang Clans."
Ning Menghao then told him. "Father, Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin are currently in this realm, but I'm unsure of their exact location, and they've brought Senior Hun Di's disciple with them."
"Which Senior Hun Di's disciple is it? Is it Shang Yingyue or Qiao Liangren?"

"Neither." Ning Menghao then explained to his father about Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Shang Ziyuan sent Shang Baishi to capture him, and she asked me to do the same. She didn't tell us that the kid was Senior Hun Di's disciple, and it made me think that she wanted to sacrifice us."

Ning Yuzhong agreed with his son. "Since Murong Qianying is with that kid, I can't meet her now. Hong Xinxin's influence is quite big in the Hong clan, but the final decision is in the hands of her father and grandfather, Hong Chong and Hong Quan. I'll go back and meet them first, and I'll go to the other clans afterward."
"Please let me know when you get their decision, Father."
"All right."

After his father left, Ning Menghao let out a heavy sigh and leaned back in his chair. "I'm sure the Shang Clan will weaken without Shang Huaqiang and Shang Ziyuan. If my clan and the others work together to take advantage of the chaos in their clan, I'm sure we can fight back and destroy them, so we'll be free from their pressure."

Inside the bedroom, Shang Yifen looked irritated because she still couldn't leave the room, and her incessant grumbling was bothering Shang Xinyu. "Hey! Stop grumbling, Yifen! I know you want to go out, but Long'er brought you here for your safety."
"What do you mean by that?" Shang Yifen asked with a frown.

Shang Xinyu shook her head. "I don't know what Long'er has done to Shang Xiaoyin yet, but he told me that she will never bother us again. Actually, he did it for me, but because you are my best friend, he brought you here to ensure you wouldn't get involved in that trouble."
"Are you referring to the matter regarding Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin's relationship?"

"Yes." Shang Xinyu nodded at her. "Their relationship will cause significant problems, particularly if Shang Ziyuan discovers it. We are Xiaoyin's close people, and she will definitely blame us because we didn't stop her daughter. Therefore, you should wait patiently here, and Long'er will let you out once the situation calms down."
Shang Yifen let out a soft sigh as she realized the precarious situation. "Why do you trust that kid so much? Where did you disappear to before? Did he hide you somewhere else?"

"Long'er is still a child, but I love him." Shang Xinyu's answer left Shang Yifen dumbfounded. Moreover, he is very kind to me and always protects me, so I decided to accept my feelings for him. Unfortunately, he is still a child, so I can't introduce him to my parents yet, or they will think I'm crazy for falling in love with him."
"You are indeed crazy!" Shang Yifen shouted. "You are over hundreds of years old, and he is only 10 years old, yet you fell in love with him."
Shang Xinyu smiled in response. "Love knows no age, and I love him. If you have lived and known him, I'm sure you will also fall in love with him, especially since he is always gentle."
"Humph!" Shang Yifen snorted in denial, but she also harbored curiosity about Zhang Xiaolong [4]. After all, Shang Yaolin had fallen for him, and her best friend had also fallen for him now.

"Instead of continuing to be upset, you should start cultivating so you can forget about your situation." Shang Yifen nodded helplessly, and they started cultivating while waiting for Zhang Xiaolong [3] to return.

Not only that, this place is also much more suitable for the members of my race to live in compared to the Fairy Forest in the Sky Jade Realm, and they will definitely enjoy living here."

When this pearl has grown, I will bring members of your race to live here so you two can meet them more often."
